name: Moxikind CV 625mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About MOXIKIND CV 625MG TABLET

MOXIKIND CV 625MG TABLET is used to manage bacterial infections, including middle ear and sinus infections, respiratory tract infections, genital tract infections, urinary tract infections, skin and soft tissue infections such as dental infections, bone and joint infections, septic abortion, and abdominal infections. The symptoms of bacterial infection include fever, difficulty breathing, pus formation, and pain.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belong to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It works by preventing the growth of bacteria and helps clear up the infection.

MOXIKIND CV 625MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have liver problems or jaundice upon taking an antibiotic or amoxicillin-clavulanate. Before taking this medicine, inform your doctor if you are suffering from a hepatic impairment, liver disease, renal impairment, kidney disease, glandular fever, or are unable to pass water properly.

MOXIKIND CV 625MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary. It should be used with caution in children (aged below 12 years) and elderly patients (above 50 years).

The common side effects associated with the use of MOXIKIND CV 625MG TABLET are diarrhea, thrush (fungal infection in the vagina, skin folds, or mouth), nausea, and vomiting. Contact your doctor immediately if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of MOXIKIND CV 625MG TABLET
Manage bacterial infection
mechanismOfAction:
How MOXIKIND CV 625MG TABLET Works

MOXIKIND CV 625MG TABLET helps in managing bacterial infection where amoxicillin is a penicillin that works by inhibiting the enzymes that help in the synthesis of the integral structural component of the bacterial cell wall whereas clavulanic acid is a beta-lactam (structurally related to penicillin) that works by inactivating an enzyme, namely beta-lactamase, thereby managing the inactivation of amoxicillin.
usageInstructions: Take this medicine as advised by your physician.
For Tablet, Capsule: Swallow the tablet with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse MOXIKIND CV 625MG TABLET in the specified quantity of water as mentioned in the label.
Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

name: Ampoxin 500mg Capsule 15'S
introduction:
Introduction About AMPOXIN 500MG CAPSULE

AMPOXIN 500MG CAPSULE is a combination of Ampicillin and Cloxacillin which belongs to the group of medicines called Penicillin Antibiotics. It is used to manage respiratory tract infections like bronchopneumonia, acute exacerbations of chronic bronchitis, post-operative wound infections, postoperative pulmonary infections, puerperal fever and other infections such as septicaemia, pelvic infections, urinary tract infections, skin and soft tissue infections, and gastrointestinal infections, bone infections like Ex. osteomyelitis, ear, nose and throat infections.

Before taking AMPOXIN 500MG CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have liver or kidney disease. AMPOXIN 500MG CAPSULE is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless clearly necessary. Contact your doctor before taking it.

AMPOXIN 500MG CAPSULE is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Contact your doctor before taking.

AMPOXIN 500MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in neonates with jaundice and should be used with caution in children. Contact your doctor before taking.

AMPOXIN 500MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years). Contact your doctor before taking.

The most common side effects of this medicine are nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, stomach pain or stomach upset and skin rash. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.
uses: Infected wounds or lung infections following surgery
Fever associated with a bacterial infection
usesDetails:
Uses Of AMPOXIN 500MG CAPSULE

It is used to manage:

Infected wounds or lung infections following surgery
Respiratory tract infections
Fever associated with a bacterial infection
mechanismOfAction:
How AMPOXIN 500MG CAPSULE Works

AMPOXIN 500MG CAPSULE is a combination of Ampicillin and cloxacillin where ampicillin (has a broad spectrum of bactericidal activity against many gram-positive and gram-negative aerobic and anaerobic bacteria. It acts through the inhibition of cell wall mucopeptide biosynthesis during the stage of active multiplication.) Cloxacillin manages bacteria from reproducing, which allows your body to fight only the existing bacteria.
usageDetails:
How to use AMPOXIN 500MG CAPSULE

Take AMPOXIN 500MG CAPSULE as advised by your physician.

For Tablet, Capsule: Swallow AMPOXIN 500MG CAPSULE with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse the medicine in the specified quantity of water as mentioned on the label. Consume the medicine immediately after reconstitution.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending on your age, body weight and severity of the infection.
sideEffects: Allergic reaction such as skin rash, itching, swelling of the face, lips, tongue and mouth causing difficulty in breathing
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of AMPOXIN 500MG CAPSULE
Common
Nausea, vomiting
Diarrhoea
Stomach pain or stomach upset
Skin rash, urticaria, pruritus
Rare

Stop taking AMPOXIN 500MG CAPSULE and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects:

Allergic reaction such as skin rash, itching, swelling of the face, lips, tongue and mouth causing difficulty in breathing

warnings.details: There is no adequate human data on use during pregnancy. However, studies have not identified any risk to pregnancy or embryo-foetal development. Contact your doctor before taking.
There is no adequate human data on use during lactation. Contact your doctor before taking.
AMPOXIN 500MG CAPSULE has no effects on the ability to drive and use machinery. Contact your doctor before taking.
AMPOXIN 500MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with kidney disease. Contact your doctor before taking.
AMPOXIN 500MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with liver disease. Contact your doctor before taking.
Do not take AMPOXIN 500MG CAPSULE if you are allergic to Ampicillin, Cloxacillin or beta-lactam antibiotics (Ex. penicillin, cephalosporins) or other ingredients of this medicine.

Others

AMPOXIN 500MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use if you:

Are on a diet that restricts the amount of sodium
Have glandular fever and/or leukaemia
Have jaundice (in children)

Use in pediatrics:

Your doctor will give the right dose depending on your child’s age, body weight and disease condition. Consult your doctor before taking AMPOXIN 500MG CAPSULE.

Use in geriatrics:

AMPOXIN 500MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years above). Contact your doctor before taking.

introduction:
Introduction About MOX 500MG CAPSULE

MOX 500MG CAPSULE is an antibiotic medicine used in the management of various bacterial infections such as respiratory tract infections, ear, nose, throat infections, stomach infections (H. Pylori infection), skin infections and urinary tract infections. It contains a medicine called amoxycillin which is a powerful antibacterial agent that eradicates the susceptible microorganism that causes the infection.

Take MOX 500MG CAPSULE as advised by the physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Do not skip doses or stop therapy with MOX 500MG CAPSULE without consulting your doctor, as it will make this medicine less effective against the bacteria which causes infection.

Therefore, make sure to complete the duration of therapy as suggested by your doctor for fast recovery. Do not take MOX 500MG CAPSULE if you are allergic to Amoxycillin. Before taking MOX 500MG CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, glandular fever, urinary problems, etc. Consult your doctor before taking MOX 500MG CAPSULE if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking MOX 500MG CAPSULE are nausea, diarrhea and skin rashes. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.
usesDetails:
Uses Of MOX 500MG CAPSULE

Management of bacterial infections such as:

Respiratory tract infections
Ear, nose, throat infections
Stomach infections (H. Pylori infection)
Skin infections
Urinary tract infections
mechanismOfAction:
How MOX 500MG CAPSULE Works

MOX 500MG CAPSULE contains a medicine called Amoxicillin which is a type of antibiotic that belongs to the penicillin group. It works by inhibiting the synthesis of bacterial cell walls. Bacteria have a protective outer layer called the cell wall, which is essential for their survival. Amoxicillin interferes with the enzymes that are responsible for forming the cell wall, specifically targeting the cross-linking process. This weakens the cell wall, causing it to rupture and ultimately leading to the death of the bacteria. This action makes amoxicillin effective against a wide range of bacterial infections.

introduction:
Introduction About MOXCLAV 625MG TABLET

MOXCLAV 625MG TABLET is used to manage bacterial infections, including middle ear and sinus infections, respiratory tract infections, genital tract infections, urinary tract infections, skin and soft tissue infections such as dental infections, bone and joint infections, septic abortion, and abdominal infections. The symptoms of bacterial infection include fever, difficulty breathing, pus formation, and pain.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belong to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It works by preventing the growth of bacteria and helps clear up the infection.

MOXCLAV 625MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have liver problems or jaundice upon taking an antibiotic or amoxicillin-clavulanate. Before taking this medicine, inform your doctor if you are suffering from a hepatic impairment, liver disease, renal impairment, kidney disease, glandular fever, or are unable to pass water properly.

MOXCLAV 625MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary. It should be used with caution in children (aged below 12 years) and elderly patients (above 50 years).

The common side effects associated with the use of MOXCLAV 625MG TABLET are diarrhea, thrush (fungal infection in the vagina, skin folds, or mouth), nausea, and vomiting. Contact your doctor immediately if any of the symptoms worsen.

Manage bacterial infection
mechanismOfAction:
How MOXCLAV 625MG TABLET Works

MOXCLAV 625MG TABLET helps in managing bacterial infection where amoxicillin is a penicillin that works by inhibiting the enzymes that help in the synthesis of the integral structural component of the bacterial cell wall whereas clavulanic acid is a beta-lactam (structurally related to penicillin) that works by inactivating an enzyme, namely beta-lactamase, thereby managing the inactivation of amoxicillin.

introduction:
Introduction About AMPOXIN DRY SYRUP

AMPOXIN DRY SYRUP is a combination of Ampicillin and Cloxacillin which belongs to the group of medicines called Penicillin Antibiotics. It is used to manage respiratory tract infections like bronchopneumonia, acute exacerbations of chronic bronchitis, post-operative wound infections, post-operative lung infections, puerperal fever and other infections such as septicaemia, bone infections like osteomyelitis, ear, nose and throat infections.

Before taking AMPOXIN DRY SYRUP inform your doctor if you have liver or kidney disease. There is no proper information on the use of AMPOXIN DRY SYRUP during pregnancy and breastfeeding, and therefore consult your doctor before taking.

AMPOXIN DRY SYRUP should be used with caution in neonates with jaundice and in children. Contact your doctor before taking.

AMPOXIN DRY SYRUP should be used with caution in elderly patients aged 65 years and above. Contact your doctor before taking.

The most common side effects of taking AMPOXIN DRY SYRUP are nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, skin rash, urticaria, pruritus. Contact your doctor if any of the side effects worsen
uses: Infected wounds or lung infections following surgery

Infected wounds or lung infections following surgery
Respiratory tract infections
Fever associated with bacterial infection
mechanismOfAction:
How AMPOXIN DRY SYRUP Works

AMPOXIN DRY SYRUP is a combination of Ampicillin and cloxacillin where ampicillin has a broad spectrum of bactericidal activity against many gram-positive and gram-negative aerobic and anaerobic bacteria. It acts through the inhibition of cell wall mucopeptide biosynthesis during the stage of active multiplication. Cloxacillin manages bacteria from reproducing, which allows your body to fight only the existing bacteria.

Introduction About MEGAPEN 500MG CAPSULE

MEGAPEN 500MG CAPSULE is a combination of Ampicillin and Cloxacillin which belongs to the group of medicines called Penicillin Antibiotics. It is used to manage respiratory tract infections like bronchopneumonia, acute exacerbations of chronic bronchitis, post-operative wound infections, postoperative pulmonary infections, puerperal fever and other infections such as septicaemia, pelvic infections, urinary tract infections, skin and soft tissue infections, and gastrointestinal infections, bone infections like Ex. osteomyelitis, ear, nose and throat infections.

Before taking MEGAPEN 500MG CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have liver or kidney disease. MEGAPEN 500MG CAPSULE is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless clearly necessary. Contact your doctor before taking it.

MEGAPEN 500MG CAPSULE is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Contact your doctor before taking.

MEGAPEN 500MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in neonates with jaundice and should be used with caution in children. Contact your doctor before taking.

MEGAPEN 500MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years). Contact your doctor before taking.

The most common side effects of this medicine are nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, stomach pain or stomach upset and skin rash. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

How MEGAPEN 500MG CAPSULE Works

MEGAPEN 500MG CAPSULE is a combination of Ampicillin and cloxacillin where ampicillin (has a broad spectrum of bactericidal activity against many gram-positive and gram-negative aerobic and anaerobic bacteria. It acts through the inhibition of cell wall mucopeptide biosynthesis during the stage of active multiplication.) Cloxacillin manages bacteria from reproducing, which allows your body to fight only the existing bacteria.

SULBACIN TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with rare hereditary problems such as galactose intolerance, the Lapp-lactase deficiency or glucose-galactose malabsorption. Contact your doctor before taking.

Before taking SULBACIN TABLET inform your doctor if you have liver or kidney disease. SULBACIN TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless clearly necessary. Contact your doctor before taking.

SULBACIN TABLET is generally not recommended for use in breast feeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Contact your doctor before taking.

SULBACIN TABLET should be used with caution in children. Contact our doctor before taking.

introduction:
Introduction About SENSICLAV BD 228.5MG DRY SYRUP

SENSICLAV BD 228.5MG DRY SYRUP is used to manage bacterial infections such as middle ear and sinus infections, respiratory tract infections, genital tract infections, urinary tract infections, skin and soft tissue infections such as dental infections, bone and joint infections, septic abortion (any abortion complicated by uterine infection), and abdominal infections. The symptoms of a bacterial infection may include fever, difficulty breathing, pus formation, and pain.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It works by preventing the growth of bacteria and helps clear up the infection.

Do not take SENSICLAV BD 228.5MG DRY SYRUP if you have a history of hypersensitivity to beta-lactams, including penicillin and cephalosporins, or any other ingredients of this medicine. It is not recommended for use if you have a history of amoxicillin-clavulanate-associated jaundice or hepatic dysfunction.

Before taking SENSICLAV BD 228.5MG DRY SYRUP, inform your doctor if you are suffering from hepatic or renal impairment. This medicine should be used with caution in pregnant women and only when necessary.

In breastfeeding women, it should be used with caution. SENSICLAV BD 228.5MG DRY SYRUP should be used with caution in children (aged below 12 years) and elderly patients (above 50 years).

The common side effects associated with the use of SENSICLAV BD 228.5MG DRY SYRUP are diarrhea, thrush (a fungal infection in the vagina, skin folds, or mouth), nausea, and vomiting. Contact your doctor immediately if any of the symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About NOVACLOX NF CAPSULE

NOVACLOX NF CAPSULE contains a combination of Amoxicillin and Cloxacillin, which belongs to the group of medicines called semi-synthetic penicillin antibiotics. NOVACLOX NF CAPSULE is used to manage infectious conditions caused by various types of bacteria such as lung infection (Bronchopneumonia, bronchitis etc.), infection in the blood (septicaemia), urinary tract infection, bone infection, wound infection and following a surgery etc. The symptoms of bacterial infection include fever, tiredness, headache, stomach pain, feeling sick or vomiting sensation etc.

Amoxicillin and Cloxacillin work by killing and managing the growth of bacteria by blocking the production of the bacterial cell wall. Before recommending NOVACLOX NF CAPSULE, your doctor may want you to take relevant blood tests to understand your existing condition.

Before taking NOVACLOX NF CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have or ever had kidney disease (such as difficulty in passing urine, kidney failure, kidney injury etc.), liver disease, viral or fungal infection, malnutrition, suppressed immune system, bone marrow disorder, fits or seizure disorder, frequent diarrhoea etc. NOVACLOX NF CAPSULE should be used with caution among women who are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking NOVACLOX NF CAPSULE are sickness, vomiting, skin rashes, itching, loose stools (diarrhoea), stomach upset or discomfort etc. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About MOXCLAV BD 228.5MG ORAL SUSPENSION

MOXCLAV BD 228.5MG ORAL SUSPENSION is used to manage bacterial infections such as middle ear and sinus infections, respiratory tract infections, genital tract infections, urinary tract infections, skin and soft tissue infections such as dental infections, bone and joint infections, septic abortion (any abortion complicated by uterine infection), and abdominal infections. The symptoms of a bacterial infection may include fever, difficulty breathing, pus formation, and pain.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It works by preventing the growth of bacteria and helps clear up the infection.

Do not take MOXCLAV BD 228.5MG ORAL SUSPENSION if you have a history of hypersensitivity to beta-lactams, including penicillin and cephalosporins, or any other ingredients of this medicine. It is not recommended for use if you have a history of amoxicillin-clavulanate-associated jaundice or hepatic dysfunction.

Before taking MOXCLAV BD 228.5MG ORAL SUSPENSION, inform your doctor if you are suffering from hepatic or renal impairment. This medicine should be used with caution in pregnant women and only when necessary.

In breastfeeding women, it should be used with caution. MOXCLAV BD 228.5MG ORAL SUSPENSION should be used with caution in children (aged below 12 years) and elderly patients (above 50 years).

The common side effects associated with the use of MOXCLAV BD 228.5MG ORAL SUSPENSION are diarrhea, thrush (a fungal infection in the vagina, skin folds, or mouth), nausea, and vomiting. Contact your doctor immediately if any of the symptoms worsen.

CIPMOX 500MG CAPSULE is an antibiotic medicine used in the management of various bacterial infections such as respiratory tract infections, ear, nose, throat infections, stomach infections (H. Pylori infection), skin infections and urinary tract infections. It contains a medicine called amoxycillin which is a powerful antibacterial agent that eradicates the susceptible microorganism that causes the infection.

Take CIPMOX 500MG CAPSULE as advised by the physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Do not skip doses or stop therapy with CIPMOX 500MG CAPSULE without consulting your doctor, as it will make this medicine less effective against the bacteria which causes infection.

Therefore, make sure to complete the duration of therapy as suggested by your doctor for fast recovery. Do not take CIPMOX 500MG CAPSULE if you are allergic to Amoxycillin. Before taking CIPMOX 500MG CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, glandular fever, urinary problems, etc. Consult your doctor before taking CIPMOX 500MG CAPSULE if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking CIPMOX 500MG CAPSULE are nausea, diarrhea and skin rashes. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How CIPMOX 500MG CAPSULE Works

CIPMOX 500MG CAPSULE contains a medicine called Amoxicillin which is a type of antibiotic that belongs to the penicillin group. It works by inhibiting the synthesis of bacterial cell walls. Bacteria have a protective outer layer called the cell wall, which is essential for their survival. Amoxicillin interferes with the enzymes that are responsible for forming the cell wall, specifically targeting the cross-linking process. This weakens the cell wall, causing it to rupture and ultimately leading to the death of the bacteria. This action makes amoxicillin effective against a wide range of bacterial infections.

PENCLAV 200MG SYRUP is used to manage bacterial infections such as middle ear and sinus infections, respiratory tract infections, genital tract infections, urinary tract infections, skin and soft tissue infections such as dental infections, bone and joint infections, septic abortion (any abortion complicated by uterine infection), and abdominal infections. In breastfeeding women, it should be used with caution. PENCLAV 200MG SYRUP should be used with caution in children (aged below 12 years) and elderly patients (above 50 years).

Take EVOXIL 500MG CAPSULE as advised by the physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Do not skip doses or stop therapy with EVOXIL 500MG CAPSULE without consulting your doctor, as it will make this medicine less effective against the bacteria which causes infection.

Therefore, make sure to complete the duration of therapy as suggested by your doctor for fast recovery. Do not take EVOXIL 500MG CAPSULE if you are allergic to Amoxycillin. Before taking EVOXIL 500MG CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, glandular fever, urinary problems, etc. Consult your doctor before taking EVOXIL 500MG CAPSULE if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking EVOXIL 500MG CAPSULE are nausea, diarrhea and skin rashes. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How EVOXIL 500MG CAPSULE Works

EVOXIL 500MG CAPSULE contains a medicine called Amoxicillin which is a type of antibiotic that belongs to the penicillin group. It works by inhibiting the synthesis of bacterial cell walls. Bacteria have a protective outer layer called the cell wall, which is essential for their survival. Amoxicillin interferes with the enzymes that are responsible for forming the cell wall, specifically targeting the cross-linking process. This weakens the cell wall, causing it to rupture and ultimately leading to the death of the bacteria. This action makes amoxicillin effective against a wide range of bacterial infections.

introduction:
Introduction About ROSCILLIN 500MG CAPSULE

ROSCILLIN 500MG CAPSULE contains Ampicillin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage bacterial infections of the ears, nose, throat, respiratory tract (bronchus, lungs), urinary tract, genital tract, stomach, blood, brain or skin and soft tissues.

It can also be used to manage typhoid fever, meningitis (inflammation of the lining of the brain), peritonitis (inflammation of the lining of the stomach) and endocarditis (inflammation of the lining of the heart and its valves).

ROSCILLIN 500MG CAPSULE should be taken on an empty stomach. It is important to take ROSCILLIN 500MG CAPSULE for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor to achieve better results even if you feel better during the midway of the therapy. Failing to complete the full course of the therapy or skipping doses in between the therapy may not result in adequate infection control.

During therapy with ROSCILLIN 500MG CAPSULE, your doctor will periodically monitor your health condition through several blood tests/urine tests to access the improvement in your condition and to reduce the risk of unwanted side effects. ROSCILLIN 500MG CAPSULE is suitable for use in adults and in children (aged 10 years or older; weighing 20 kg or more).

Before taking ROSCILLIN 500MG CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have diabetes or any kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have blood cancer or any viral infections (such as cytomegalovirus infection) as a precaution.

ROSCILLIN 500MG CAPSULE should be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women only if considered necessary by the physician. The most common side effects of taking ROSCILLIN 500MG CAPSULE are nausea, vomiting and diarrhea. Inform your doctor if they trouble you.

Introduction About ACUCLAV 625MG TABLET

ACUCLAV 625MG TABLET is used to manage bacterial infections, including middle ear and sinus infections, respiratory tract infections, genital tract infections, urinary tract infections, skin and soft tissue infections such as dental infections, bone and joint infections, septic abortion, and abdominal infections. The symptoms of bacterial infection include fever, difficulty breathing, pus formation, and pain.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belong to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It works by preventing the growth of bacteria and helps clear up the infection.

ACUCLAV 625MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have liver problems or jaundice upon taking an antibiotic or amoxicillin-clavulanate. Before taking this medicine, inform your doctor if you are suffering from a hepatic impairment, liver disease, renal impairment, kidney disease, glandular fever, or are unable to pass water properly.

ACUCLAV 625MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary. It should be used with caution in children (aged below 12 years) and elderly patients (above 50 years).

The common side effects associated with the use of ACUCLAV 625MG TABLET are diarrhea, thrush (fungal infection in the vagina, skin folds, or mouth), nausea, and vomiting. Contact your doctor immediately if any of the symptoms worsen.

Introduction About RAPICLAV 625MG TABLET

RAPICLAV 625MG TABLET is used to manage bacterial infections, including middle ear and sinus infections, respiratory tract infections, genital tract infections, urinary tract infections, skin and soft tissue infections such as dental infections, bone and joint infections, septic abortion, and abdominal infections. The symptoms of bacterial infection include fever, difficulty breathing, pus formation, and pain.

RAPICLAV 625MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have liver problems or jaundice upon taking an antibiotic or amoxicillin-clavulanate. Before taking this medicine, inform your doctor if you are suffering from a hepatic impairment, liver disease, renal impairment, kidney disease, glandular fever, or are unable to pass water properly.

RAPICLAV 625MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary. It should be used with caution in children (aged below 12 years) and elderly patients (above 50 years).

The common side effects associated with the use of RAPICLAV 625MG TABLET are diarrhea, thrush (fungal infection in the vagina, skin folds, or mouth), nausea, and vomiting. Contact your doctor immediately if any of the symptoms worsen.

Manage bacterial infection
mechanismOfAction:

introduction:
Introduction About ROSCILLIN 250MG CAPSULE

ROSCILLIN 250MG CAPSULE contains Ampicillin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage bacterial infections of the ears, nose, throat, respiratory tract (bronchus, lungs), urinary tract, genital tract, stomach, blood, brain or skin and soft tissues.

It can also be used to manage typhoid fever, meningitis (inflammation of the lining of the brain), peritonitis (inflammation of the lining of the stomach) and endocarditis (inflammation of the lining of the heart and its valves).

ROSCILLIN 250MG CAPSULE should be taken on an empty stomach. It is important to take ROSCILLIN 250MG CAPSULE for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor to achieve better results even if you feel better during the midway of the therapy. Failing to complete the full course of the therapy or skipping doses in between the therapy may not result in adequate infection control.

During therapy with ROSCILLIN 250MG CAPSULE, your doctor will periodically monitor your health condition through several blood tests/urine tests to access the improvement in your condition and to reduce the risk of unwanted side effects. ROSCILLIN 250MG CAPSULE is suitable for use in adults and in children (aged 10 years or older; weighing 20 kg or more).

Before taking ROSCILLIN 250MG CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have diabetes or any kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have blood cancer or any viral infections (such as cytomegalovirus infection) as a precaution.

ROSCILLIN 250MG CAPSULE should be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women only if considered necessary by the physician. The most common side effects of taking ROSCILLIN 250MG CAPSULE are nausea, vomiting and diarrhea. Inform your doctor if they trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How ROSCILLIN 250MG CAPSULE Works

ROSCILLIN 250MG CAPSULE is a bactericidal agent. It kills the susceptible bacteria by blocking the bacterial cell wall synthesis that is essential for the bacterial cell to survive. This action destroys the susceptible bacteria, manage their further growth and multiplication and reduce the severity of the infection.
usageDetails:
How to use ROSCILLIN 250MG CAPSULE

Take ROSCILLIN 250MG CAPSULE on an empty stomach or at least 30 minutes to 1 hour before meals or as advised by your physician.

For Tablet, Capsule: Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse the medicine in the specified quantity of water as mentioned in the label. Consume the medicine immediately after reconstitution.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of the infection.

It is important to take the full course of ROSCILLIN 250MG CAPSULE without any interruption. Therefore, do not miss a dose or stop taking ROSCILLIN 250MG CAPSULE without consulting your doctor as it may lead to growth of harmful bacteria within the body which cannot be further controlled by ROSCILLIN 250MG CAPSULE.

name: Oxipod 100mg Suspension 30ml
introduction:
Introduction About OXIPOD 100MG SUSPENSION

OXIPOD 100MG SUSPENSION is used to manage a variety of bacterial infections in children, such as acute otitis media (inflammation of the middle ear leading to pain and fever), pharyngitis or tonsillitis (sore throat, difficulty swallowing, and tender lymph nodes), and sinusitis (inflammation around the nasal cavity leading to headache and runny nose).

It is also used to manage bronchitis (inflammation of tubes that carry air, leading to difficulty breathing), infection of the urinary tract (cystitis), pneumonia (an infection that inflames the air sacs in one or both lungs), and gonococcal infection (a sexually transmitted disease by indirect contact with an infected parent). 

It contains a medicine called Cefpodoxime, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It works by stopping the growth of the bacteria that causes the infections.

Before giving OXIPOD 100MG SUSPENSION to your child, inform your child’s doctor if your child has or has ever had colitis, liver problems, or impaired kidney function. Your child’s doctor may monitor the blood count and liver enzymes in blood tests during management with this medicine.

OXIPOD 100MG SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in pregnant or breast-feeding women and elderly individuals, as it is used only in children. It is not recommended for use in infants less than 2 months of age.

The most common side effects of taking OXIPOD 100MG SUSPENSION are diarrhea, nausea, abdominal pain, and headache. Consult your child’s doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

Manages bacterial infections in children such as:

introduction:
Introduction About CLAMP KID FORTE SUSPENSION

CLAMP KID FORTE SUSPENSION is used to manage bacterial infections such as middle ear and sinus infections, respiratory tract infections, genital tract infections, urinary tract infections, skin and soft tissue infections such as dental infections, bone and joint infections, septic abortion (any abortion complicated by uterine infection), and abdominal infections. The symptoms of a bacterial infection may include fever, difficulty breathing, pus formation, and pain.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It works by preventing the growth of bacteria and helps clear up the infection.

Do not take CLAMP KID FORTE SUSPENSION if you have a history of hypersensitivity to beta-lactams, including penicillin and cephalosporins, or any other ingredients of this medicine. It is not recommended for use if you have a history of amoxicillin-clavulanate-associated jaundice or hepatic dysfunction.

Before taking CLAMP KID FORTE SUSPENSION, inform your doctor if you are suffering from hepatic or renal impairment. This medicine should be used with caution in pregnant women and only when necessary.

In breastfeeding women, it should be used with caution. CLAMP KID FORTE SUSPENSION should be used with caution in children (aged below 12 years) and elderly patients (above 50 years).

The common side effects associated with the use of CLAMP KID FORTE SUSPENSION are diarrhea, thrush (a fungal infection in the vagina, skin folds, or mouth), nausea, and vomiting. Contact your doctor immediately if any of the symptoms worsen.

Introduction About FIGHTOX 625MG TABLET

FIGHTOX 625MG TABLET is used to manage bacterial infections, including middle ear and sinus infections, respiratory tract infections, genital tract infections, urinary tract infections, skin and soft tissue infections such as dental infections, bone and joint infections, septic abortion, and abdominal infections. The symptoms of bacterial infection include fever, difficulty breathing, pus formation, and pain.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belong to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It works by preventing the growth of bacteria and helps clear up the infection.

FIGHTOX 625MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have liver problems or jaundice upon taking an antibiotic or amoxicillin-clavulanate. The common side effects associated with the use of FIGHTOX 625MG TABLET are diarrhea, thrush (fungal infection in the vagina, skin folds, or mouth), nausea, and vomiting. Contact your doctor immediately if any of the symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About ROSCILLIN 500MG INJECTION

ROSCILLIN 500MG INJECTION contains Ampicillin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage bacterial infections of the ear, nose, throat, respiratory tract (bronchus, lungs), urinary tract, genital tract, stomach, blood, brain and skin or soft tissues.

It can also be used to manage typhoid fever, meningitis (inflammation of the lining of the brain), peritonitis (inflammation of the lining of the stomach) and endocarditis (inflammation of the lining of the heart and its valves).

ROSCILLIN 500MG INJECTION should be used under medical supervision. Do not stop receiving ROSCILLIN 500MG INJECTION even if you feel better during the midway of the therapy. Failing to complete the full course of the therapy or skipping doses in between the therapy may not result in adequate infection control.

During therapy with ROSCILLIN 500MG INJECTION, your doctor will periodically monitor your health condition through several blood tests/urine tests to access the improvement in your condition and to reduce the risk of unwanted side effects. ROSCILLIN 500MG INJECTION is suitable for use in adults and in children (aged 10 years or older; weighing 20 kg or more).

Before receiving ROSCILLIN 500MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you have any kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have blood cancer or any viral infections (such as cytomegalovirus infection) as a precaution.

ROSCILLIN 500MG INJECTION should be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women only if considered necessary by the physician. The most common side effects of receiving ROSCILLIN 500MG INJECTION are nausea, vomiting and diarrhea. Inform your doctor if they trouble you.

introduction:
Introduction About WYMOX 500MG CAPSULE

WYMOX 500MG CAPSULE is an antibiotic medicine used in the management of various bacterial infections such as respiratory tract infections, ear, nose, throat infections, stomach infections (H. Pylori infection), skin infections and urinary tract infections. It contains a medicine called amoxycillin which is a powerful antibacterial agent that eradicates the susceptible microorganism that causes the infection.

Take WYMOX 500MG CAPSULE as advised by the physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Do not skip doses or stop therapy with WYMOX 500MG CAPSULE without consulting your doctor, as it will make this medicine less effective against the bacteria which causes infection.

Therefore, make sure to complete the duration of therapy as suggested by your doctor for fast recovery. Do not take WYMOX 500MG CAPSULE if you are allergic to Amoxycillin. Before taking WYMOX 500MG CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, glandular fever, urinary problems, etc. Consult your doctor before taking WYMOX 500MG CAPSULE if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking WYMOX 500MG CAPSULE are nausea, diarrhea and skin rashes. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.
usesDetails:

Management of bacterial infections such as:

Respiratory tract infections
Ear, nose, throat infections
Stomach infections (H. Pylori infection)
Skin infections
Urinary tract infections
mechanismOfAction:
How WYMOX 500MG CAPSULE Works

WYMOX 500MG CAPSULE contains a medicine called Amoxicillin which is a type of antibiotic that belongs to the penicillin group. It works by inhibiting the synthesis of bacterial cell walls. Bacteria have a protective outer layer called the cell wall, which is essential for their survival. Amoxicillin interferes with the enzymes that are responsible for forming the cell wall, specifically targeting the cross-linking process. This weakens the cell wall, causing it to rupture and ultimately leading to the death of the bacteria. This action makes amoxicillin effective against a wide range of bacterial infections.

introduction:
Introduction About PENCLAV 625MG TABLET

PENCLAV 625MG TABLET is used to manage bacterial infections, including middle ear and sinus infections, respiratory tract infections, genital tract infections, urinary tract infections, skin and soft tissue infections such as dental infections, bone and joint infections, septic abortion, and abdominal infections. The symptoms of bacterial infection include fever, difficulty breathing, pus formation, and pain.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belong to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It works by preventing the growth of bacteria and helps clear up the infection.

PENCLAV 625MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have liver problems or jaundice upon taking an antibiotic or amoxicillin-clavulanate. Before taking this medicine, inform your doctor if you are suffering from a hepatic impairment, liver disease, renal impairment, kidney disease, glandular fever, or are unable to pass water properly.

PENCLAV 625MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary. It should be used with caution in children (aged below 12 years) and elderly patients (above 50 years).

The common side effects associated with the use of PENCLAV 625MG TABLET are diarrhea, thrush (fungal infection in the vagina, skin folds, or mouth), nausea, and vomiting. Contact your doctor immediately if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:

Manage bacterial infection
mechanismOfAction:
How PENCLAV 625MG TABLET Works

PENCLAV 625MG TABLET helps in managing bacterial infection where amoxicillin is a penicillin that works by inhibiting the enzymes that help in the synthesis of the integral structural component of the bacterial cell wall whereas clavulanic acid is a beta-lactam (structurally related to penicillin) that works by inactivating an enzyme, namely beta-lactamase, thereby managing the inactivation of amoxicillin.

introduction:
Introduction About CLAMP DROPS

CLAMP DROPS is used in infants for the management of various bacterial infections such as respiratory tract infections, urinary tract infections, bone and joint infections, middle ear infections (otitis media), tonsillitis, sinusitis, skin, and soft tissue infections such as cellulitis, animal bites, etc.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belong to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It works by preventing the growth of the bacteria, thus clearing up the infection.

CLAMP DROPS is not recommended for children with a history of severe kidney impairment, history of liver problems, or jaundice after taking penicillin antibiotics. It should be used with caution in children suffering from glandular fever (viral infection causing sore throat, high fever, swelling of salivary glands), liver disease, or kidney disease who are not passing urine daily.

CLAMP DROPS is for pediatric use only. It should be used with caution in neonates and infants less than 12 weeks of age. The most common side effects after giving CLAMP DROPS are vomiting, diarrhea, nausea, and thrush (fungal infections). Consult your doctor immediately if your child experiences any of the above side effects.
uses: Used to manage bacterial infections in children
usesDetails:

Used to manage bacterial infections in children
mechanismOfAction:
How CLAMP DROPS Works

CLAMP DROPS work against bacterial infections. Amoxicillin in Clavam stops bacteria from making their cell walls, causing them to break apart and die. Clavulanic acid in Clavam stops bacteria from destroying amoxicillin, making it more effective at killing bacteria. So together, they help kill bacteria and manage infections.

introduction:
Introduction About WYMOX DRY SYRUP

WYMOX DRY SYRUP is an antibiotic medicine used in the management of various bacterial infections such as respiratory tract infections, ear, nose, throat infections, stomach infections (H. Pylori infection), skin infections and urinary tract infections, especially in children. It contains a medicine called amoxycillin which is a powerful antibacterial agent that eradicates the susceptible microorganism that causes the infection.

Do not take WYMOX DRY SYRUP if you are allergic to Amoxycillin. Before taking WYMOX DRY SYRUP inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, glandular fever, urinary problems, etc. Consult your doctor before taking WYMOX DRY SYRUP if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking WYMOX DRY SYRUP are nausea, diarrhea and skin rashes. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.
usesDetails:

Management of bacterial infections such as:

Respiratory tract infections
Ear, nose, throat infections
Stomach infections (H. Pylori infection)
Skin infections
Urinary tract infections
mechanismOfAction:
How WYMOX DRY SYRUP Works

WYMOX DRY SYRUP contains a medicine called Amoxicillin which is a type of antibiotic that belongs to the penicillin group. It works by inhibiting the synthesis of bacterial cell walls. Bacteria have a protective outer layer called the cell wall, which is essential for their survival. Amoxicillin interferes with the enzymes that are responsible for forming the cell wall, specifically targeting the cross-linking process. This weakens the cell wall, causing it to rupture and ultimately leading to the death of the bacteria. This action makes amoxicillin effective against a wide range of bacterial infections.

How to use WYMOX DRY SYRUP

Take WYMOX DRY SYRUP as advised by the physician.

For Dry Syrup: Shake the medicine powder for dispersing the powder. Add the sterile water provided along with the package into the dry powder and shake it vigorously for 10-15 mins. Measure the required amount of the medicine in the measuring cup and drink it. Store the reconstituted mixture in refrigerator

For Syrups and Suspension: Shake the medicine well before use. Measure the required quantity of the medicine in the measuring cup provided with the package and drink it immediately.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of the therapy based on your age, body weight and severity of infection.

introduction:
Introduction About NOVAMOX REDIUSE DROPS

NOVAMOX REDIUSE DROPS contains Amoxycillin which belongs to the group of medicines called Penicillin. NOVAMOX REDIUSE DROPS is used to manage bacterial infections in pediatric patients caused by susceptible strains of gram-positive and gram-negative bacteria that affect different parts of the body.

It is also used in combination with other medicines in pediatric patients to manage stomach ulcers.

NOVAMOX REDIUSE DROPS is not recommended for use in children allergic to amoxicillin, penicillin, and/or other antibiotics.

Before administering NOVAMOX REDIUSE DROPS, inform your doctor if the child has glandular fever (viral infection caused by Epstein Barr Virus), is unable to urinate regularly, has kidney problems, and/or liver problems (such as hepatic impairment).

NOVAMOX REDIUSE DROPS is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women since it is used only in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). It is also not recommended for use in elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking NOVAMOX REDIUSE DROPS are skin rash, nausea and diarrhoea. Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.

Before taking AMPOXIN 250MG CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have liver or kidney disease. AMPOXIN 250MG CAPSULE is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless clearly necessary. Contact your doctor before taking it.

AMPOXIN 250MG CAPSULE is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Contact your doctor before taking.

AMPOXIN 250MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in neonates with jaundice and should be used with caution in children. Contact your doctor before taking.

AMPOXIN 250MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years). Contact your doctor before taking.

introduction:
Introduction About AUGMENTIN DDS ORAL SUSPENSION

AUGMENTIN DDS ORAL SUSPENSION is used to manage bacterial infections such as middle ear and sinus infections, respiratory tract infections, genital tract infections, urinary tract infections, skin and soft tissue infections such as dental infections, bone and joint infections, septic abortion (any abortion complicated by uterine infection), and abdominal infections. The symptoms of a bacterial infection may include fever, difficulty breathing, pus formation, and pain.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It works by preventing the growth of bacteria and helps clear up the infection.

Do not take AUGMENTIN DDS ORAL SUSPENSION if you have a history of hypersensitivity to beta-lactams, including penicillin and cephalosporins, or any other ingredients of this medicine. It is not recommended for use if you have a history of amoxicillin-clavulanate-associated jaundice or hepatic dysfunction.

Before taking AUGMENTIN DDS ORAL SUSPENSION, inform your doctor if you are suffering from hepatic or renal impairment. This medicine should be used with caution in pregnant women and only when necessary.

In breastfeeding women, it should be used with caution. AUGMENTIN DDS ORAL SUSPENSION should be used with caution in children (aged below 12 years) and elderly patients (above 50 years).

The common side effects associated with the use of AUGMENTIN DDS ORAL SUSPENSION are diarrhea, thrush (a fungal infection in the vagina, skin folds, or mouth), nausea, and vomiting. Contact your doctor immediately if any of the symptoms worsen.

SENSICLAV DS 457MG DRY SYRUP helps in managing bacterial infection where amoxicillin is a penicillin that works by inhibiting the enzymes that help in the synthesis of an integral structural component of the bacterial cell wall whereas clavulanic acid is a beta-lactam (structurally related to penicillin) that works by inactivating an enzyme, namely beta-lactamase, thereby managing the inactivation of amoxicillin.

introduction:
Introduction About PENIDURE LA 12LAC INJECTION

PENIDURE LA 12LAC INJECTION contains Benzathine penicillin which belong to the group of medicine called Antibiotics. It is used in adults, children and neonates for the management of wide range of bacterial infections such as erysipelas (infection of upper layer of the skin), syphilis (bacterial infection usually spread by sexual contact), tropical infectious skin diseases, such as yaws or pinta.

It is also used to manage rheumatic fever (disease that affect heart, brain, joints and skin) and post streptococcal glomerulonephritis (a specific form of kidney inflammation) and erysipelas (skin infection).

PENIDURE LA 12LAC INJECTION is not recommended for use if you have ever had an allergic reaction (skin rash or swelling of the face or neck) to any antibiotic. Consult your doctor before receiving it.

PENIDURE LA 12LAC INJECTION should be used with caution in patients suffering from lung problems such as allergic asthma, allergy, hay fever, kidney, liver problems. Consult your doctor before receiving it.

PENIDURE LA 12LAC INJECTION should be used during pregnancy only if clearly necessary. It should be used with caution in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before receiving it.

PENIDURE LA 12LAC INJECTION should be used with caution in children and in elderly patients. The most common side effect of receiving this medicine is fungal infection (candidiasis), diarrhea, nausea. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About BACTOMIN 750MG TABLET

BACTOMIN 750MG TABLET contains Sultamicillin which belongs to the group of medicines called Penicillins. BACTOMIN 750MG TABLET is used to manage upper respiratory tract infections (such as sinusitis, otitis media, tonsillitis), lower respiratory tract infections (such as bacterial pneumonias, bronchitis), urinary tract infections, pyelonephritis (inflammation of kidney), skin & soft tissue infections, and gonococcal infections (sexually transmitted disease) in affected individuals.

BACTOMIN 750MG TABLET is also indicated in patients who require sulbactam/ampicillin therapy (antibacterial therapy) following initial therapy with intramuscular/intravenous sulbactam/ampicillin medicine. BACTOMIN 750MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Sultamicillin. It is also not recommended for use in patients with infectious mononucleosis (a viral infection), galactose intolerance, Lapp-lactase deficiency, and/or glucose-galactose malabsorption (rare hereditary problems).

Before taking BACTOMIN 750MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you had previously suffered from hypersensitivity reactions (to penicillins, cephalosporins, carbapenems, and/or other beta-lactam antibiotic agents), and/or have kidney problems (such as severe renal impairment), and/or liver problems (such as liver dysfunction).

BACTOMIN 750MG TABLET should be used with caution during pregnancy only if it is clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through breast milk.

BACTOMIN 750MG TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) which is also advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years/above) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking BACTOMIN 750MG TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, stomach pain, itching, and/or rashes. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

BACTOMIN 750MG TABLET works by inhibiting penicillin binding proteins (responsible for bacterial cell wall formation) which leads to activation of autolytic enzymes in the bacterial cell wall resulting in its destruction thus managing the spread of infection in affected individuals.

name: Microcef 100mg Suspension 30ml
introduction:
Introduction About MICROCEF 100MG SUSPENSION

MICROCEF 100MG SUSPENSION is used to manage a variety of bacterial infections in children, such as acute otitis media (inflammation of the middle ear leading to pain and fever), pharyngitis or tonsillitis (sore throat, difficulty swallowing, and tender lymph nodes), and sinusitis (inflammation around the nasal cavity leading to headache and runny nose).

It is also used to manage bronchitis (inflammation of tubes that carry air, leading to difficulty breathing), infection of the urinary tract (cystitis), pneumonia (an infection that inflames the air sacs in one or both lungs), and gonococcal infection (a sexually transmitted disease by indirect contact with an infected parent). 

It contains a medicine called Cefpodoxime, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It works by stopping the growth of the bacteria that causes the infections.

Before giving MICROCEF 100MG SUSPENSION to your child, inform your child’s doctor if your child has or has ever had colitis, liver problems, or impaired kidney function. Your child’s doctor may monitor the blood count and liver enzymes in blood tests during management with this medicine.

MICROCEF 100MG SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in pregnant or breast-feeding women and elderly individuals, as it is used only in children. It is not recommended for use in infants less than 2 months of age.

The most common side effects of taking MICROCEF 100MG SUSPENSION are diarrhea, nausea, abdominal pain, and headache. Consult your child’s doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of MICROCEF 100MG SUSPENSION

Manages bacterial infections in children such as:

Acute exacerbations of chronic bronchitis
Acute otitis media
Cystitis (uncomplicated urinary tract infection)
Gonococcal infection
Pneumonia
Sinusitis 
Pharyngitis/tonsillitis
mechanismOfAction:
How MICROCEF 100MG SUSPENSION Works

MICROCEF 100MG SUSPENSION manages infection by stopping or managing the bacteria from multiplying by inhibiting their cell wall formation, which is essential for the bacteria to survive as it provides protection from the environment. This kind of action that kills bacteria is useful in managing various bacterial infections.

Use a medicine dropper to properly measure the dose.

introduction:
Introduction About EVOXIL DT 250 TABLET

EVOXIL DT 250 TABLET contains Amoxicillin which belongs to the group of medicines called Penicillins. It is used to manage wide range of infections caused by gram positive and gram-negative bacteria which includes respiratory infection (such as otitis media), sinus infection, gynaecological infection, urinary tract infection and other serious infections (such as septicaemia).

EVOXIL DT 250 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients suffering from mononucleosis (glandular fever caused by Epstein Barr Virus) and/or certain infections (especially urinary tract infection, a severe infection of ear/nose/throat) caused by the non-susceptible pathogen.

Before taking EVOXIL DT 250 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have a history of seizures/fits, meningeal disorders, diarrhoea, kidney problems (such as renal impairment) and/or liver problems (such as hepatic impairment).

EVOXIL DT 250 TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if it is clearly necessary. EVOXIL DT 250 TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents (from 6 months to 18 years of age) and elderly patients (aged above 65 years). Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.

The most common side effects of taking EVOXIL DT 250 TABLET are skin rash, nausea and diarrhoea. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How EVOXIL DT 250 TABLET Works

EVOXIL DT 250 TABLET works by inhibiting penicillin-binding proteins that are responsible for bacterial cell wall formation. This leads to the activation of autolytic enzymes in the bacterial cell wall which causes its destruction thus managing the spread of infection in affected individuals.

Take EVOXIL DT 250 TABLET as advised by your physician. Disperse EVOXIL DT 250 TABLET in the specified quantity of water as mentioned on the label. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution. Your doctor will recommend the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About RECONTREX TABLET

RECONTREX TABLET contains Sultamicillin which belongs to the group of medicines called Penicillins. RECONTREX TABLET is used to manage upper respiratory tract infections (such as sinusitis, otitis media, tonsillitis), lower respiratory tract infections (such as bacterial pneumonias, bronchitis), urinary tract infections, pyelonephritis (inflammation of kidney), skin & soft tissue infections, and gonococcal infections (sexually transmitted disease) in affected individuals.

RECONTREX TABLET is also indicated in patients who require sulbactam/ampicillin therapy (antibacterial therapy) following initial therapy with intramuscular/intravenous sulbactam/ampicillin medicine. RECONTREX TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Sultamicillin. It is also not recommended for use in patients with infectious mononucleosis (a viral infection), galactose intolerance, Lapp-lactase deficiency, and/or glucose-galactose malabsorption (rare hereditary problems).

Before taking RECONTREX TABLET, inform your doctor if you had previously suffered from hypersensitivity reactions (to penicillins, cephalosporins, carbapenems, and/or other beta-lactam antibiotic agents), and/or have kidney problems (such as severe renal impairment), and/or liver problems (such as liver dysfunction).

RECONTREX TABLET should be used with caution during pregnancy only if it is clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through breast milk.

RECONTREX TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) which is also advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years/above) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking RECONTREX TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, stomach pain, itching, and/or rashes. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

introduction:
Introduction About EVOXIL CV DRY SYRUP

EVOXIL CV DRY SYRUP is used to manage bacterial infections such as middle ear and sinus infections, respiratory tract infections, genital tract infections, urinary tract infections, skin and soft tissue infections such as dental infections, bone and joint infections, septic abortion (any abortion complicated by uterine infection), and abdominal infections. The symptoms of a bacterial infection may include fever, difficulty breathing, pus formation, and pain.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It works by preventing the growth of bacteria and helps clear up the infection.

Do not take EVOXIL CV DRY SYRUP if you have a history of hypersensitivity to beta-lactams, including penicillin and cephalosporins, or any other ingredients of this medicine. It is not recommended for use if you have a history of amoxicillin-clavulanate-associated jaundice or hepatic dysfunction.

Before taking EVOXIL CV DRY SYRUP, inform your doctor if you are suffering from hepatic or renal impairment. This medicine should be used with caution in pregnant women and only when necessary.

In breastfeeding women, it should be used with caution. EVOXIL CV DRY SYRUP should be used with caution in children (aged below 12 years) and elderly patients (above 50 years).

The common side effects associated with the use of EVOXIL CV DRY SYRUP are diarrhea, thrush (a fungal infection in the vagina, skin folds, or mouth), nausea, and vomiting. Contact your doctor immediately if any of the symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About NODIMOX PLUS 500MG CAPSULE

NODIMOX PLUS 500MG CAPSULE contains a combination of Amoxicillin and Cloxacillin, which belongs to the group of medicines called semi-synthetic penicillin antibiotics. NODIMOX PLUS 500MG CAPSULE is used to manage infectious conditions caused by various types of bacteria such as lung infection (Bronchopneumonia, bronchitis etc.), infection in the blood (septicaemia), urinary tract infection, bone infection, wound infection and following a surgery etc. The symptoms of bacterial infection include fever, tiredness, headache, stomach pain, feeling sick or vomiting sensation etc.

Amoxicillin and Cloxacillin work by killing and managing the growth of bacteria by blocking the production of the bacterial cell wall. Before recommending NODIMOX PLUS 500MG CAPSULE, your doctor may want you to take relevant blood tests to understand your existing condition.

Before taking NODIMOX PLUS 500MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have or ever had kidney disease (such as difficulty in passing urine, kidney failure, kidney injury etc.), liver disease, viral or fungal infection, malnutrition, suppressed immune system, bone marrow disorder, fits or seizure disorder, frequent diarrhoea etc. NODIMOX PLUS 500MG CAPSULE should be used with caution among women who are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking NODIMOX PLUS 500MG CAPSULE are sickness, vomiting, skin rashes, itching, loose stools (diarrhoea), stomach upset or discomfort etc. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

Introduction About AMPOXIN 500MG INJECTION

AMPOXIN 500MG INJECTION is a combination of Ampicillin and Cloxacillin which belongs to the group of medicines called Penicillin Antibiotics. It is used to manage respiratory tract infections, bacterial meningitis, septicaemia, endocarditis, urinary tract infections, pelvic infections, skin and soft tissue infections, gastrointestinal infections, infected wounds or lung infections after surgery, puerperal fever, ear, nose and throat infections in moderately severe and severe infections and for patients who are unable to take the oral forms.

Before receiving AMPOXIN 500MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you have liver or kidney disease. AMPOXIN 500MG INJECTION should be used with caution in pregnant women. Contact your doctor before receiving.

AMPOXIN 500MG INJECTION is generally not recommended for use in breast feeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Contact your doctor before receiving.

AMPOXIN 500MG INJECTION should be used with caution in children. Contact your doctor before receiving. AMPOXIN 500MG INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years above). Contact your doctor before receiving.

The most common side effects of this medicine are nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, flatulence, stomach pain or stomach upset and mouth sores. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About AUGMENTIN DUO ORAL SUSPENSION

AUGMENTIN DUO ORAL SUSPENSION is used to manage bacterial infections such as middle ear and sinus infections, respiratory tract infections, genital tract infections, urinary tract infections, skin and soft tissue infections such as dental infections, bone and joint infections, septic abortion (any abortion complicated by uterine infection), and abdominal infections. The symptoms of a bacterial infection may include fever, difficulty breathing, pus formation, and pain.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It works by preventing the growth of bacteria and helps clear up the infection.

Do not take AUGMENTIN DUO ORAL SUSPENSION if you have a history of hypersensitivity to beta-lactams, including penicillin and cephalosporins, or any other ingredients of this medicine. It is not recommended for use if you have a history of amoxicillin-clavulanate-associated jaundice or hepatic dysfunction.

Before taking AUGMENTIN DUO ORAL SUSPENSION, inform your doctor if you are suffering from hepatic or renal impairment. This medicine should be used with caution in pregnant women and only when necessary.

In breastfeeding women, it should be used with caution. AUGMENTIN DUO ORAL SUSPENSION should be used with caution in children (aged below 12 years) and elderly patients (above 50 years).

The common side effects associated with the use of AUGMENTIN DUO ORAL SUSPENSION are diarrhea, thrush (a fungal infection in the vagina, skin folds, or mouth), nausea, and vomiting. Contact your doctor immediately if any of the symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About AMPILOX CV 625MG TABLET

AMPILOX CV 625MG TABLET is used to manage bacterial infections, including middle ear and sinus infections, respiratory tract infections, genital tract infections, urinary tract infections, skin and soft tissue infections such as dental infections, bone and joint infections, septic abortion, and abdominal infections. The symptoms of bacterial infection include fever, difficulty breathing, pus formation, and pain.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belong to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It works by preventing the growth of bacteria and helps clear up the infection.

AMPILOX CV 625MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have liver problems or jaundice upon taking an antibiotic or amoxicillin-clavulanate. Before taking this medicine, inform your doctor if you are suffering from a hepatic impairment, liver disease, renal impairment, kidney disease, glandular fever, or are unable to pass water properly.

AMPILOX CV 625MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary. It should be used with caution in children (aged below 12 years) and elderly patients (above 50 years).

The common side effects associated with the use of AMPILOX CV 625MG TABLET are diarrhea, thrush (fungal infection in the vagina, skin folds, or mouth), nausea, and vomiting. Contact your doctor immediately if any of the symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About MICROCEF CV 200MG TABLET

MICROCEF CV 200MG TABLET is a combination of Cefpodoxime and Clavulanic acid, which belongs to the group of medicines called Cephalosporins and Beta-lactamase inhibitors, respectively. MICROCEF CV 200MG TABLET is used to manage mild to moderate infections caused by susceptible strains of microorganisms in conditions such as acute otitis media (middle ear infection), pharyngitis (sore throat)/tonsillitis (inflammation of tonsils), community-acquired pneumonia, chronic bronchitis (respiratory infection), and acute maxillary sinusitis (sinus infection) in affected individuals.

MICROCEF CV 200MG TABLET is also used to manage uncomplicated skin structure infections, urethral and cervical gonorrhoea (sexually transmitted disease), anorectal (anal/rectal) infections, and urinary tract infections in affected individuals.

MICROCEF CV 200MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Cefpodoxime, Clavulanic Acid, and/or other cephalosporin groups of antibiotics. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency (lactose intolerance), and glucose-galactose malabsorption (a condition marked by the inability of the body to absorb glucose and galactose sugars).

Before taking MICROCEF CV 200MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have previous history of hypersensitivity reactions to medicines such as cefpodoxime, other cephalosporins, penicillin, and/or have kidney problems (such as mild/moderate/severe renal impairment) and liver problems (such as hepatic insufficiency/impairment).

MICROCEF CV 200MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women only if it is clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through breastmilk.

MICROCEF CV 200MG TABLET is indicated for use in children and adolescents (aged above 12 years). Consult your doctor before administering the medicine to infants (less than 2 years), as the safety and efficacy of the medicine have not been established. The medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking MICROCEF CV 200MG TABLET are diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, headache, vaginal fungal infections, and/or vulvovaginal infections. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About TAZOMAC PS INJECTION

TAZOMAC PS INJECTION is a combination of Piperacillin and Tazobactam which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage several bacterial infections such as lower respiratory tract infections such as pneumonia, acute bacterial exacerbation causing breathing difficulties, urinary tract infections, pyelonephritis, skin infections, abdominal, biliary tract infections and female pelvic infections such as postpartum endometritis or pelvic inflammatory disease, bacteraemia, and bacterial meningitis in infants and children.

It is also used along with other antibacterial agents in the management of neutropenic caused by bacterial infection.

Pneumonia is an infection which causes inflammation in the air sac producing cough with phlegm and shortness of breath. Pyelonephritis is a urinary tract infection affecting the urinary bladder later gets spreads to the kidneys. Bacteraemia is an infectious condition indicating presence of bacteria in the blood stream.

Bacterial meningitis is an infection caused by bacteria in the region surrounding the brain. Neutropenic is low levels of neutrophils (a type of white blood cells) in our body.

Kindly inform your doctor or your health-care professional before any laboratory tests as TAZOMAC PS INJECTION will interact with medical investigations. Inform your doctor if you are allergic to any antibiotics or other medicines.

TAZOMAC PS INJECTION should not be used in patients allergic to penicillin antibiotics, cephalosporin, and other beta-lactam antibiotics.

TAZOMAC PS INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with pre-existing diarrhoea, low potassium levels, kidney, and liver diseases.

Avoid concomitant use of other aminoglycoside antibiotics and vancomycin along with this medicine.

TAZOMAC PS INJECTION should be used with caution in pregnant and breast-feeding women. TAZOMAC PS INJECTION should be used with caution in children above 2 months and in elderly people. Your doctor will administer the right dose depends on your child’s age, body weight and severity of the infection.

The common side effects of TAZOMAC PS INJECTION are diarrhoea, yeast infection, headache, sleeplessness, stomach pain, vomiting, nausea, constipation, skin rash, itching, fever, and injection site reaction.

mechanismOfAction:
How TAZOMAC PS INJECTION Works

TAZOMAC PS INJECTION works by destroying the bacterial growth responsible for causing infections. Piperacillin works by interrupting the cell wall formation by binding with the enzymes responsible for cell wall synthesis. This binding causes defects in the cell wall leading to cell death causing death of the organism. Tazobactam is responsible for the irreversible termination of enzymes (beta- lactamases) that protect the organism from antibiotics and produces less anti-bacterial actions when given alone so it’s always used in combination with other antibiotics. Thus, both the substances works by managing cell growth and function inhibiting bacterial growth.

name: Advent 625mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About ADVENT 625MG TABLET

ADVENT 625MG TABLET is used to manage bacterial infections, including middle ear and sinus infections, respiratory tract infections, genital tract infections, urinary tract infections, skin and soft tissue infections such as dental infections, bone and joint infections, septic abortion, and abdominal infections. The symptoms of bacterial infection include fever, difficulty breathing, pus formation, and pain.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belong to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It works by preventing the growth of bacteria and helps clear up the infection.

ADVENT 625MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have liver problems or jaundice upon taking an antibiotic or amoxicillin-clavulanate. Before taking this medicine, inform your doctor if you are suffering from a hepatic impairment, liver disease, renal impairment, kidney disease, glandular fever, or are unable to pass water properly.

ADVENT 625MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary. It should be used with caution in children (aged below 12 years) and elderly patients (above 50 years).

The common side effects associated with the use of ADVENT 625MG TABLET are diarrhea, thrush (fungal infection in the vagina, skin folds, or mouth), nausea, and vomiting. Contact your doctor immediately if any of the symptoms worsen.

Manage bacterial infection
mechanismOfAction:
How ADVENT 625MG TABLET Works

ADVENT 625MG TABLET helps in managing bacterial infection where amoxicillin is a penicillin that works by inhibiting the enzymes that help in the synthesis of the integral structural component of the bacterial cell wall whereas clavulanic acid is a beta-lactam (structurally related to penicillin) that works by inactivating an enzyme, namely beta-lactamase, thereby managing the inactivation of amoxicillin.

name: Polyclav DS Tablet 6'S
introduction:
Introduction About POLYCLAV DS TABLET

POLYCLAV DS TABLET is used to manage bacterial infections, including middle ear and sinus infections, respiratory tract infections, genital tract infections, urinary tract infections, skin and soft tissue infections such as dental infections, bone and joint infections, septic abortion, and abdominal infections. The symptoms of bacterial infection include fever, difficulty breathing, pus formation, and pain.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belong to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It works by preventing the growth of bacteria and helps clear up the infection.

POLYCLAV DS TABLET is not recommended for use if you have liver problems or jaundice upon taking an antibiotic or amoxicillin-clavulanate. Before taking this medicine, inform your doctor if you are suffering from a hepatic impairment, liver disease, renal impairment, kidney disease, glandular fever, or are unable to pass water properly.

POLYCLAV DS TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary. It should be used with caution in children (aged below 12 years) and elderly patients (above 50 years).

The common side effects associated with the use of POLYCLAV DS TABLET are diarrhea, thrush (fungal infection in the vagina, skin folds, or mouth), nausea, and vomiting. Contact your doctor immediately if any of the symptoms worsen.

Manage bacterial infection

introduction:
Introduction About ADVENT DROPS

ADVENT DROPS is used in infants for the management of various bacterial infections such as respiratory tract infections, urinary tract infections, bone and joint infections, middle ear infections (otitis media), tonsillitis, sinusitis, skin, and soft tissue infections such as cellulitis, animal bites, etc.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belong to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It works by preventing the growth of the bacteria, thus clearing up the infection.

ADVENT DROPS is not recommended for children with a history of severe kidney impairment, history of liver problems, or jaundice after taking penicillin antibiotics. It should be used with caution in children suffering from glandular fever (viral infection causing sore throat, high fever, swelling of salivary glands), liver disease, or kidney disease who are not passing urine daily.

ADVENT DROPS is for pediatric use only. It should be used with caution in neonates and infants less than 12 weeks of age. The most common side effects after giving ADVENT DROPS are vomiting, diarrhea, nausea, and thrush (fungal infections). Consult your doctor immediately if your child experiences any of the above side effects.
uses: Used to manage bacterial infections in children
usesDetails:
Uses Of ADVENT DROPS
Used to manage bacterial infections in children
mechanismOfAction:
How ADVENT DROPS Works

ADVENT DROPS work against bacterial infections. Amoxicillin in Clavam stops bacteria from making their cell walls, causing them to break apart and die. Clavulanic acid in Clavam stops bacteria from destroying amoxicillin, making it more effective at killing bacteria. So together, they help kill bacteria and manage infections.
