mechanismOfAction:
How NOVAMOX 125MG REDIUSE SUSPENSION Works

NOVAMOX 125MG REDIUSE SUSPENSION contains a medicine called Amoxicillin which is a type of antibiotic that belongs to the penicillin group. It works by inhibiting the synthesis of bacterial cell walls. Bacteria have a protective outer layer called the cell wall, which is essential for their survival. Amoxicillin interferes with the enzymes that are responsible for forming the cell wall, specifically targeting the cross-linking process. This weakens the cell wall, causing it to rupture and ultimately leading to the death of the bacteria. This action makes amoxicillin effective against a wide range of bacterial infections.

introduction:
Introduction About FLEMICLAV KID DRY SYRUP

FLEMICLAV KID DRY SYRUP is used to manage bacterial infections such as middle ear and sinus infections, respiratory tract infections, genital tract infections, urinary tract infections, skin and soft tissue infections such as dental infections, bone and joint infections, septic abortion (any abortion complicated by uterine infection), and abdominal infections. The symptoms of a bacterial infection may include fever, difficulty breathing, pus formation, and pain.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It works by preventing the growth of bacteria and helps clear up the infection.

Do not take FLEMICLAV KID DRY SYRUP if you have a history of hypersensitivity to beta-lactams, including penicillin and cephalosporins, or any other ingredients of this medicine. It is not recommended for use if you have a history of amoxicillin-clavulanate-associated jaundice or hepatic dysfunction.

Before taking FLEMICLAV KID DRY SYRUP, inform your doctor if you are suffering from hepatic or renal impairment. This medicine should be used with caution in pregnant women and only when necessary.

In breastfeeding women, it should be used with caution. FLEMICLAV KID DRY SYRUP should be used with caution in children (aged below 12 years) and elderly patients (above 50 years).

The common side effects associated with the use of FLEMICLAV KID DRY SYRUP are diarrhea, thrush (a fungal infection in the vagina, skin folds, or mouth), nausea, and vomiting. Contact your doctor immediately if any of the symptoms worsen.

Amoxicillin and Cloxacillin work by killing and managing the growth of bacteria by blocking the production of the bacterial cell wall. Before recommending NOVACLOX 250MG/250MG CAPSULE, your doctor may want you to take relevant blood tests to understand your existing condition.

Before taking NOVACLOX 250MG/250MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have or ever had kidney disease (such as difficulty in passing urine, kidney failure, kidney injury etc.), liver disease, viral or fungal infection, malnutrition, suppressed immune system, bone marrow disorder, fits or seizure disorder, frequent diarrhoea etc. NOVACLOX 250MG/250MG CAPSULE should be used with caution among women who are pregnant or breastfeeding. introduction:
Introduction About TAZACT 4.5GM INJECTION

TAZACT 4.5GM INJECTION is a combination of Piperacillin and Tazobactam which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage several bacterial infections such as lower respiratory tract infections such as pneumonia, acute bacterial exacerbation causing breathing difficulties, urinary tract infections, pyelonephritis, skin infections, abdominal, biliary tract infections and female pelvic infections such as postpartum endometritis or pelvic inflammatory disease, bacteraemia, and bacterial meningitis in infants and children.

It is also used along with other antibacterial agents in the management of neutropenic caused by bacterial infection.

Pneumonia is an infection which causes inflammation in the air sac producing cough with phlegm and shortness of breath. Pyelonephritis is a urinary tract infection affecting the urinary bladder later gets spreads to the kidneys. Bacteraemia is an infectious condition indicating presence of bacteria in the blood stream.

Bacterial meningitis is an infection caused by bacteria in the region surrounding the brain. Neutropenic is low levels of neutrophils (a type of white blood cells) in our body.

Kindly inform your doctor or your health-care professional before any laboratory tests as TAZACT 4.5GM INJECTION will interact with medical investigations. Inform your doctor if you are allergic to any antibiotics or other medicines.

TAZACT 4.5GM INJECTION should not be used in patients allergic to penicillin antibiotics, cephalosporin, and other beta-lactam antibiotics.

TAZACT 4.5GM INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with pre-existing diarrhoea, low potassium levels, kidney, and liver diseases.

Avoid concomitant use of other aminoglycoside antibiotics and vancomycin along with this medicine.

TAZACT 4.5GM INJECTION should be used with caution in pregnant and breast-feeding women. TAZACT 4.5GM INJECTION should be used with caution in children above 2 months and in elderly people. Your doctor will administer the right dose depends on your child’s age, body weight and severity of the infection.

The common side effects of TAZACT 4.5GM INJECTION are diarrhoea, yeast infection, headache, sleeplessness, stomach pain, vomiting, nausea, constipation, skin rash, itching, fever, and injection site reaction.

mechanismOfAction:
How TAZACT 4.5GM INJECTION Works

TAZACT 4.5GM INJECTION works by destroying the bacterial growth responsible for causing infections. Piperacillin works by interrupting the cell wall formation by binding with the enzymes responsible for cell wall synthesis. This binding causes defects in the cell wall leading to cell death causing death of the organism. Tazobactam is responsible for the irreversible termination of enzymes (beta- lactamases) that protect the organism from antibiotics and produces less anti-bacterial actions when given alone so it’s always used in combination with other antibiotics. Thus, both the substances works by managing cell growth and function inhibiting bacterial growth.

introduction:
Introduction About PIPZO 4.5GM INJECTION

PIPZO 4.5GM INJECTION is a combination of Piperacillin and Tazobactam which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage several bacterial infections such as lower respiratory tract infections such as pneumonia, acute bacterial exacerbation causing breathing difficulties, urinary tract infections, pyelonephritis, skin infections, abdominal, biliary tract infections and female pelvic infections such as postpartum endometritis or pelvic inflammatory disease, bacteraemia, and bacterial meningitis in infants and children.

It is also used along with other antibacterial agents in the management of neutropenic caused by bacterial infection.

Pneumonia is an infection which causes inflammation in the air sac producing cough with phlegm and shortness of breath. Pyelonephritis is a urinary tract infection affecting the urinary bladder later gets spreads to the kidneys. Bacteraemia is an infectious condition indicating presence of bacteria in the blood stream.

Bacterial meningitis is an infection caused by bacteria in the region surrounding the brain. Neutropenic is low levels of neutrophils (a type of white blood cells) in our body.

Kindly inform your doctor or your health-care professional before any laboratory tests as PIPZO 4.5GM INJECTION will interact with medical investigations. Inform your doctor if you are allergic to any antibiotics or other medicines.

PIPZO 4.5GM INJECTION should not be used in patients allergic to penicillin antibiotics, cephalosporin, and other beta-lactam antibiotics.

PIPZO 4.5GM INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with pre-existing diarrhoea, low potassium levels, kidney, and liver diseases.

Avoid concomitant use of other aminoglycoside antibiotics and vancomycin along with this medicine.

PIPZO 4.5GM INJECTION should be used with caution in pregnant and breast-feeding women. PIPZO 4.5GM INJECTION should be used with caution in children above 2 months and in elderly people. Your doctor will administer the right dose depends on your child’s age, body weight and severity of the infection.

The common side effects of PIPZO 4.5GM INJECTION are diarrhoea, yeast infection, headache, sleeplessness, stomach pain, vomiting, nausea, constipation, skin rash, itching, fever, and injection site reaction.

mechanismOfAction:
How PIPZO 4.5GM INJECTION Works

PIPZO 4.5GM INJECTION works by destroying the bacterial growth responsible for causing infections. Piperacillin works by interrupting the cell wall formation by binding with the enzymes responsible for cell wall synthesis. This binding causes defects in the cell wall leading to cell death causing death of the organism. Tazobactam is responsible for the irreversible termination of enzymes (beta- lactamases) that protect the organism from antibiotics and produces less anti-bacterial actions when given alone so it’s always used in combination with other antibiotics. Thus, both the substances works by managing cell growth and function inhibiting bacterial growth.

introduction:
Introduction About MEGA CV 375MG TABLET

MEGA CV 375MG TABLET is used to manage bacterial infections, including middle ear and sinus infections, respiratory tract infections, genital tract infections, urinary tract infections, skin and soft tissue infections such as dental infections, bone and joint infections, septic abortion, and abdominal infections. The symptoms of bacterial infection include fever, difficulty breathing, pus formation, and pain.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belong to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It works by preventing the growth of bacteria and helps clear up the infection.

MEGA CV 375MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have liver problems or jaundice upon taking an antibiotic or amoxicillin-clavulanate. Before taking this medicine, inform your doctor if you are suffering from a hepatic impairment, liver disease, renal impairment, kidney disease, glandular fever, or are unable to pass water properly.

MEGA CV 375MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary. It should be used with caution in children (aged below 12 years) and elderly patients (above 50 years).

The common side effects associated with the use of MEGA CV 375MG TABLET are diarrhea, thrush (fungal infection in the vagina, skin folds, or mouth), nausea, and vomiting. Contact your doctor immediately if any of the symptoms worsen.

Manage bacterial infection

name: MOX Kidtab 250mg Tablet 15'S
introduction:
Introduction About MOX KID DT 250MG TABLET

MOX KID DT 250MG TABLET contains Amoxicillin which belongs to a group of medicines called Penicillins. It is used to manage infections caused by bacteria in different parts of the body in affected individuals.

MOX KID DT 250MG TABLET is also used in combination with other medicines to manage stomach ulcers in affected individuals. It is not recommended for use in patients allergic to amoxicillin, penicillin, and/or other antibiotics.

Before taking MOX KID DT 250MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have glandular fever (viral infection caused by Epstein Barr Virus), are unable to urinate regularly, scheduled for urine, blood or oestriol tests, kidney problems, and/or liver problems (such as hepatic impairment).

MOX KID DT 250MG TABLET should be used with caution during pregnancy and in breastfeeding women. MOX KID DT 250MG TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) and in elders (aged above 65 years).

The most common side effects of taking MOX KID DT 250MG TABLET are skin rash, nausea, and/or diarrhoea. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.
uses: Manage bacterial infections in different parts of the body
Manage stomach ulcers when used in combination with other medicines
usesDetails:

Manage bacterial infections in different parts of the body
Manage stomach ulcers when used in combination with other medicines
mechanismOfAction:
How MOX KID DT 250MG TABLET Works

MOX KID DT 250MG TABLET works by inhibiting the synthesis of penicillin-binding proteins which leads to the activation of autolytic enzymes in bacterial cell wall resulting in lysis/destruction of bacterial cell wall thus managing the spread of infection in affected individuals.

How to use MOX KID DT 250MG TABLET

Tablet, Capsule:

Take MOX KID DT 250MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicines with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Dispersible Tablet:

Take MOX KID DT 250MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Disperse MOX KID DT 250MG TABLET in the specified quantity of water as mentioned in the label. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.
sideEffects: Mild itchy rash (round, pink-red patches), ‘hive-like’ swollen areas on the forearms, legs, palms, hands or feet
Signs of allergic reactions such as skin itching/rash, swelling of the face/lips/tongue/body, and/or breathing difficulties
Signs of inflammation of blood vessel walls (due to allergic reaction) such as rash/pinpoint red round spots under the skin surface or bruising of the skin, joint pain (arthritis) and kidney problems
Signs of delayed allergic reaction (that occurs usually after 7 to 12 days of use) such as rashes, rashes, fever, joint pains and enlargement of lymph nodes under the arms

Signs of erythema multiforme (skin reaction) such as itchy reddish-purple patches on the skin (especially on the palms of the hands or soles of the feet), ‘hive-like’ raised swollen areas on the skin, tender areas on the surfaces of the mouth, eyes and genitals, fever, tiredness)
Signs of other severe skin reactions include changes in skin colour, bumps under the skin, blistering, pustules, peeling, redness, pain, itching, scaling, fever, headaches and body aches

Signs of Dress (Drug Reaction with Eosinophilia and Systemic Symptoms) such as flu-like symptoms such as rash, fever, swollen glands, and abnormal blood test results (including increased white blood cells (eosinophilia) and liver enzymes)
Signs of problems (associated with blood cell) such as fever, chills, sore throat or other signs of an infection, or bruise easily
Signs of Jarisch-Herxheimer reaction (acute febrile reaction) such as fever, chills, headache, muscle pain and skin rash
Inflammation of the colon with diarrhoea (sometimes containing blood), pain and fever

Signs of serious (reversible) liver effects such as severe diarrhoea with bleeding, blisters/ redness/bruising of the skin, darker urine/paler stools, yellowing of the skin/the whites of the eyes (jaundice)

introduction:
Introduction About NOVAMOX CV 228.5MG TANGY ORANGE FLAVOUR DISPERSIBLE TABLET

NOVAMOX CV 228.5MG TANGY ORANGE FLAVOUR DISPERSIBLE TABLET is used to manage bacterial infections, including middle ear and sinus infections, respiratory tract infections, genital tract infections, urinary tract infections, skin and soft tissue infections such as dental infections, bone and joint infections, septic abortion, and abdominal infections. The symptoms of bacterial infection include fever, difficulty breathing, pus formation, and pain.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belong to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It works by preventing the growth of bacteria and helps clear up the infection.

NOVAMOX CV 228.5MG TANGY ORANGE FLAVOUR DISPERSIBLE TABLET is not recommended for use if you have liver problems or jaundice upon taking an antibiotic or amoxicillin-clavulanate. Before taking this medicine, inform your doctor if you are suffering from a hepatic impairment, liver disease, renal impairment, kidney disease, glandular fever, or are unable to pass water properly.

NOVAMOX CV 228.5MG TANGY ORANGE FLAVOUR DISPERSIBLE TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary. It should be used with caution in children (aged below 12 years) and elderly patients (above 50 years).

The common side effects associated with the use of NOVAMOX CV 228.5MG TANGY ORANGE FLAVOUR DISPERSIBLE TABLET are diarrhea, thrush (fungal infection in the vagina, skin folds, or mouth), nausea, and vomiting. Contact your doctor immediately if any of the symptoms worsen.

Manage bacterial infection
mechanismOfAction:
How NOVAMOX CV 228.5MG TANGY ORANGE FLAVOUR DISPERSIBLE TABLET Works

NOVAMOX CV 228.5MG TANGY ORANGE FLAVOUR DISPERSIBLE TABLET helps in managing bacterial infection where amoxicillin is a penicillin that works by inhibiting the enzymes that help in the synthesis of the integral structural component of the bacterial cell wall whereas clavulanic acid is a beta-lactam (structurally related to penicillin) that works by inactivating an enzyme, namely beta-lactamase, thereby managing the inactivation of amoxicillin.

introduction:
Introduction About AMPILOX C DS 1GM INJECTION

AMPILOX C DS 1GM INJECTION is a combination of Ampicillin and Cloxacillin which belongs to the group of medicines called Penicillin Antibiotics. It is used to manage respiratory tract infections, bacterial meningitis, septicaemia, endocarditis, urinary tract infections, pelvic infections, skin and soft tissue infections, gastrointestinal infections, infected wounds or lung infections after surgery, puerperal fever, ear, nose and throat infections in moderately severe and severe infections and for patients who are unable to take the oral forms.

Before receiving AMPILOX C DS 1GM INJECTION inform your doctor if you have liver or kidney disease. AMPILOX C DS 1GM INJECTION should be used with caution in pregnant women. Contact your doctor before receiving.

AMPILOX C DS 1GM INJECTION is generally not recommended for use in breast feeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Contact your doctor before receiving.

AMPILOX C DS 1GM INJECTION should be used with caution in children. Contact your doctor before receiving. AMPILOX C DS 1GM INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years above). Contact your doctor before receiving.

The most common side effects of this medicine are nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, flatulence, stomach pain or stomach upset and mouth sores. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How AMPILOX C DS 1GM INJECTION Works

AMPILOX C DS 1GM INJECTION is a combination of Ampicillin and cloxacillin where ampicillin (has a broad spectrum of bactericidal activity against many gram-positive and gram-negative aerobic and anaerobic bacteria. It acts through the inhibition of cell wall mucopeptide biosynthesis during the stage of active multiplication.) Cloxacillin manages bacteria from reproducing, which allows your body to fight only the existing bacteria.

AMPILOX C DS 1GM INJECTION will be administered into a vein or muscle as intravenously or intramuscularly. Your doctor will administer the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About CLARIBID ORAL SUSPENSION

CLARIBID ORAL SUSPENSION contains Clarithromycin which belongs to the group of medicines called Macrolide Antibiotics. It is used to manage bacterial infections in the chest, throat and sinuses in children above 6 months to 12 years of age. It is also used to manage inflammation of the middle ear (otitis media) and infections of the skin and the layers of flesh just under the skin.

Before prescribing this medicine, your doctor may want your child to undergo few diagnostic tests to determine the exact cause of your infection before starting with the medication.

Before giving CLARIBID ORAL SUSPENSION to your child, inform your doctor if the child has been diagnosed with coronary artery disease, severe heart failure or slowed heart rate.

CLARIBID ORAL SUSPENSION is not recommended in children with a history of heart rhythm disorders (such as ventricular cardiac arrhythmia, and fast heart rhythm), in ‘long QT syndrome’ (abnormality in electrocardiogram) and in children with severe liver or kidney disorders or those prone to fungal infections.

The most common side effect of taking this medicine is stomach pain, headache, diarrhoea, and insomnia. Consult a doctor immediately if any of the above symptoms worsen.
uses: Used to manage ear nose and throat infections, respiratory tract infections, skin and soft tissue infections in children
usesDetails:
Uses Of CLARIBID ORAL SUSPENSION
Used to manage ear nose and throat infections, respiratory tract infections, skin and soft tissue infections in children
mechanismOfAction:
How CLARIBID ORAL SUSPENSION Works

CLARIBID ORAL SUSPENSION manages the growth of bacteria by interfering with its protein synthesis and binds specific proteins present in the bacterial ribosomes, thus stopping the growth of the bacteria inside the body, which helps to reduce the infection and its symptoms.
usageDetails:
How to use CLARIBID ORAL SUSPENSION

Give CLARIBID ORAL SUSPENSION to your child as advised by your physician. It is for pediatric use.

Shake the bottle well to loosen the dry powder. Add the sterile water provided with this pack up to the ring mark present on the bottle surface. Add extra water if required to adjust the volume up to the ring mark. Close the bottle tightly and shake the mixture well.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for your child depending on the age, body weight and disease condition. It is important to consume CLARIBID ORAL SUSPENSION for the stipulated duration recommended by your doctor to achieve control over the infection.

Develops severe diarrhoea

warnings.details: Do not allow your child drive or play outdoors, as CLARIBID ORAL SUSPENSION may cause dizziness or blurry vision. Consult your doctor before giving CLARIBID ORAL SUSPENSION.
CLARIBID ORAL SUSPENSION is not recommended in children with a severe kidney disorder. Consult your doctor before giving CLARIBID ORAL SUSPENSION to your child.
CLARIBID ORAL SUSPENSION is not recommended in children with severe liver disorder. Consult your doctor before giving CLARIBID ORAL SUSPENSION to your child.

Do not give CLARIBID ORAL SUSPENSION if the child is allergic (hypersensitive) to Clarithromycin and other macrolide antibiotics (such as azithromycin and erythromycin) or any other constituents of this medicine.
CLARIBID ORAL SUSPENSION should be used with caution in children with pneumonia. Consult the doctor before giving CLARIBID ORAL SUSPENSION.

CLARIBID ORAL SUSPENSION is not recommended for children with a family history of heart rhythm disorders known as ventricular cardiac arrhythmia, including the type of ventricular tachycardia (torsades de pointes) and if you have long QT syndrome (showing abnormality in electrocardiogram). CLARIBID ORAL SUSPENSION should be taken with caution in children diagnosed with coronary artery disease, severe heart failure or slowed heart rate. Consult a doctor before giving this medicine to your child.

Others

Before giving CLARIBID ORAL SUSPENSION, inform your doctor if your child:

Have abnormal low levels of potassium and magnesium in the blood (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia)
Having or prone to fungal infection  
Have pharyngitis
Have phenylketonuria

Use in pediatrics:

Your doctor will give the right dose depends on your child’s age, body weight and severity of the infection. Consult your doctor before giving CLARIBID ORAL SUSPENSION to your child.

introduction:
Introduction About MOXCLAV DS ORAL SUSPENSION

MOXCLAV DS ORAL SUSPENSION is used to manage bacterial infections such as middle ear and sinus infections, respiratory tract infections, genital tract infections, urinary tract infections, skin and soft tissue infections such as dental infections, bone and joint infections, septic abortion (any abortion complicated by uterine infection), and abdominal infections. The symptoms of a bacterial infection may include fever, difficulty breathing, pus formation, and pain.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It works by preventing the growth of bacteria and helps clear up the infection.

Do not take MOXCLAV DS ORAL SUSPENSION if you have a history of hypersensitivity to beta-lactams, including penicillin and cephalosporins, or any other ingredients of this medicine. It is not recommended for use if you have a history of amoxicillin-clavulanate-associated jaundice or hepatic dysfunction.

Before taking MOXCLAV DS ORAL SUSPENSION, inform your doctor if you are suffering from hepatic or renal impairment. This medicine should be used with caution in pregnant women and only when necessary.

In breastfeeding women, it should be used with caution. MOXCLAV DS ORAL SUSPENSION should be used with caution in children (aged below 12 years) and elderly patients (above 50 years).

The common side effects associated with the use of MOXCLAV DS ORAL SUSPENSION are diarrhea, thrush (a fungal infection in the vagina, skin folds, or mouth), nausea, and vomiting. Contact your doctor immediately if any of the symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About DURATAZ 2.25GM INJECTION

DURATAZ 2.25GM INJECTION is a combination of Piperacillin and Tazobactam which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage several bacterial infections such as lower respiratory tract infections such as pneumonia, acute bacterial exacerbation causing breathing difficulties, urinary tract infections, pyelonephritis, skin infections, abdominal, biliary tract infections and female pelvic infections such as postpartum endometritis or pelvic inflammatory disease, bacteraemia, and bacterial meningitis in infants and children. It is also used along with other antibacterial agents in the management of neutropenic caused by bacterial infection.

Inform your doctor or your health-care professional before any laboratory tests as DURATAZ 2.25GM INJECTION will interact with medical investigations. Inform your doctor if you are allergic to any antibiotics or other medicines. DURATAZ 2.25GM INJECTION should not be used in patients allergic to penicillin antibiotics, cephalosporin, and other beta-lactam antibiotics. DURATAZ 2.25GM INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with pre-existing diarrhoea, low potassium levels, kidney, and liver diseases.

Avoid concomitant use of other aminoglycoside antibiotics and vancomycin along with this medicine. DURATAZ 2.25GM INJECTION should be used with caution in pregnant and breast-feeding women. DURATAZ 2.25GM INJECTION should be used with caution in children above 2 months and in elderly people. Your doctor will administer the right dose depends on your child’s age, body weight and severity of the infection. The common side effects of DURATAZ 2.25GM INJECTION are diarrhoea, yeast infection, headache, sleeplessness, stomach pain, vomiting, nausea, constipation, skin rash, itching, fever, and injection site reaction.
usesDetails:
Uses Of DURATAZ 2.25GM INJECTION

It is used to manage the following infections:

Intra-abdominal infection
Skin and skin structure infections
Female pelvic infections
Lower respiratory tract infection
Bacterial septicaemia
mechanismOfAction:
How DURATAZ 2.25GM INJECTION Works

DURATAZ 2.25GM INJECTION works by destroying the bacterial growth responsible for causing infections. Piperacillin works by interrupting the cell wall formation by binding with the enzymes responsible for cell wall synthesis. This binding causes defects in the cell wall leading to cell death causing death of the organism. Tazobactam is responsible for the irreversible termination of enzymes (beta- lactamases) that protect the organism from antibiotics and produces less anti-bacterial actions when given alone so it’s always used in combination with other antibiotics. Thus, both the substances works by managing cell growth and function inhibiting bacterial growth.
usageDetails:
How to use DURATAZ 2.25GM INJECTION

DURATAZ 2.25GM INJECTION will be administered into the vein (intravenously) by your doctor or nurse. Your doctor will administer the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About BLUMOX 500MG CAPSULE

BLUMOX 500MG CAPSULE is an antibiotic medicine used in the management of various bacterial infections such as respiratory tract infections, ear, nose, throat infections, stomach infections (H. Pylori infection), skin infections and urinary tract infections. It contains a medicine called amoxycillin which is a powerful antibacterial agent that eradicates the susceptible microorganism that causes the infection.

Take BLUMOX 500MG CAPSULE as advised by the physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Do not skip doses or stop therapy with BLUMOX 500MG CAPSULE without consulting your doctor, as it will make this medicine less effective against the bacteria which causes infection.

Therefore, make sure to complete the duration of therapy as suggested by your doctor for fast recovery. Do not take BLUMOX 500MG CAPSULE if you are allergic to Amoxycillin. Before taking BLUMOX 500MG CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, glandular fever, urinary problems, etc. Consult your doctor before taking BLUMOX 500MG CAPSULE if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking BLUMOX 500MG CAPSULE are nausea, diarrhea and skin rashes. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.
usesDetails:
Uses Of BLUMOX 500MG CAPSULE

Management of bacterial infections such as:

Respiratory tract infections
Ear, nose, throat infections
Stomach infections (H. Pylori infection)
Skin infections
Urinary tract infections
mechanismOfAction:
How BLUMOX 500MG CAPSULE Works

BLUMOX 500MG CAPSULE contains a medicine called Amoxicillin which is a type of antibiotic that belongs to the penicillin group. It works by inhibiting the synthesis of bacterial cell walls. Bacteria have a protective outer layer called the cell wall, which is essential for their survival. Amoxicillin interferes with the enzymes that are responsible for forming the cell wall, specifically targeting the cross-linking process. This weakens the cell wall, causing it to rupture and ultimately leading to the death of the bacteria. This action makes amoxicillin effective against a wide range of bacterial infections.

Take BLUMOX 500MG CAPSULE as advised by the physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of the therapy based on your age, body weight and severity of infection.

introduction:
Introduction About POLYCLAV 625MG TABLET

POLYCLAV 625MG TABLET is used to manage bacterial infections, including middle ear and sinus infections, respiratory tract infections, genital tract infections, urinary tract infections, skin and soft tissue infections such as dental infections, bone and joint infections, septic abortion, and abdominal infections. The symptoms of bacterial infection include fever, difficulty breathing, pus formation, and pain.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belong to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It works by preventing the growth of bacteria and helps clear up the infection.

POLYCLAV 625MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have liver problems or jaundice upon taking an antibiotic or amoxicillin-clavulanate. Before taking this medicine, inform your doctor if you are suffering from a hepatic impairment, liver disease, renal impairment, kidney disease, glandular fever, or are unable to pass water properly.

POLYCLAV 625MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary. It should be used with caution in children (aged below 12 years) and elderly patients (above 50 years).

The common side effects associated with the use of POLYCLAV 625MG TABLET are diarrhea, thrush (fungal infection in the vagina, skin folds, or mouth), nausea, and vomiting. Contact your doctor immediately if any of the symptoms worsen.

name: Mega CV Drops 10ml
introduction:
Introduction About MEGA CV DROPS

MEGA CV DROPS is used in infants for the management of various bacterial infections such as respiratory tract infections, urinary tract infections, bone and joint infections, middle ear infections (otitis media), tonsillitis, sinusitis, skin, and soft tissue infections such as cellulitis, animal bites, etc.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belong to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It works by preventing the growth of the bacteria, thus clearing up the infection.

MEGA CV DROPS is not recommended for children with a history of severe kidney impairment, history of liver problems, or jaundice after taking penicillin antibiotics. It should be used with caution in children suffering from glandular fever (viral infection causing sore throat, high fever, swelling of salivary glands), liver disease, or kidney disease who are not passing urine daily.

MEGA CV DROPS is for pediatric use only. It should be used with caution in neonates and infants less than 12 weeks of age. The most common side effects after giving MEGA CV DROPS are vomiting, diarrhea, nausea, and thrush (fungal infections). Consult your doctor immediately if your child experiences any of the above side effects.
uses: Used to manage bacterial infections in children
usesDetails:
Uses Of MEGA CV DROPS
Used to manage bacterial infections in children
mechanismOfAction:
How MEGA CV DROPS Works

MEGA CV DROPS work against bacterial infections. Amoxicillin in Clavam stops bacteria from making their cell walls, causing them to break apart and die. Clavulanic acid in Clavam stops bacteria from destroying amoxicillin, making it more effective at killing bacteria. So together, they help kill bacteria and manage infections.

Shake the medicine well before use.
Measure the required amount of the medicine in the measuring dropper provided with the pack.
Make sure to rinse the measuring dropper in warm water before and after use. Your doctor will decide the correct dose for your child based on their age and body weight.

introduction:
Introduction About BLUMOX DT 250MG TABLET

BLUMOX DT 250MG TABLET contains Amoxicillin which belongs to the group of medicines called Penicillins. It is used to manage wide range of infections caused by gram positive and gram-negative bacteria which includes respiratory infection (such as otitis media), sinus infection, gynaecological infection, urinary tract infection and other serious infections (such as septicaemia).

BLUMOX DT 250MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients suffering from mononucleosis (glandular fever caused by Epstein Barr Virus) and/or certain infections (especially urinary tract infection, a severe infection of ear/nose/throat) caused by the non-susceptible pathogen.

Before taking BLUMOX DT 250MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have a history of seizures/fits, meningeal disorders, diarrhoea, kidney problems (such as renal impairment) and/or liver problems (such as hepatic impairment).

BLUMOX DT 250MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if it is clearly necessary. BLUMOX DT 250MG TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents (from 6 months to 18 years of age) and elderly patients (aged above 65 years). Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.

The most common side effects of taking BLUMOX DT 250MG TABLET are skin rash, nausea and diarrhoea. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

usesDetails:

mechanismOfAction:
How BLUMOX DT 250MG TABLET Works

BLUMOX DT 250MG TABLET works by inhibiting penicillin-binding proteins that are responsible for bacterial cell wall formation. This leads to the activation of autolytic enzymes in the bacterial cell wall which causes its destruction thus managing the spread of infection in affected individuals.
usageDetails:

Tablet, Capsule:

Take BLUMOX DT 250MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Dispersible Tablet:

Take BLUMOX DT 250MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Disperse BLUMOX DT 250MG TABLET in the specified quantity of water as mentioned on the label. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution. Your doctor will recommend the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About BACTOCLAV DS 457MG SYRUP

BACTOCLAV DS 457MG SYRUP is used to manage bacterial infections such as middle ear and sinus infections, respiratory tract infections, genital tract infections, urinary tract infections, skin and soft tissue infections such as dental infections, bone and joint infections, septic abortion (any abortion complicated by uterine infection), and abdominal infections. The symptoms of a bacterial infection may include fever, difficulty breathing, pus formation, and pain.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It works by preventing the growth of bacteria and helps clear up the infection.

Do not take BACTOCLAV DS 457MG SYRUP if you have a history of hypersensitivity to beta-lactams, including penicillin and cephalosporins, or any other ingredients of this medicine. It is not recommended for use if you have a history of amoxicillin-clavulanate-associated jaundice or hepatic dysfunction.

Before taking BACTOCLAV DS 457MG SYRUP, inform your doctor if you are suffering from hepatic or renal impairment. This medicine should be used with caution in pregnant women and only when necessary.

In breastfeeding women, it should be used with caution. BACTOCLAV DS 457MG SYRUP should be used with caution in children (aged below 12 years) and elderly patients (above 50 years).

The common side effects associated with the use of BACTOCLAV DS 457MG SYRUP are diarrhea, thrush (a fungal infection in the vagina, skin folds, or mouth), nausea, and vomiting. Contact your doctor immediately if any of the symptoms worsen.

Introduction About DUET 625MG TABLET

DUET 625MG TABLET is used to manage bacterial infections, including middle ear and sinus infections, respiratory tract infections, genital tract infections, urinary tract infections, skin and soft tissue infections such as dental infections, bone and joint infections, septic abortion, and abdominal infections. The symptoms of bacterial infection include fever, difficulty breathing, pus formation, and pain.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belong to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It works by preventing the growth of bacteria and helps clear up the infection.

DUET 625MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have liver problems or jaundice upon taking an antibiotic or amoxicillin-clavulanate. Before taking this medicine, inform your doctor if you are suffering from a hepatic impairment, liver disease, renal impairment, kidney disease, glandular fever, or are unable to pass water properly.

DUET 625MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary. It should be used with caution in children (aged below 12 years) and elderly patients (above 50 years).

The common side effects associated with the use of DUET 625MG TABLET are diarrhea, thrush (fungal infection in the vagina, skin folds, or mouth), nausea, and vomiting. Contact your doctor immediately if any of the symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About BLUMOX PLUS CAPSULE

BLUMOX PLUS CAPSULE contains a combination of Amoxicillin and Cloxacillin, which belongs to the group of medicines called semi-synthetic penicillin antibiotics. BLUMOX PLUS CAPSULE is used to manage infectious conditions caused by various types of bacteria such as lung infection (Bronchopneumonia, bronchitis etc.), infection in the blood (septicaemia), urinary tract infection, bone infection, wound infection and following a surgery etc. The symptoms of bacterial infection include fever, tiredness, headache, stomach pain, feeling sick or vomiting sensation etc.

Amoxicillin and Cloxacillin work by killing and managing the growth of bacteria by blocking the production of the bacterial cell wall. Before recommending BLUMOX PLUS CAPSULE, your doctor may want you to take relevant blood tests to understand your existing condition.

Before taking BLUMOX PLUS CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have or ever had kidney disease (such as difficulty in passing urine, kidney failure, kidney injury etc.), liver disease, viral or fungal infection, malnutrition, suppressed immune system, bone marrow disorder, fits or seizure disorder, frequent diarrhoea etc. BLUMOX PLUS CAPSULE should be used with caution among women who are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking BLUMOX PLUS CAPSULE are sickness, vomiting, skin rashes, itching, loose stools (diarrhoea), stomach upset or discomfort etc. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About NOVAMOX DT 125MG TABLET

NOVAMOX DT 125MG TABLET is an antibiotic medicine used in the management of various bacterial infections such as respiratory tract infections, ear, nose, throat infections, stomach infections (H. Pylori infection), skin infections and urinary tract infections, especially in children. It contains a medicine called amoxycillin which is a powerful antibacterial agent that eradicates the susceptible microorganism that causes the infection.

Do not take NOVAMOX DT 125MG TABLET if you are allergic to Amoxycillin. Before taking NOVAMOX DT 125MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, glandular fever, urinary problems, etc. Consult your doctor before taking NOVAMOX DT 125MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking NOVAMOX DT 125MG TABLET are nausea, diarrhea and skin rashes. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.
usesDetails:

mechanismOfAction:
How NOVAMOX DT 125MG TABLET Works

NOVAMOX DT 125MG TABLET contains a medicine called Amoxicillin which is a type of antibiotic that belongs to the penicillin group. It works by inhibiting the synthesis of bacterial cell walls. Bacteria have a protective outer layer called the cell wall, which is essential for their survival. Amoxicillin interferes with the enzymes that are responsible for forming the cell wall, specifically targeting the cross-linking process. This weakens the cell wall, causing it to rupture and ultimately leading to the death of the bacteria. This action makes amoxicillin effective against a wide range of bacterial infections.

Take NOVAMOX DT 125MG TABLET as advised by the physician. Disperse the medicine in a glass of water before consumption. Do not crush, swallow or chew the medicine.

SENSICLAV DROPS is used in infants for the management of various bacterial infections such as respiratory tract infections, urinary tract infections, bone and joint infections, middle ear infections (otitis media), tonsillitis, sinusitis, skin, and soft tissue infections such as cellulitis, animal bites, etc.

SENSICLAV DROPS is not recommended for children with a history of severe kidney impairment, history of liver problems, or jaundice after taking penicillin antibiotics. It should be used with caution in children suffering from glandular fever (viral infection causing sore throat, high fever, swelling of salivary glands), liver disease, or kidney disease who are not passing urine daily.

SENSICLAV DROPS is for pediatric use only. It should be used with caution in neonates and infants less than 12 weeks of age. The most common side effects after giving SENSICLAV DROPS are vomiting, diarrhea, nausea, and thrush (fungal infections). How SENSICLAV DROPS Works

SENSICLAV DROPS work against bacterial infections. Amoxicillin in Clavam stops bacteria from making their cell walls, causing them to break apart and die. introduction:
Introduction About PIPZO 1.125GM INJECTION

PIPZO 1.125GM INJECTION is a combination of Piperacillin and Tazobactam which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage several bacterial infections such as lower respiratory tract infections such as pneumonia, acute bacterial exacerbation causing breathing difficulties, urinary tract infections, pyelonephritis, skin infections, abdominal, biliary tract infections and female pelvic infections such as postpartum endometritis or pelvic inflammatory disease, bacteraemia, and bacterial meningitis in infants and children.

It is also used along with other antibacterial agents in the management of neutropenic caused by bacterial infection.

Pneumonia is an infection which causes inflammation in the air sac producing cough with phlegm and shortness of breath. Pyelonephritis is a urinary tract infection affecting the urinary bladder later gets spreads to the kidneys. Bacteraemia is an infectious condition indicating presence of bacteria in the blood stream.

Bacterial meningitis is an infection caused by bacteria in the region surrounding the brain. Neutropenic is low levels of neutrophils (a type of white blood cells) in our body.

Kindly inform your doctor or your health-care professional before any laboratory tests as PIPZO 1.125GM INJECTION will interact with medical investigations. Inform your doctor if you are allergic to any antibiotics or other medicines.

PIPZO 1.125GM INJECTION should not be used in patients allergic to penicillin antibiotics, cephalosporin, and other beta-lactam antibiotics.

PIPZO 1.125GM INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with pre-existing diarrhoea, low potassium levels, kidney, and liver diseases.

Avoid concomitant use of other aminoglycoside antibiotics and vancomycin along with this medicine.

PIPZO 1.125GM INJECTION should be used with caution in pregnant and breast-feeding women. PIPZO 1.125GM INJECTION should be used with caution in children above 2 months and in elderly people. Your doctor will administer the right dose depends on your child’s age, body weight and severity of the infection.

The common side effects of PIPZO 1.125GM INJECTION are diarrhoea, yeast infection, headache, sleeplessness, stomach pain, vomiting, nausea, constipation, skin rash, itching, fever, and injection site reaction.

mechanismOfAction:
How PIPZO 1.125GM INJECTION Works

PIPZO 1.125GM INJECTION works by destroying the bacterial growth responsible for causing infections. Piperacillin works by interrupting the cell wall formation by binding with the enzymes responsible for cell wall synthesis. This binding causes defects in the cell wall leading to cell death causing death of the organism. Tazobactam is responsible for the irreversible termination of enzymes (beta- lactamases) that protect the organism from antibiotics and produces less anti-bacterial actions when given alone so it’s always used in combination with other antibiotics. Thus, both the substances works by managing cell growth and function inhibiting bacterial growth.

name: AUGMENTIN ES Suspension 50ml
introduction:
Introduction About AUGMENTIN ES SUSPENSION

AUGMENTIN ES SUSPENSION is used to manage bacterial infections such as middle ear and sinus infections, respiratory tract infections, genital tract infections, urinary tract infections, skin and soft tissue infections such as dental infections, bone and joint infections, septic abortion (any abortion complicated by uterine infection), and abdominal infections. The symptoms of a bacterial infection may include fever, difficulty breathing, pus formation, and pain.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It works by preventing the growth of bacteria and helps clear up the infection.

Do not take AUGMENTIN ES SUSPENSION if you have a history of hypersensitivity to beta-lactams, including penicillin and cephalosporins, or any other ingredients of this medicine. It is not recommended for use if you have a history of amoxicillin-clavulanate-associated jaundice or hepatic dysfunction.

Before taking AUGMENTIN ES SUSPENSION, inform your doctor if you are suffering from hepatic or renal impairment. This medicine should be used with caution in pregnant women and only when necessary.

In breastfeeding women, it should be used with caution. AUGMENTIN ES SUSPENSION should be used with caution in children (aged below 12 years) and elderly patients (above 50 years).

The common side effects associated with the use of AUGMENTIN ES SUSPENSION are diarrhea, thrush (a fungal infection in the vagina, skin folds, or mouth), nausea, and vomiting. Contact your doctor immediately if any of the symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About BIOCILIN 1000 INJECTION

BIOCILIN 1000 INJECTION contains Ampicillin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage bacterial infections of the ear, nose, throat, respiratory tract (bronchus, lungs), urinary tract, genital tract, stomach, blood, brain and skin or soft tissues.

It can also be used to manage typhoid fever, meningitis (inflammation of the lining of the brain), peritonitis (inflammation of the lining of the stomach) and endocarditis (inflammation of the lining of the heart and its valves).

BIOCILIN 1000 INJECTION should be used under medical supervision. Do not stop receiving BIOCILIN 1000 INJECTION even if you feel better during the midway of the therapy. Failing to complete the full course of the therapy or skipping doses in between the therapy may not result in adequate infection control.

During therapy with BIOCILIN 1000 INJECTION, your doctor will periodically monitor your health condition through several blood tests/urine tests to access the improvement in your condition and to reduce the risk of unwanted side effects. BIOCILIN 1000 INJECTION is suitable for use in adults and in children (aged 10 years or older; weighing 20 kg or more).

Before receiving BIOCILIN 1000 INJECTION inform your doctor if you have any kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have blood cancer or any viral infections (such as cytomegalovirus infection) as a precaution.

BIOCILIN 1000 INJECTION should be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women only if considered necessary by the physician. The most common side effects of receiving BIOCILIN 1000 INJECTION are nausea, vomiting and diarrhea. Inform your doctor if they trouble you.

Do not take MOXIKIND CV DRY SYRUP if you have a history of hypersensitivity to beta-lactams, including penicillin and cephalosporins, or any other ingredients of this medicine. introduction:
Introduction About NOVAMOX DT 250MG TABLET

NOVAMOX DT 250MG TABLET contains Amoxicillin which belongs to the group of medicines called Penicillins. It is used to manage wide range of infections caused by gram positive and gram-negative bacteria which includes respiratory infection (such as otitis media), sinus infection, gynaecological infection, urinary tract infection and other serious infections (such as septicaemia).

NOVAMOX DT 250MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients suffering from mononucleosis (glandular fever caused by Epstein Barr Virus) and/or certain infections (especially urinary tract infection, a severe infection of ear/nose/throat) caused by the non-susceptible pathogen.

Before taking NOVAMOX DT 250MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have a history of seizures/fits, meningeal disorders, diarrhoea, kidney problems (such as renal impairment) and/or liver problems (such as hepatic impairment).

NOVAMOX DT 250MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if it is clearly necessary. NOVAMOX DT 250MG TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents (from 6 months to 18 years of age) and elderly patients (aged above 65 years). Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.

The most common side effects of taking NOVAMOX DT 250MG TABLET are skin rash, nausea and diarrhoea. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.
uses: Manage wide range of infections caused by gram-positive and gram-negative bacteria which includes respiratory infection (such as otitis media), sinus infection, gynaecological infection, urinary tract infection and other serious infections (such as septicaemia)

mechanismOfAction:
How NOVAMOX DT 250MG TABLET Works

NOVAMOX DT 250MG TABLET works by inhibiting penicillin-binding proteins that are responsible for bacterial cell wall formation. This leads to the activation of autolytic enzymes in the bacterial cell wall which causes its destruction thus managing the spread of infection in affected individuals.

Take NOVAMOX DT 250MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Dispersible Tablet:

Take NOVAMOX DT 250MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Disperse NOVAMOX DT 250MG TABLET in the specified quantity of water as mentioned on the label. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution. Your doctor will recommend the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Marzon Duo Tablet 6'S
introduction:
Introduction About MARZON DUO TABLET

MARZON DUO TABLET contains Sultamicillin which belongs to the group of medicines called Penicillins. MARZON DUO TABLET is used to manage upper respiratory tract infections (such as sinusitis, otitis media, tonsillitis), lower respiratory tract infections (such as bacterial pneumonias, bronchitis), urinary tract infections, pyelonephritis (inflammation of kidney), skin & soft tissue infections, and gonococcal infections (sexually transmitted disease) in affected individuals.

MARZON DUO TABLET is also indicated in patients who require sulbactam/ampicillin therapy (antibacterial therapy) following initial therapy with intramuscular/intravenous sulbactam/ampicillin medicine. MARZON DUO TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Sultamicillin. It is also not recommended for use in patients with infectious mononucleosis (a viral infection), galactose intolerance, Lapp-lactase deficiency, and/or glucose-galactose malabsorption (rare hereditary problems).

Before taking MARZON DUO TABLET, inform your doctor if you had previously suffered from hypersensitivity reactions (to penicillins, cephalosporins, carbapenems, and/or other beta-lactam antibiotic agents), and/or have kidney problems (such as severe renal impairment), and/or liver problems (such as liver dysfunction).

MARZON DUO TABLET should be used with caution during pregnancy only if it is clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through breast milk.

MARZON DUO TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) which is also advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years/above) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking MARZON DUO TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, stomach pain, itching, and/or rashes. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

introduction:
Introduction About MOXIKIND CV 1GM TABLET

MOXIKIND CV 1GM TABLET is used to manage bacterial infections, including middle ear and sinus infections, respiratory tract infections, genital tract infections, urinary tract infections, skin and soft tissue infections such as dental infections, bone and joint infections, septic abortion, and abdominal infections. The symptoms of bacterial infection include fever, difficulty breathing, pus formation, and pain.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belong to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It works by preventing the growth of bacteria and helps clear up the infection.

MOXIKIND CV 1GM TABLET is not recommended for use if you have liver problems or jaundice upon taking an antibiotic or amoxicillin-clavulanate. Before taking this medicine, inform your doctor if you are suffering from a hepatic impairment, liver disease, renal impairment, kidney disease, glandular fever, or are unable to pass water properly.

MOXIKIND CV 1GM TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary. It should be used with caution in children (aged below 12 years) and elderly patients (above 50 years).

The common side effects associated with the use of MOXIKIND CV 1GM TABLET are diarrhea, thrush (fungal infection in the vagina, skin folds, or mouth), nausea, and vomiting. Contact your doctor immediately if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of MOXIKIND CV 1GM TABLET
Manage bacterial infection
mechanismOfAction:
How MOXIKIND CV 1GM TABLET Works

MOXIKIND CV 1GM TABLET helps in managing bacterial infection where amoxicillin is a penicillin that works by inhibiting the enzymes that help in the synthesis of the integral structural component of the bacterial cell wall whereas clavulanic acid is a beta-lactam (structurally related to penicillin) that works by inactivating an enzyme, namely beta-lactamase, thereby managing the inactivation of amoxicillin.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About BACTOCLAV DRY SUSPENSION

BACTOCLAV DRY SUSPENSION is used to manage bacterial infections such as middle ear and sinus infections, respiratory tract infections, genital tract infections, urinary tract infections, skin and soft tissue infections such as dental infections, bone and joint infections, septic abortion (any abortion complicated by uterine infection), and abdominal infections. The symptoms of a bacterial infection may include fever, difficulty breathing, pus formation, and pain.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It works by preventing the growth of bacteria and helps clear up the infection.

Do not take BACTOCLAV DRY SUSPENSION if you have a history of hypersensitivity to beta-lactams, including penicillin and cephalosporins, or any other ingredients of this medicine. It is not recommended for use if you have a history of amoxicillin-clavulanate-associated jaundice or hepatic dysfunction.

Before taking BACTOCLAV DRY SUSPENSION, inform your doctor if you are suffering from hepatic or renal impairment. This medicine should be used with caution in pregnant women and only when necessary.

In breastfeeding women, it should be used with caution. BACTOCLAV DRY SUSPENSION should be used with caution in children (aged below 12 years) and elderly patients (above 50 years).

The common side effects associated with the use of BACTOCLAV DRY SUSPENSION are diarrhea, thrush (a fungal infection in the vagina, skin folds, or mouth), nausea, and vomiting. Contact your doctor immediately if any of the symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About XYLOMOX 500 CAPSULE

XYLOMOX 500 CAPSULE is an antibiotic medicine used in the management of various bacterial infections such as respiratory tract infections, ear, nose, throat infections, stomach infections (H. Pylori infection), skin infections and urinary tract infections. It contains a medicine called amoxycillin which is a powerful antibacterial agent that eradicates the susceptible microorganism that causes the infection.

Take XYLOMOX 500 CAPSULE as advised by the physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Do not skip doses or stop therapy with XYLOMOX 500 CAPSULE without consulting your doctor, as it will make this medicine less effective against the bacteria which causes infection.

Therefore, make sure to complete the duration of therapy as suggested by your doctor for fast recovery. Do not take XYLOMOX 500 CAPSULE if you are allergic to Amoxycillin. Before taking XYLOMOX 500 CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, glandular fever, urinary problems, etc. Consult your doctor before taking XYLOMOX 500 CAPSULE if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking XYLOMOX 500 CAPSULE are nausea, diarrhea and skin rashes. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.
usesDetails:
Uses Of XYLOMOX 500 CAPSULE

Management of bacterial infections such as:

Respiratory tract infections
Ear, nose, throat infections
Stomach infections (H. Pylori infection)
Skin infections
Urinary tract infections
mechanismOfAction:
How XYLOMOX 500 CAPSULE Works

XYLOMOX 500 CAPSULE contains a medicine called Amoxicillin which is a type of antibiotic that belongs to the penicillin group. It works by inhibiting the synthesis of bacterial cell walls. Bacteria have a protective outer layer called the cell wall, which is essential for their survival. Amoxicillin interferes with the enzymes that are responsible for forming the cell wall, specifically targeting the cross-linking process. This weakens the cell wall, causing it to rupture and ultimately leading to the death of the bacteria. This action makes amoxicillin effective against a wide range of bacterial infections.

How to use XYLOMOX 500 CAPSULE

Take XYLOMOX 500 CAPSULE as advised by the physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of the therapy based on your age, body weight and severity of infection.

introduction:
Introduction About MOXIKIND CV DROPS

MOXIKIND CV DROPS is used in infants for the management of various bacterial infections such as respiratory tract infections, urinary tract infections, bone and joint infections, middle ear infections (otitis media), tonsillitis, sinusitis, skin, and soft tissue infections such as cellulitis, animal bites, etc.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belong to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It works by preventing the growth of the bacteria, thus clearing up the infection.

MOXIKIND CV DROPS is not recommended for children with a history of severe kidney impairment, history of liver problems, or jaundice after taking penicillin antibiotics. It should be used with caution in children suffering from glandular fever (viral infection causing sore throat, high fever, swelling of salivary glands), liver disease, or kidney disease who are not passing urine daily.

MOXIKIND CV DROPS is for pediatric use only. It should be used with caution in neonates and infants less than 12 weeks of age. The most common side effects after giving MOXIKIND CV DROPS are vomiting, diarrhea, nausea, and thrush (fungal infections). Consult your doctor immediately if your child experiences any of the above side effects.

mechanismOfAction:
How MOXIKIND CV DROPS Works

MOXIKIND CV DROPS work against bacterial infections. Amoxicillin in Clavam stops bacteria from making their cell walls, causing them to break apart and die. Clavulanic acid in Clavam stops bacteria from destroying amoxicillin, making it more effective at killing bacteria. So together, they help kill bacteria and manage infections.

introduction:
Introduction About MEGAPEN 1GM INJECTION

MEGAPEN 1GM INJECTION is a combination of Ampicillin and Cloxacillin which belongs to the group of medicines called Penicillin Antibiotics. It is used to manage respiratory tract infections, bacterial meningitis, septicaemia, endocarditis, urinary tract infections, pelvic infections, skin and soft tissue infections, gastrointestinal infections, infected wounds or lung infections after surgery, puerperal fever, ear, nose and throat infections in moderately severe and severe infections and for patients who are unable to take the oral forms.

Before receiving MEGAPEN 1GM INJECTION inform your doctor if you have liver or kidney disease. MEGAPEN 1GM INJECTION should be used with caution in pregnant women. Contact your doctor before receiving.

MEGAPEN 1GM INJECTION is generally not recommended for use in breast feeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Contact your doctor before receiving.

MEGAPEN 1GM INJECTION should be used with caution in children. Contact your doctor before receiving. MEGAPEN 1GM INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years above). Contact your doctor before receiving.

The most common side effects of this medicine are nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, flatulence, stomach pain or stomach upset and mouth sores. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

How MEGAPEN 1GM INJECTION Works

MEGAPEN 1GM INJECTION is a combination of Ampicillin and cloxacillin where ampicillin (has a broad spectrum of bactericidal activity against many gram-positive and gram-negative aerobic and anaerobic bacteria. It acts through the inhibition of cell wall mucopeptide biosynthesis during the stage of active multiplication.) Cloxacillin manages bacteria from reproducing, which allows your body to fight only the existing bacteria.

name: Oxipod Drops 10ml
introduction:
Introduction About OXIPOD DROPS

OXIPOD DROPS is used to manage a variety of bacterial infections in children, such as acute otitis media (inflammation of the middle ear leading to pain and fever), pharyngitis or tonsillitis (sore throat, difficulty swallowing, and tender lymph nodes), and sinusitis (inflammation around the nasal cavity leading to headache and runny nose).

It is also used to manage bronchitis (inflammation of tubes that carry air, leading to difficulty breathing), infection of the urinary tract (cystitis), pneumonia (an infection that inflames the air sacs in one or both lungs), and gonococcal infection (a sexually transmitted disease by indirect contact with an infected parent). 

It contains a medicine called Cefpodoxime, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It works by stopping the growth of the bacteria that causes the infections.

Before giving OXIPOD DROPS to your child, inform your child’s doctor if your child has or has ever had colitis, liver problems, or impaired kidney function. Your child’s doctor may monitor the blood count and liver enzymes in blood tests during management with this medicine.

OXIPOD DROPS is not recommended for use in pregnant or breast-feeding women and elderly individuals, as it is used only in children. It is not recommended for use in infants less than 2 months of age.

The most common side effects of taking OXIPOD DROPS are diarrhea, nausea, abdominal pain, and headache. Consult your child’s doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of OXIPOD DROPS

Manages bacterial infections in children such as:

Acute exacerbations of chronic bronchitis
Acute otitis media
Cystitis (uncomplicated urinary tract infection)
Gonococcal infection
Pneumonia
Sinusitis 
Pharyngitis/tonsillitis
mechanismOfAction:
How OXIPOD DROPS Works

OXIPOD DROPS manages infection by stopping or managing the bacteria from multiplying by inhibiting their cell wall formation, which is essential for the bacteria to survive as it provides protection from the environment. This kind of action that kills bacteria is useful in managing various bacterial infections.
usageInstructions: Give this medicine to your child as advised by the physician.
Tap the bottle to loosen the powder.
Add two-thirds of the sterile water (provided with the pack) and shake the bottle vigorously.
Add more water up to the mark on the bottle and shake well before using.
Allow the suspension to stand for 5 minutes.
Use a medicine dropper to properly measure the dose.
Your child’s doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of OXIPOD DROPS for your child depending upon the age, body weight, and type or severity of the infection.

Introduction About ADVENT 1.2GM INJECTION

ADVENT 1.2GM INJECTION is used in the management of various bacterial infections such as respiratory tract infections (pneumonia, acute exacerbation of chronic bronchitis), urinary tract infections (cystitis, urethritis, pyelonephritis), bone and joint infections (osteomyelitis), middle ear infections (otitis media), tonsillitis, sinusitis, skin and soft tissue infections such as cellulitis, boils, wound infections, intra-abdominal sepsis, dental infections, and infections of genital organs in females.

ADVENT 1.2GM INJECTION is also used as prophylaxis against various bacterial infections associated with major surgeries of the heart, joints, kidney, head and neck, stomach, biliary tract, intestine, and pelvic region. Along with management with this medicine, your doctor might order bacterial culture tests to enhance the outcomes of the management.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belong to the group of medicines called Penicillins and Beta-Lactamase Inhibitors. It works by preventing the growth of the bacteria and thus clearing up the infection.

ADVENT 1.2GM INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney impairment who had a history of liver problems or jaundice after taking penicillin antibiotics. It should be used with caution in patients suffering from glandular fever (a viral infection causing sore throat, high fever, swelling of salivary glands, etc.), liver disease, kidney disease, who are not passing urine daily, convulsions (fits), or large intestine inflammation.

ADVENT 1.2GM INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless necessary. It should be used with caution in breastfeeding women, as it may pass through breast milk. ADVENT 1.2GM INJECTION should be used with caution in children as it may require dose modification.

The most common side effects after receiving ADVENT 1.2GM INJECTION are diarrhea, thrush (fungal infection), etc. Consult your doctor immediately if any of your symptoms get worse or persist.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ADVENT 1.2GM INJECTION
Management of various bacterial infections
mechanismOfAction:
How ADVENT 1.2GM INJECTION Works

ADVENT 1.2GM INJECTION helps in managing bacterial infection, where Amoxicillin works by inhibiting penicillin-binding proteins (which are involved in the synthesis of the bacterial cell wall), leading to the activation of autolytic enzymes in the bacterial cell wall. Therefore, leading to lysis of the cell wall and death of the bacterial cell, clavulanic acid inhibits the activity of bacterial enzymes known as beta-lactamases and hence enhances the antibacterial activity of amoxicillin.
usageInstructions: This medicine will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as an intravenous infusion or intravenous injection.
Your doctor will decide the exact dose and duration of management for you depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

sideEffects: Severe allergic reaction, which includes rashes, collapsing or fainting, swelling of the face and throat, which may cause difficulty breathing, fever, joint pain, swollen lymph nodes of the neck, armpits, and groin, and red or purple raised spots on skin due to inflammation of blood vessels
Watery diarrhea with blood or mucus, fever, and abdominal pain that occurs due to inflammation of the large intestine
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of ADVENT 1.2GM INJECTION
Common Side Effects of ADVENT 1.2GM INJECTION:
Diarrhoea
Thrush (candida fungal infection)

Stop receiving ADVENT 1.2GM INJECTION and consult your doctor immediately in case you experience:

Severe allergic reaction, which includes rashes, collapsing or fainting, swelling of the face and throat, which may cause difficulty breathing, fever, joint pain, swollen lymph nodes of the neck, armpits, and groin, and red or purple raised spots on skin due to inflammation of blood vessels
Watery diarrhea with blood or mucus, fever, and abdominal pain that occurs due to inflammation of the large intestine

warnings.details: ADVENT 1.2GM INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless necessary.
ADVENT 1.2GM INJECTION should be used with caution in breastfeeding women as it may pass through breast milk.
Do not drive or operate machinery after receiving ADVENT 1.2GM INJECTION.
ADVENT 1.2GM INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney impairment. It should be used with caution in patients suffering from kidney problems.

ADVENT 1.2GM INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients who had a history of liver problems or jaundice after taking penicillin antibiotics. It should be used with caution in patients suffering from liver disease.
Do not receive ADVENT 1.2GM INJECTION if you are allergic to amoxicillin, clavulanic acid, or any other ingredients in this medicine.
ADVENT 1.2GM INJECTION should be used with caution in children as it may require dose modification.
ADVENT 1.2GM INJECTION should be used with caution in the elderly.

Others

Before receiving ADVENT 1.2GM INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have:

Glandular fever (viral infection causing sore throat, high fever, swelling of salivary glands, etc.)
Not been urinating regularly
Convulsions (fits)
Large intestine inflammation
Urine and blood tests

name: Bactoclav 625mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About BACTOCLAV 625MG TABLET

BACTOCLAV 625MG TABLET is used to manage bacterial infections, including middle ear and sinus infections, respiratory tract infections, genital tract infections, urinary tract infections, skin and soft tissue infections such as dental infections, bone and joint infections, septic abortion, and abdominal infections. The symptoms of bacterial infection include fever, difficulty breathing, pus formation, and pain.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belong to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It works by preventing the growth of bacteria and helps clear up the infection.

BACTOCLAV 625MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have liver problems or jaundice upon taking an antibiotic or amoxicillin-clavulanate. Before taking this medicine, inform your doctor if you are suffering from a hepatic impairment, liver disease, renal impairment, kidney disease, glandular fever, or are unable to pass water properly.

BACTOCLAV 625MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary. It should be used with caution in children (aged below 12 years) and elderly patients (above 50 years).

The common side effects associated with the use of BACTOCLAV 625MG TABLET are diarrhea, thrush (fungal infection in the vagina, skin folds, or mouth), nausea, and vomiting. Contact your doctor immediately if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of BACTOCLAV 625MG TABLET
Manage bacterial infection
mechanismOfAction:
How BACTOCLAV 625MG TABLET Works

BACTOCLAV 625MG TABLET helps in managing bacterial infection where amoxicillin is a penicillin that works by inhibiting the enzymes that help in the synthesis of the integral structural component of the bacterial cell wall whereas clavulanic acid is a beta-lactam (structurally related to penicillin) that works by inactivating an enzyme, namely beta-lactamase, thereby managing the inactivation of amoxicillin.

For Tablet, Capsule: Swallow the tablet with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.
