name: MOX Redimix 125mg Oral Suspension 30ml
introduction:
Introduction About MOX REDIMIX 125MG SYRUP

MOX REDIMIX 125MG SYRUP is an antibiotic medicine used in the management of various bacterial infections such as respiratory tract infections, ear, nose, throat infections, stomach infections (H. Pylori infection), skin infections and urinary tract infections, especially in children. It contains a medicine called amoxycillin which is a powerful antibacterial agent that eradicates the susceptible microorganism that causes the infection.

Do not take MOX REDIMIX 125MG SYRUP if you are allergic to Amoxycillin. Before taking MOX REDIMIX 125MG SYRUP inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, glandular fever, urinary problems, etc. Consult your doctor before taking MOX REDIMIX 125MG SYRUP if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking MOX REDIMIX 125MG SYRUP are nausea, diarrhea and skin rashes. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.
usesDetails:
Uses Of MOX REDIMIX 125MG SYRUP

Management of bacterial infections such as:

Respiratory tract infections
Ear, nose, throat infections
Stomach infections (H. Pylori infection)
Skin infections
Urinary tract infections
mechanismOfAction:
How MOX REDIMIX 125MG SYRUP Works

MOX REDIMIX 125MG SYRUP contains a medicine called Amoxicillin which is a type of antibiotic that belongs to the penicillin group. It works by inhibiting the synthesis of bacterial cell walls. Bacteria have a protective outer layer called the cell wall, which is essential for their survival. Amoxicillin interferes with the enzymes that are responsible for forming the cell wall, specifically targeting the cross-linking process. This weakens the cell wall, causing it to rupture and ultimately leading to the death of the bacteria. This action makes amoxicillin effective against a wide range of bacterial infections.
usageDetails:
How to use MOX REDIMIX 125MG SYRUP

Take MOX REDIMIX 125MG SYRUP as advised by the physician.

For Dry Syrup: Shake the medicine powder for dispersing the powder. Add the sterile water provided along with the package into the dry powder and shake it vigorously for 10-15 mins. Measure the required amount of the medicine in the measuring cup and drink it. Store the reconstituted mixture in refrigerator

For Syrups and Suspension: Shake the medicine well before use. Measure the required quantity of the medicine in the measuring cup provided with the package and drink it immediately.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of the therapy based on your age, body weight and severity of infection.
sideEffects: Allergic reactions (such as skin rashes, itching, swelling of the face, lips, tongue, causing breathing difficulties)

Skin rash or pinpoint flat red round spots under the skin surface or skin bruising, inflammation of blood vessel walls due to an allergic reaction with or without joint pain (arthritis) and kidney problems
Enlargement of the lymph nodes especially under the arms

Fever, chills, headache, skin rashes, itchy reddish-purple patches on the skin especially on the palms of the hands or soles of the feet, changes in skin colour, bumps under the skin, blistering, pustules, peeling, redness, pain, itching, scaling.
Inflammation of the large bowel (colon) with diarrhoea (sometimes containing blood), pain and fever
Severe diarrhoea with bleeding and blisters, redness or bruising of the skin − darker urine or paler stools − yellowing of the skin or the whites of the eyes (jaundice)

Common
Nausea
Diarrhea
Skin rashes
Uncommon
Vomiting

Stop taking MOX REDIMIX 125MG SYRUP and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects:

Allergic reactions (such as skin rashes, itching, swelling of the face, lips, tongue, causing breathing difficulties)
Skin rash or pinpoint flat red round spots under the skin surface or skin bruising, inflammation of blood vessel walls due to an allergic reaction with or without joint pain (arthritis) and kidney problems
Enlargement of the lymph nodes especially under the arms
Fever, chills, headache, skin rashes, itchy reddish-purple patches on the skin especially on the palms of the hands or soles of the feet, changes in skin colour, bumps under the skin, blistering, pustules, peeling, redness, pain, itching, scaling.
Inflammation of the large bowel (colon) with diarrhoea (sometimes containing blood), pain and fever
Severe diarrhoea with bleeding and blisters, redness or bruising of the skin − darker urine or paler stools − yellowing of the skin or the whites of the eyes (jaundice)

MOX REDIMIX 125MG SYRUP should be used with caution in breastfeeding women. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice before taking it.
Do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines if your ability to concentrate is affected by MOX REDIMIX 125MG SYRUP.
MOX REDIMIX 125MG SYRUP should be used with caution in patients with trouble urination or kidney problems. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice.
Do not take MOX REDIMIX 125MG SYRUP if you are allergic to Amoxycillin or to any other ingredients of this medicine.

Are suffering from glandular fever

introduction:
Introduction About EVOXIL ORAL SUSPENSION

EVOXIL ORAL SUSPENSION is an antibiotic medicine used in the management of various bacterial infections such as respiratory tract infections, ear, nose, throat infections, stomach infections (H. Pylori infection), skin infections and urinary tract infections, especially in children. It contains a medicine called amoxycillin which is a powerful antibacterial agent that eradicates the susceptible microorganism that causes the infection.

Do not take EVOXIL ORAL SUSPENSION if you are allergic to Amoxycillin. Before taking EVOXIL ORAL SUSPENSION inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, glandular fever, urinary problems, etc. Consult your doctor before taking EVOXIL ORAL SUSPENSION if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking EVOXIL ORAL SUSPENSION are nausea, diarrhea and skin rashes. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.
usesDetails:
Uses Of EVOXIL ORAL SUSPENSION

Management of bacterial infections such as:

Respiratory tract infections
Ear, nose, throat infections
Stomach infections (H. Pylori infection)
Skin infections
Urinary tract infections
mechanismOfAction:
How EVOXIL ORAL SUSPENSION Works

EVOXIL ORAL SUSPENSION contains a medicine called Amoxicillin which is a type of antibiotic that belongs to the penicillin group. It works by inhibiting the synthesis of bacterial cell walls. Bacteria have a protective outer layer called the cell wall, which is essential for their survival. Amoxicillin interferes with the enzymes that are responsible for forming the cell wall, specifically targeting the cross-linking process. This weakens the cell wall, causing it to rupture and ultimately leading to the death of the bacteria. This action makes amoxicillin effective against a wide range of bacterial infections.
usageDetails:
How to use EVOXIL ORAL SUSPENSION

Take EVOXIL ORAL SUSPENSION as advised by the physician.

For Dry Syrup: Shake the medicine powder for dispersing the powder. Add the sterile water provided along with the package into the dry powder and shake it vigorously for 10-15 mins. Measure the required amount of the medicine in the measuring cup and drink it. Store the reconstituted mixture in refrigerator

For Syrups and Suspension: Shake the medicine well before use. Measure the required quantity of the medicine in the measuring cup provided with the package and drink it immediately.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of the therapy based on your age, body weight and severity of infection.

introduction:
Introduction About FIGHTOX FORTE DRY SYRUP

FIGHTOX FORTE DRY SYRUP is used to manage bacterial infections such as middle ear and sinus infections, respiratory tract infections, genital tract infections, urinary tract infections, skin and soft tissue infections such as dental infections, bone and joint infections, septic abortion (any abortion complicated by uterine infection), and abdominal infections. The symptoms of a bacterial infection may include fever, difficulty breathing, pus formation, and pain.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It works by preventing the growth of bacteria and helps clear up the infection.

Do not take FIGHTOX FORTE DRY SYRUP if you have a history of hypersensitivity to beta-lactams, including penicillin and cephalosporins, or any other ingredients of this medicine. It is not recommended for use if you have a history of amoxicillin-clavulanate-associated jaundice or hepatic dysfunction.

Before taking FIGHTOX FORTE DRY SYRUP, inform your doctor if you are suffering from hepatic or renal impairment. This medicine should be used with caution in pregnant women and only when necessary.

In breastfeeding women, it should be used with caution. FIGHTOX FORTE DRY SYRUP should be used with caution in children (aged below 12 years) and elderly patients (above 50 years).

The common side effects associated with the use of FIGHTOX FORTE DRY SYRUP are diarrhea, thrush (a fungal infection in the vagina, skin folds, or mouth), nausea, and vomiting. Contact your doctor immediately if any of the symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About HUELIN 24LAC IU INJECTION

HUELIN 24LAC IU INJECTION contains Benzathine penicillin which belong to the group of medicine called Antibiotics. It is used in adults, children and neonates for the management of wide range of bacterial infections such as erysipelas (infection of upper layer of the skin), syphilis (bacterial infection usually spread by sexual contact), tropical infectious skin diseases, such as yaws or pinta.

It is also used to manage rheumatic fever (disease that affect heart, brain, joints and skin) and post streptococcal glomerulonephritis (a specific form of kidney inflammation) and erysipelas (skin infection).

HUELIN 24LAC IU INJECTION is not recommended for use if you have ever had an allergic reaction (skin rash or swelling of the face or neck) to any antibiotic. Consult your doctor before receiving it.

HUELIN 24LAC IU INJECTION should be used with caution in patients suffering from lung problems such as allergic asthma, allergy, hay fever, kidney, liver problems. Consult your doctor before receiving it.

HUELIN 24LAC IU INJECTION should be used during pregnancy only if clearly necessary. It should be used with caution in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before receiving it.

HUELIN 24LAC IU INJECTION should be used with caution in children and in elderly patients. The most common side effect of receiving this medicine is fungal infection (candidiasis), diarrhea, nausea. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

name: Flemiclav Forte Dry Syrup 30ml
introduction:
Introduction About FLEMICLAV FORTE DRY SYRUP

FLEMICLAV FORTE DRY SYRUP is used to manage bacterial infections such as middle ear and sinus infections, respiratory tract infections, genital tract infections, urinary tract infections, skin and soft tissue infections such as dental infections, bone and joint infections, septic abortion (any abortion complicated by uterine infection), and abdominal infections. The symptoms of a bacterial infection may include fever, difficulty breathing, pus formation, and pain.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It works by preventing the growth of bacteria and helps clear up the infection.

Do not take FLEMICLAV FORTE DRY SYRUP if you have a history of hypersensitivity to beta-lactams, including penicillin and cephalosporins, or any other ingredients of this medicine. It is not recommended for use if you have a history of amoxicillin-clavulanate-associated jaundice or hepatic dysfunction.

Before taking FLEMICLAV FORTE DRY SYRUP, inform your doctor if you are suffering from hepatic or renal impairment. This medicine should be used with caution in pregnant women and only when necessary.

In breastfeeding women, it should be used with caution. FLEMICLAV FORTE DRY SYRUP should be used with caution in children (aged below 12 years) and elderly patients (above 50 years).

The common side effects associated with the use of FLEMICLAV FORTE DRY SYRUP are diarrhea, thrush (a fungal infection in the vagina, skin folds, or mouth), nausea, and vomiting. Contact your doctor immediately if any of the symptoms worsen.

name: LABMOX 500 Capsule 10's
introduction:
Introduction About LABMOX 500 CAPSULE

LABMOX 500 CAPSULE is an antibiotic medicine used in the management of various bacterial infections such as respiratory tract infections, ear, nose, throat infections, stomach infections (H. Pylori infection), skin infections and urinary tract infections. It contains a medicine called amoxycillin which is a powerful antibacterial agent that eradicates the susceptible microorganism that causes the infection.

Take LABMOX 500 CAPSULE as advised by the physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Do not skip doses or stop therapy with LABMOX 500 CAPSULE without consulting your doctor, as it will make this medicine less effective against the bacteria which causes infection.

Therefore, make sure to complete the duration of therapy as suggested by your doctor for fast recovery. Do not take LABMOX 500 CAPSULE if you are allergic to Amoxycillin. Before taking LABMOX 500 CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, glandular fever, urinary problems, etc. Consult your doctor before taking LABMOX 500 CAPSULE if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking LABMOX 500 CAPSULE are nausea, diarrhea and skin rashes. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LABMOX 500 CAPSULE

Management of bacterial infections such as:

Respiratory tract infections
Ear, nose, throat infections
Stomach infections (H. Pylori infection)
Skin infections
Urinary tract infections
mechanismOfAction:
How LABMOX 500 CAPSULE Works

LABMOX 500 CAPSULE contains a medicine called Amoxicillin which is a type of antibiotic that belongs to the penicillin group. It works by inhibiting the synthesis of bacterial cell walls. Bacteria have a protective outer layer called the cell wall, which is essential for their survival. Amoxicillin interferes with the enzymes that are responsible for forming the cell wall, specifically targeting the cross-linking process. This weakens the cell wall, causing it to rupture and ultimately leading to the death of the bacteria. This action makes amoxicillin effective against a wide range of bacterial infections.
usageDetails:

introduction:
Introduction About CLAMP KID FORTE TABLET

CLAMP KID FORTE TABLET is used to manage bacterial infections, including middle ear and sinus infections, respiratory tract infections, genital tract infections, urinary tract infections, skin and soft tissue infections such as dental infections, bone and joint infections, septic abortion, and abdominal infections. The symptoms of bacterial infection include fever, difficulty breathing, pus formation, and pain.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belong to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It works by preventing the growth of bacteria and helps clear up the infection.

CLAMP KID FORTE TABLET is not recommended for use if you have liver problems or jaundice upon taking an antibiotic or amoxicillin-clavulanate. Before taking this medicine, inform your doctor if you are suffering from a hepatic impairment, liver disease, renal impairment, kidney disease, glandular fever, or are unable to pass water properly.

CLAMP KID FORTE TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary. It should be used with caution in children (aged below 12 years) and elderly patients (above 50 years).

The common side effects associated with the use of CLAMP KID FORTE TABLET are diarrhea, thrush (fungal infection in the vagina, skin folds, or mouth), nausea, and vomiting. Contact your doctor immediately if any of the symptoms worsen.

name: Clavam Drops 10ml
introduction:
Introduction About CLAVAM DROPS

Clavam Drops 10ml is a prescription antibiotic formulation that contains a combination of Amoxicillin and Clavulanic Acid, belonging to the penicillin group of medicines. This dual-action composition helps control bacterial growth and enhances the effectiveness of the antibiotic against resistant strains. Clavam Drops is widely recommended for infants and young children under medical guidance, especially for conditions involving the ear, throat, lungs, urinary tract, skin, bones, joints, and dental areas. This formulation is designed for easy oral administration and gentle action on the digestive system when given as directed by a paediatrician.      

It is suitable for infants and children aged below one year, where bacterial infections are suspected and a pediatric antibiotic is required. The drops should be given after food, as this helps improve absorption and minimizes stomach upset. Always shake the bottle well before use and measure the dose accurately using the provided dropper. The dosage and duration depend on your child’s weight, age, and the severity of infection as assessed by the doctor. Maintaining equal time intervals between doses ensures steady antibiotic levels in the bloodstream for optimal results. 

Clavam Drops should be used with caution in children with a history of liver problems, kidney impairment, or allergies to penicillin or cephalosporin antibiotics. Inform your doctor about any existing medical conditions or other medicines your child may be taking. If mild side effects such as nausea, loose stools, or mild rashes occur, they usually subside once the medicine is stopped. However, persistent symptoms, signs of allergic reactions, or unusual tiredness should be reported immediately. Avoid self-medicating or reusing leftover drops from previous prescriptions.  

It is specifically formulated for pediatric use and is not intended for adults. However, for pregnant or breastfeeding mothers administering the medicine to their infants, it is important to seek medical advice before use. Small amounts of the antibiotic can pass into breast milk, so monitoring for mild digestive disturbances or rashes in the baby is advised. Maintaining hydration, offering a balanced diet, and following correct dosage schedules can help ensure safe and effective use of Clavam Drops.
uses: Used to manage bacterial infections in children
usesDetails:

Used to manage bacterial infections in children
mechanismOfAction:
How CLAVAM DROPS Works
Mechanism of Action of Clavam Drops 10ml

Clavam Drops 10ml contains two key ingredients Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid.

Amoxicillin is a broad-spectrum antibiotic that works by interfering with bacterial cell wall formation, causing the bacteria to weaken and eventually get destroyed.
Some bacteria produce enzymes (beta-lactamases) that make them resistant to Amoxicillin alone.
Clavulanic acid blocks these beta-lactamase enzymes, protecting Amoxicillin and allowing it to work effectively against resistant bacteria.
This dual-action mechanism broadens the antibacterial coverage and helps in effectively managing bacterial infections under medical supervision. Together, these components make Clavam Drops a reliable antibiotic option for infants and children when prescribed by a doctor.
usageInstructions: Always give Clavam Drops 10ml exactly as prescribed by your child’s doctor.
Shake the bottle well before each use to ensure the medicine is evenly mixed.
Use the provided dropper or measuring cup to measure the correct dose accurately.
It is generally advised to give the medicine after food to reduce stomach discomfort.
Administer the drops at evenly spaced time intervals for best results.
Do not skip doses or stop early, even if your child appears better.
If your child vomits within 15 minutes of taking the dose, consult your doctor for advice.
Always wash the dropper after use and store the bottle in the refrigerator after mixing.

introduction:
Introduction About MOX KID DT 125MG TABLET

MOX KID DT 125MG TABLET is an antibiotic medicine used in the management of various bacterial infections such as respiratory tract infections, ear, nose, throat infections, stomach infections (H. Pylori infection), skin infections and urinary tract infections, especially in children. It contains a medicine called amoxycillin which is a powerful antibacterial agent that eradicates the susceptible microorganism that causes the infection.

Do not take MOX KID DT 125MG TABLET if you are allergic to Amoxycillin. Before taking MOX KID DT 125MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, glandular fever, urinary problems, etc. Consult your doctor before taking MOX KID DT 125MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking MOX KID DT 125MG TABLET are nausea, diarrhea and skin rashes. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.
usesDetails:

Management of bacterial infections such as:

Respiratory tract infections
Ear, nose, throat infections
Stomach infections (H. Pylori infection)
Skin infections
Urinary tract infections
mechanismOfAction:
How MOX KID DT 125MG TABLET Works

MOX KID DT 125MG TABLET contains a medicine called Amoxicillin which is a type of antibiotic that belongs to the penicillin group. It works by inhibiting the synthesis of bacterial cell walls. Bacteria have a protective outer layer called the cell wall, which is essential for their survival. Amoxicillin interferes with the enzymes that are responsible for forming the cell wall, specifically targeting the cross-linking process. This weakens the cell wall, causing it to rupture and ultimately leading to the death of the bacteria. This action makes amoxicillin effective against a wide range of bacterial infections.

Take MOX KID DT 125MG TABLET as advised by the physician. Disperse the medicine in a glass of water before consumption. Do not crush, swallow or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of the therapy based on your age, body weight and severity of infection.

introduction:
Introduction About MOX 125MG ORAL SUSPENSION

MOX 125MG ORAL SUSPENSION is an antibiotic medicine used in the management of various bacterial infections such as respiratory tract infections, ear, nose, throat infections, stomach infections (H. Pylori infection), skin infections and urinary tract infections, especially in children. It contains a medicine called amoxycillin which is a powerful antibacterial agent that eradicates the susceptible microorganism that causes the infection.

Do not take MOX 125MG ORAL SUSPENSION if you are allergic to Amoxycillin. Before taking MOX 125MG ORAL SUSPENSION inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, glandular fever, urinary problems, etc. Consult your doctor before taking MOX 125MG ORAL SUSPENSION if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking MOX 125MG ORAL SUSPENSION are nausea, diarrhea and skin rashes. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.
usesDetails:
Uses Of MOX 125MG ORAL SUSPENSION

Management of bacterial infections such as:

Respiratory tract infections
Ear, nose, throat infections
Stomach infections (H. Pylori infection)
Skin infections
Urinary tract infections
mechanismOfAction:
How MOX 125MG ORAL SUSPENSION Works

MOX 125MG ORAL SUSPENSION contains a medicine called Amoxicillin which is a type of antibiotic that belongs to the penicillin group. It works by inhibiting the synthesis of bacterial cell walls. Bacteria have a protective outer layer called the cell wall, which is essential for their survival. Amoxicillin interferes with the enzymes that are responsible for forming the cell wall, specifically targeting the cross-linking process. This weakens the cell wall, causing it to rupture and ultimately leading to the death of the bacteria. This action makes amoxicillin effective against a wide range of bacterial infections.
usageDetails:
How to use MOX 125MG ORAL SUSPENSION

Take MOX 125MG ORAL SUSPENSION as advised by the physician.

For Dry Syrup: Shake the medicine powder for dispersing the powder. Add the sterile water provided along with the package into the dry powder and shake it vigorously for 10-15 mins. Measure the required amount of the medicine in the measuring cup and drink it. Store the reconstituted mixture in refrigerator

For Syrups and Suspension: Shake the medicine well before use. Measure the required quantity of the medicine in the measuring cup provided with the package and drink it immediately.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of the therapy based on your age, body weight and severity of infection.

introduction:
Introduction About MOX REDIMIX 125MG ORAL SUSPENSION

MOX REDIMIX 125MG ORAL SUSPENSION is an antibiotic medicine used in the management of various bacterial infections such as respiratory tract infections, ear, nose, throat infections, stomach infections (H. Pylori infection), skin infections and urinary tract infections, especially in children. It contains a medicine called amoxycillin which is a powerful antibacterial agent that eradicates the susceptible microorganism that causes the infection.

Do not take MOX REDIMIX 125MG ORAL SUSPENSION if you are allergic to Amoxycillin. Before taking MOX REDIMIX 125MG ORAL SUSPENSION inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, glandular fever, urinary problems, etc. Consult your doctor before taking MOX REDIMIX 125MG ORAL SUSPENSION if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking MOX REDIMIX 125MG ORAL SUSPENSION are nausea, diarrhea and skin rashes. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.
usesDetails:
Uses Of MOX REDIMIX 125MG ORAL SUSPENSION

Management of bacterial infections such as:

Respiratory tract infections
Ear, nose, throat infections
Stomach infections (H. Pylori infection)
Skin infections
Urinary tract infections
mechanismOfAction:
How MOX REDIMIX 125MG ORAL SUSPENSION Works

MOX REDIMIX 125MG ORAL SUSPENSION contains a medicine called Amoxicillin which is a type of antibiotic that belongs to the penicillin group. It works by inhibiting the synthesis of bacterial cell walls. Bacteria have a protective outer layer called the cell wall, which is essential for their survival. Amoxicillin interferes with the enzymes that are responsible for forming the cell wall, specifically targeting the cross-linking process. This weakens the cell wall, causing it to rupture and ultimately leading to the death of the bacteria. This action makes amoxicillin effective against a wide range of bacterial infections.
usageDetails:
How to use MOX REDIMIX 125MG ORAL SUSPENSION

Take MOX REDIMIX 125MG ORAL SUSPENSION as advised by the physician.

For Dry Syrup: Shake the medicine powder for dispersing the powder. Add the sterile water provided along with the package into the dry powder and shake it vigorously for 10-15 mins. Measure the required amount of the medicine in the measuring cup and drink it. Store the reconstituted mixture in refrigerator

For Syrups and Suspension: Shake the medicine well before use. Measure the required quantity of the medicine in the measuring cup provided with the package and drink it immediately.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of the therapy based on your age, body weight and severity of infection.

introduction:
Introduction About MEDMOX CV 625MG TABLET

MEDMOX CV 625MG TABLET is used to manage bacterial infections, including middle ear and sinus infections, respiratory tract infections, genital tract infections, urinary tract infections, skin and soft tissue infections such as dental infections, bone and joint infections, septic abortion, and abdominal infections. The symptoms of bacterial infection include fever, difficulty breathing, pus formation, and pain.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belong to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It works by preventing the growth of bacteria and helps clear up the infection.

MEDMOX CV 625MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have liver problems or jaundice upon taking an antibiotic or amoxicillin-clavulanate. Before taking this medicine, inform your doctor if you are suffering from a hepatic impairment, liver disease, renal impairment, kidney disease, glandular fever, or are unable to pass water properly.

MEDMOX CV 625MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary. It should be used with caution in children (aged below 12 years) and elderly patients (above 50 years).

The common side effects associated with the use of MEDMOX CV 625MG TABLET are diarrhea, thrush (fungal infection in the vagina, skin folds, or mouth), nausea, and vomiting. Contact your doctor immediately if any of the symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About NOVAMOX DROPS

NOVAMOX DROPS contains Amoxycillin which belongs to the group of medicines called Penicillin. NOVAMOX DROPS is used to manage bacterial infections in pediatric patients caused by susceptible strains of gram-positive and gram-negative bacteria that affect different parts of the body.

It is also used in combination with other medicines in pediatric patients to manage stomach ulcers.

NOVAMOX DROPS is not recommended for use in children allergic to amoxicillin, penicillin, and/or other antibiotics.

Before administering NOVAMOX DROPS, inform your doctor if the child has glandular fever (viral infection caused by Epstein Barr Virus), is unable to urinate regularly, has kidney problems, and/or liver problems (such as hepatic impairment).

NOVAMOX DROPS is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women since it is used only in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). It is also not recommended for use in elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking NOVAMOX DROPS are skin rash, nausea and diarrhoea. Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.
uses: To manage bacterial infections caused by susceptible strains of gram-positive and gram-negative bacteria that affect different parts of the body
To manage stomach ulcers (in combination with other medicines)
usesDetails:
Uses Of NOVAMOX DROPS

Used in paediatric patients:

To manage bacterial infections caused by susceptible strains of gram-positive and gram-negative bacteria that affect different parts of the body
To manage stomach ulcers (in combination with other medicines)
mechanismOfAction:
How NOVAMOX DROPS Works

NOVAMOX DROPS works by inhibiting the synthesis of penicillin-binding proteins which leads to the activation of autolytic enzymes in bacterial cell wall resulting in lysis/destruction of bacterial cell wall thus managing the spread of infection in affected children.
usageDetails:
How to use NOVAMOX DROPS

Administer NOVAMOX DROPS in a child as advised by your physician. Shake well before use. Your doctor will decide the exact dose and duration of management for the child depending on the child’s age, body weight and disease condition.
sideEffects: Mild itchy rash (round, pink-red patches), ‘hive-like’ swollen areas on the forearms, legs, palms, hands or feet
Signs of allergic reactions such as skin itching/rash, swelling of the face/lips/tongue/body, and/or breathing difficulties
Signs of inflammation of blood vessel walls (due to allergic reaction) such as rash/pinpoint red round spots under the skin surface or bruising of the skin, joint pain (arthritis) and kidney problems
Signs of a delayed allergic reaction (that occurs usually after 7 to 12 days of use) such as rashes, rashes, fever, joint pains and enlargement of lymph nodes under the arms

introduction:
Introduction About ACUCLAV KID TABLET

ACUCLAV KID TABLET is used to manage bacterial infections, including middle ear and sinus infections, respiratory tract infections, genital tract infections, urinary tract infections, skin and soft tissue infections such as dental infections, bone and joint infections, septic abortion, and abdominal infections. The symptoms of bacterial infection include fever, difficulty breathing, pus formation, and pain.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belong to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It works by preventing the growth of bacteria and helps clear up the infection.

ACUCLAV KID TABLET is not recommended for use if you have liver problems or jaundice upon taking an antibiotic or amoxicillin-clavulanate. Before taking this medicine, inform your doctor if you are suffering from a hepatic impairment, liver disease, renal impairment, kidney disease, glandular fever, or are unable to pass water properly.

ACUCLAV KID TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary. It should be used with caution in children (aged below 12 years) and elderly patients (above 50 years).

The common side effects associated with the use of ACUCLAV KID TABLET are diarrhea, thrush (fungal infection in the vagina, skin folds, or mouth), nausea, and vomiting. Contact your doctor immediately if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ACUCLAV KID TABLET
Manage bacterial infection
mechanismOfAction:
How ACUCLAV KID TABLET Works

ACUCLAV KID TABLET helps in managing bacterial infection where amoxicillin is a penicillin that works by inhibiting the enzymes that help in the synthesis of the integral structural component of the bacterial cell wall whereas clavulanic acid is a beta-lactam (structurally related to penicillin) that works by inactivating an enzyme, namely beta-lactamase, thereby managing the inactivation of amoxicillin.
usageInstructions: Take this medicine as advised by your physician.
For Tablet, Capsule: Swallow the tablet with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse ACUCLAV KID TABLET in the specified quantity of water as mentioned in the label.
Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

name: SULTAZIDE 375mg Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About SULTAZIDE 375MG TABLET

SULTAZIDE 375MG TABLET contains Sultamicillin which belongs to the group of medicines called Penicillins. SULTAZIDE 375MG TABLET is used to manage upper respiratory tract infections (such as sinusitis, otitis media, tonsillitis), lower respiratory tract infections (such as bacterial pneumonias, bronchitis), urinary tract infections, pyelonephritis (inflammation of kidney), skin & soft tissue infections, and gonococcal infections (sexually transmitted disease) in affected individuals.

SULTAZIDE 375MG TABLET is also indicated in patients who require sulbactam/ampicillin therapy (antibacterial therapy) following initial therapy with intramuscular/intravenous sulbactam/ampicillin medicine. SULTAZIDE 375MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Sultamicillin. It is also not recommended for use in patients with infectious mononucleosis (a viral infection), galactose intolerance, Lapp-lactase deficiency, and/or glucose-galactose malabsorption (rare hereditary problems).

Before taking SULTAZIDE 375MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you had previously suffered from hypersensitivity reactions (to penicillins, cephalosporins, carbapenems, and/or other beta-lactam antibiotic agents), and/or have kidney problems (such as severe renal impairment), and/or liver problems (such as liver dysfunction).

SULTAZIDE 375MG TABLET should be used with caution during pregnancy only if it is clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through breast milk.

SULTAZIDE 375MG TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) which is also advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years/above) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking SULTAZIDE 375MG TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, stomach pain, itching, and/or rashes. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

name: Augmentin 1.2Gm Injection 1's
introduction:
Introduction About AUGMENTIN 1.2GM INJECTION

AUGMENTIN 1.2GM INJECTION is used in the management of various bacterial infections such as respiratory tract infections (pneumonia, acute exacerbation of chronic bronchitis), urinary tract infections (cystitis, urethritis, pyelonephritis), bone and joint infections (osteomyelitis), middle ear infections (otitis media), tonsillitis, sinusitis, skin and soft tissue infections such as cellulitis, boils, wound infections, intra-abdominal sepsis, dental infections, and infections of genital organs in females.

AUGMENTIN 1.2GM INJECTION is also used as prophylaxis against various bacterial infections associated with major surgeries of the heart, joints, kidney, head and neck, stomach, biliary tract, intestine, and pelvic region. Along with management with this medicine, your doctor might order bacterial culture tests to enhance the outcomes of the management.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belong to the group of medicines called Penicillins and Beta-Lactamase Inhibitors. It works by preventing the growth of the bacteria and thus clearing up the infection.

AUGMENTIN 1.2GM INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney impairment who had a history of liver problems or jaundice after taking penicillin antibiotics. It should be used with caution in patients suffering from glandular fever (a viral infection causing sore throat, high fever, swelling of salivary glands, etc.), liver disease, kidney disease, who are not passing urine daily, convulsions (fits), or large intestine inflammation.

AUGMENTIN 1.2GM INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless necessary. It should be used with caution in breastfeeding women, as it may pass through breast milk. AUGMENTIN 1.2GM INJECTION should be used with caution in children as it may require dose modification.

The most common side effects after receiving AUGMENTIN 1.2GM INJECTION are diarrhea, thrush (fungal infection), etc. Consult your doctor immediately if any of your symptoms get worse or persist.
usesDetails:
Uses Of AUGMENTIN 1.2GM INJECTION
Management of various bacterial infections
mechanismOfAction:
How AUGMENTIN 1.2GM INJECTION Works

AUGMENTIN 1.2GM INJECTION helps in managing bacterial infection, where Amoxicillin works by inhibiting penicillin-binding proteins (which are involved in the synthesis of the bacterial cell wall), leading to the activation of autolytic enzymes in the bacterial cell wall. Therefore, leading to lysis of the cell wall and death of the bacterial cell, clavulanic acid inhibits the activity of bacterial enzymes known as beta-lactamases and hence enhances the antibacterial activity of amoxicillin.

introduction:
Introduction About NOVAMOX CV 228.5MG TANGY ORANGE FLAVOUR DRY SYRUP

NOVAMOX CV 228.5MG TANGY ORANGE FLAVOUR DRY SYRUP is used to manage bacterial infections such as middle ear and sinus infections, respiratory tract infections, genital tract infections, urinary tract infections, skin and soft tissue infections such as dental infections, bone and joint infections, septic abortion (any abortion complicated by uterine infection), and abdominal infections. The symptoms of a bacterial infection may include fever, difficulty breathing, pus formation, and pain.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It works by preventing the growth of bacteria and helps clear up the infection.

Do not take NOVAMOX CV 228.5MG TANGY ORANGE FLAVOUR DRY SYRUP if you have a history of hypersensitivity to beta-lactams, including penicillin and cephalosporins, or any other ingredients of this medicine. It is not recommended for use if you have a history of amoxicillin-clavulanate-associated jaundice or hepatic dysfunction.

Before taking NOVAMOX CV 228.5MG TANGY ORANGE FLAVOUR DRY SYRUP, inform your doctor if you are suffering from hepatic or renal impairment. This medicine should be used with caution in pregnant women and only when necessary.

In breastfeeding women, it should be used with caution. NOVAMOX CV 228.5MG TANGY ORANGE FLAVOUR DRY SYRUP should be used with caution in children (aged below 12 years) and elderly patients (above 50 years).

The common side effects associated with the use of NOVAMOX CV 228.5MG TANGY ORANGE FLAVOUR DRY SYRUP are diarrhea, thrush (a fungal infection in the vagina, skin folds, or mouth), nausea, and vomiting. Contact your doctor immediately if any of the symptoms worsen.

name: TIPCIL 2.25gm Injection 1's
introduction:
Introduction About TIPCIL 2.25GM INJECTION

TIPCIL 2.25GM INJECTION is a combination of Piperacillin and Tazobactam which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage several bacterial infections such as lower respiratory tract infections such as pneumonia, acute bacterial exacerbation causing breathing difficulties, urinary tract infections, pyelonephritis, skin infections, abdominal, biliary tract infections and female pelvic infections such as postpartum endometritis or pelvic inflammatory disease, bacteraemia, and bacterial meningitis in infants and children. It is also used along with other antibacterial agents in the management of neutropenic caused by bacterial infection.

Inform your doctor or your health-care professional before any laboratory tests as TIPCIL 2.25GM INJECTION will interact with medical investigations. Inform your doctor if you are allergic to any antibiotics or other medicines. TIPCIL 2.25GM INJECTION should not be used in patients allergic to penicillin antibiotics, cephalosporin, and other beta-lactam antibiotics. TIPCIL 2.25GM INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with pre-existing diarrhoea, low potassium levels, kidney, and liver diseases.

Avoid concomitant use of other aminoglycoside antibiotics and vancomycin along with this medicine. TIPCIL 2.25GM INJECTION should be used with caution in pregnant and breast-feeding women. TIPCIL 2.25GM INJECTION should be used with caution in children above 2 months and in elderly people. Your doctor will administer the right dose depends on your child’s age, body weight and severity of the infection. The common side effects of TIPCIL 2.25GM INJECTION are diarrhoea, yeast infection, headache, sleeplessness, stomach pain, vomiting, nausea, constipation, skin rash, itching, fever, and injection site reaction.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TIPCIL 2.25GM INJECTION

It is used to manage the following infections:

Intra-abdominal infection
Skin and skin structure infections
Female pelvic infections
Lower respiratory tract infection
Bacterial septicaemia
mechanismOfAction:
How TIPCIL 2.25GM INJECTION Works

TIPCIL 2.25GM INJECTION works by destroying the bacterial growth responsible for causing infections. Piperacillin works by interrupting the cell wall formation by binding with the enzymes responsible for cell wall synthesis. This binding causes defects in the cell wall leading to cell death causing death of the organism. Tazobactam is responsible for the irreversible termination of enzymes (beta- lactamases) that protect the organism from antibiotics and produces less anti-bacterial actions when given alone so it’s always used in combination with other antibiotics. Thus, both the substances works by managing cell growth and function inhibiting bacterial growth.
usageDetails:
How to use TIPCIL 2.25GM INJECTION

TIPCIL 2.25GM INJECTION will be administered into the vein (intravenously) by your doctor or nurse. Your doctor will administer the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

TIPCIL 2.25GM INJECTION should be used with caution in breast-feeding women. Consult your doctor before receiving the medicine.
Do not drive or handle heavy machines if you experience dizziness, drowsiness, tired, or if you have blurred vision while receiving TIPCIL 2.25GM INJECTION.
Consumption of alcohol is not recommended during management with TIPCIL 2.25GM INJECTION.
TIPCIL 2.25GM INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with kidney diseases and patients on haemodialysis. Consult your doctor before receiving the medicine.
TIPCIL 2.25GM INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with liver diseases and patients with abnormal liver tests. Consult your doctor before receiving the medicine.
Do not receive TIPCIL 2.25GM INJECTION if you are allergic to Piperacillin or Tazobactam or to any other ingredients of this medicine.
TIPCIL 2.25GM INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with community-acquired pneumonia and ventilator-associated pneumonia. Consult your doctor before receiving the medicine.

TIPCIL 2.25GM INJECTION should be used with caution in children above 2 months of age. Your doctor will administer the right dose depends on your child’s age, body weight and disease condition. Consult your doctor before receiving the medicine.
TIPCIL 2.25GM INJECTION should be used with caution in elder patients (above 65 years of age). Consult your doctor before receiving the medicine.

Others

Before receiving this medicine inform your doctor if you:

Are suffering from diarrhoea
Have low levels of potassium

introduction:
Introduction About MARZON TABLET

MARZON TABLET contains Sultamicillin which belongs to the group of medicines called Penicillins. MARZON TABLET is used to manage upper respiratory tract infections (such as sinusitis, otitis media, tonsillitis), lower respiratory tract infections (such as bacterial pneumonias, bronchitis), urinary tract infections, pyelonephritis (inflammation of kidney), skin & soft tissue infections, and gonococcal infections (sexually transmitted disease) in affected individuals.

MARZON TABLET is also indicated in patients who require sulbactam/ampicillin therapy (antibacterial therapy) following initial therapy with intramuscular/intravenous sulbactam/ampicillin medicine. MARZON TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Sultamicillin. It is also not recommended for use in patients with infectious mononucleosis (a viral infection), galactose intolerance, Lapp-lactase deficiency, and/or glucose-galactose malabsorption (rare hereditary problems).

Before taking MARZON TABLET, inform your doctor if you had previously suffered from hypersensitivity reactions (to penicillins, cephalosporins, carbapenems, and/or other beta-lactam antibiotic agents), and/or have kidney problems (such as severe renal impairment), and/or liver problems (such as liver dysfunction).

MARZON TABLET should be used with caution during pregnancy only if it is clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through breast milk.

MARZON TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) which is also advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years/above) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking MARZON TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, stomach pain, itching, and/or rashes. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

MARZON TABLET works by inhibiting penicillin binding proteins (responsible for bacterial cell wall formation) which leads to activation of autolytic enzymes in the bacterial cell wall resulting in its destruction thus managing the spread of infection in affected individuals.

AMPOXIN KID 125MG TABLET is a combination of Ampicillin and Cloxacillin which belongs to the group of medicines called Penicillin Antibiotics. It is used to manage respiratory tract infections like bronchopneumonia, acute exacerbations of chronic bronchitis, post-operative wound infections, postoperative pulmonary infections, puerperal fever and other infections such as septicaemia, pelvic infections, urinary tract infections, skin and soft tissue infections, and gastrointestinal infections, bone infections like Ex. osteomyelitis, ear, nose and throat infections.

Before taking AMPOXIN KID 125MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have liver or kidney disease. AMPOXIN KID 125MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless clearly necessary. Contact your doctor before taking it.

AMPOXIN KID 125MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Contact your doctor before taking.

AMPOXIN KID 125MG TABLET is not recommended for use in neonates with jaundice and should be used with caution in children. Contact your doctor before taking.

AMPOXIN KID 125MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years). Contact your doctor before taking.

The most common side effects of this medicine are nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, stomach pain or stomach upset and skin rash. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About MEGA CV DRY SYRUP

MEGA CV DRY SYRUP is used to manage bacterial infections such as middle ear and sinus infections, respiratory tract infections, genital tract infections, urinary tract infections, skin and soft tissue infections such as dental infections, bone and joint infections, septic abortion (any abortion complicated by uterine infection), and abdominal infections. The symptoms of a bacterial infection may include fever, difficulty breathing, pus formation, and pain.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It works by preventing the growth of bacteria and helps clear up the infection.

Do not take MEGA CV DRY SYRUP if you have a history of hypersensitivity to beta-lactams, including penicillin and cephalosporins, or any other ingredients of this medicine. It is not recommended for use if you have a history of amoxicillin-clavulanate-associated jaundice or hepatic dysfunction.

Before taking MEGA CV DRY SYRUP, inform your doctor if you are suffering from hepatic or renal impairment. This medicine should be used with caution in pregnant women and only when necessary.

In breastfeeding women, it should be used with caution. MEGA CV DRY SYRUP should be used with caution in children (aged below 12 years) and elderly patients (above 50 years).

The common side effects associated with the use of MEGA CV DRY SYRUP are diarrhea, thrush (a fungal infection in the vagina, skin folds, or mouth), nausea, and vomiting. Contact your doctor immediately if any of the symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About TAZAR 2.25GM INJECTION

TAZAR 2.25GM INJECTION is a combination of Piperacillin and Tazobactam which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage several bacterial infections such as lower respiratory tract infections such as pneumonia, acute bacterial exacerbation causing breathing difficulties, urinary tract infections, pyelonephritis, skin infections, abdominal, biliary tract infections and female pelvic infections such as postpartum endometritis or pelvic inflammatory disease, bacteraemia, and bacterial meningitis in infants and children. It is also used along with other antibacterial agents in the management of neutropenic caused by bacterial infection.

Inform your doctor or your health-care professional before any laboratory tests as TAZAR 2.25GM INJECTION will interact with medical investigations. Inform your doctor if you are allergic to any antibiotics or other medicines. TAZAR 2.25GM INJECTION should not be used in patients allergic to penicillin antibiotics, cephalosporin, and other beta-lactam antibiotics. TAZAR 2.25GM INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with pre-existing diarrhoea, low potassium levels, kidney, and liver diseases.

Avoid concomitant use of other aminoglycoside antibiotics and vancomycin along with this medicine. TAZAR 2.25GM INJECTION should be used with caution in pregnant and breast-feeding women. TAZAR 2.25GM INJECTION should be used with caution in children above 2 months and in elderly people. Your doctor will administer the right dose depends on your child’s age, body weight and severity of the infection. The common side effects of TAZAR 2.25GM INJECTION are diarrhoea, yeast infection, headache, sleeplessness, stomach pain, vomiting, nausea, constipation, skin rash, itching, fever, and injection site reaction.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TAZAR 2.25GM INJECTION

It is used to manage the following infections:

Intra-abdominal infection
Skin and skin structure infections
Female pelvic infections
Lower respiratory tract infection
Bacterial septicaemia
mechanismOfAction:
How TAZAR 2.25GM INJECTION Works

TAZAR 2.25GM INJECTION works by destroying the bacterial growth responsible for causing infections. Piperacillin works by interrupting the cell wall formation by binding with the enzymes responsible for cell wall synthesis. This binding causes defects in the cell wall leading to cell death causing death of the organism. Tazobactam is responsible for the irreversible termination of enzymes (beta- lactamases) that protect the organism from antibiotics and produces less anti-bacterial actions when given alone so it’s always used in combination with other antibiotics. Thus, both the substances works by managing cell growth and function inhibiting bacterial growth.
usageDetails:
How to use TAZAR 2.25GM INJECTION

TAZAR 2.25GM INJECTION will be administered into the vein (intravenously) by your doctor or nurse. Your doctor will administer the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About MOX CV DROPS

MOX CV DROPS is used in infants for the management of various bacterial infections such as respiratory tract infections, urinary tract infections, bone and joint infections, middle ear infections (otitis media), tonsillitis, sinusitis, skin, and soft tissue infections such as cellulitis, animal bites, etc.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belong to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It works by preventing the growth of the bacteria, thus clearing up the infection.

MOX CV DROPS is not recommended for children with a history of severe kidney impairment, history of liver problems, or jaundice after taking penicillin antibiotics. It should be used with caution in children suffering from glandular fever (viral infection causing sore throat, high fever, swelling of salivary glands), liver disease, or kidney disease who are not passing urine daily.

MOX CV DROPS is for pediatric use only. It should be used with caution in neonates and infants less than 12 weeks of age. The most common side effects after giving MOX CV DROPS are vomiting, diarrhea, nausea, and thrush (fungal infections). Consult your doctor immediately if your child experiences any of the above side effects.

mechanismOfAction:
How MOX CV DROPS Works

MOX CV DROPS work against bacterial infections. Amoxicillin in Clavam stops bacteria from making their cell walls, causing them to break apart and die. Clavulanic acid in Clavam stops bacteria from destroying amoxicillin, making it more effective at killing bacteria. So together, they help kill bacteria and manage infections.

Introduction About MOXCLAV BD DISTAB 228.5MG TABLET

MOXCLAV BD DISTAB 228.5MG TABLET is used to manage bacterial infections, including middle ear and sinus infections, respiratory tract infections, genital tract infections, urinary tract infections, skin and soft tissue infections such as dental infections, bone and joint infections, septic abortion, and abdominal infections. The symptoms of bacterial infection include fever, difficulty breathing, pus formation, and pain.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belong to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It works by preventing the growth of bacteria and helps clear up the infection.

MOXCLAV BD DISTAB 228.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have liver problems or jaundice upon taking an antibiotic or amoxicillin-clavulanate. Before taking this medicine, inform your doctor if you are suffering from a hepatic impairment, liver disease, renal impairment, kidney disease, glandular fever, or are unable to pass water properly.

MOXCLAV BD DISTAB 228.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary. It should be used with caution in children (aged below 12 years) and elderly patients (above 50 years).

The common side effects associated with the use of MOXCLAV BD DISTAB 228.5MG TABLET are diarrhea, thrush (fungal infection in the vagina, skin folds, or mouth), nausea, and vomiting. Contact your doctor immediately if any of the symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About ADVENT 600MG INJECTION

ADVENT 600MG INJECTION is used in the management of various bacterial infections such as respiratory tract infections (pneumonia, acute exacerbation of chronic bronchitis), urinary tract infections (cystitis, urethritis, pyelonephritis), bone and joint infections (osteomyelitis), middle ear infections (otitis media), tonsillitis, sinusitis, skin and soft tissue infections such as cellulitis, boils, wound infections, intra-abdominal sepsis, dental infections, and infections of genital organs in females.

ADVENT 600MG INJECTION is also used as prophylaxis against various bacterial infections associated with major surgeries of the heart, joints, kidney, head and neck, stomach, biliary tract, intestine, and pelvic region. Along with management with this medicine, your doctor might order bacterial culture tests to enhance the outcomes of the management.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belong to the group of medicines called Penicillins and Beta-Lactamase Inhibitors. It works by preventing the growth of the bacteria and thus clearing up the infection.

ADVENT 600MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney impairment who had a history of liver problems or jaundice after taking penicillin antibiotics. It should be used with caution in patients suffering from glandular fever (a viral infection causing sore throat, high fever, swelling of salivary glands, etc.), liver disease, kidney disease, who are not passing urine daily, convulsions (fits), or large intestine inflammation.

ADVENT 600MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless necessary. It should be used with caution in breastfeeding women, as it may pass through breast milk. ADVENT 600MG INJECTION should be used with caution in children as it may require dose modification.

The most common side effects after receiving ADVENT 600MG INJECTION are diarrhea, thrush (fungal infection), etc. Consult your doctor immediately if any of your symptoms get worse or persist.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ADVENT 600MG INJECTION
Management of various bacterial infections
mechanismOfAction:
How ADVENT 600MG INJECTION Works

ADVENT 600MG INJECTION helps in managing bacterial infection, where Amoxicillin works by inhibiting penicillin-binding proteins (which are involved in the synthesis of the bacterial cell wall), leading to the activation of autolytic enzymes in the bacterial cell wall. Therefore, leading to lysis of the cell wall and death of the bacterial cell, clavulanic acid inhibits the activity of bacterial enzymes known as beta-lactamases and hence enhances the antibacterial activity of amoxicillin.

introduction:
Introduction About PEXOCLAV 625 TABLET

PEXOCLAV 625 TABLET is used to manage bacterial infections, including middle ear and sinus infections, respiratory tract infections, genital tract infections, urinary tract infections, skin and soft tissue infections such as dental infections, bone and joint infections, septic abortion, and abdominal infections. The symptoms of bacterial infection include fever, difficulty breathing, pus formation, and pain.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belong to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It works by preventing the growth of bacteria and helps clear up the infection.

PEXOCLAV 625 TABLET is not recommended for use if you have liver problems or jaundice upon taking an antibiotic or amoxicillin-clavulanate. Before taking this medicine, inform your doctor if you are suffering from a hepatic impairment, liver disease, renal impairment, kidney disease, glandular fever, or are unable to pass water properly.

PEXOCLAV 625 TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary. It should be used with caution in children (aged below 12 years) and elderly patients (above 50 years).

The common side effects associated with the use of PEXOCLAV 625 TABLET are diarrhea, thrush (fungal infection in the vagina, skin folds, or mouth), nausea, and vomiting. Contact your doctor immediately if any of the symptoms worsen.

Manage bacterial infection

PIPZO 2.25GM INJECTION is a combination of Piperacillin and Tazobactam which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. Inform your doctor or your health-care professional before any laboratory tests as PIPZO 2.25GM INJECTION will interact with medical investigations. Inform your doctor if you are allergic to any antibiotics or other medicines. PIPZO 2.25GM INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with pre-existing diarrhoea, low potassium levels, kidney, and liver diseases.

Avoid concomitant use of other aminoglycoside antibiotics and vancomycin along with this medicine. PIPZO 2.25GM INJECTION should be used with caution in pregnant and breast-feeding women. PIPZO 2.25GM INJECTION should be used with caution in children above 2 months and in elderly people. Your doctor will administer the right dose depends on your child’s age, body weight and severity of the infection. The common side effects of PIPZO 2.25GM INJECTION are diarrhoea, yeast infection, headache, sleeplessness, stomach pain, vomiting, nausea, constipation, skin rash, itching, fever, and injection site reaction.

introduction:
Introduction About TAZAR 4.5 COMBIPACK INJECTION

TAZAR 4.5 COMBIPACK INJECTION is used to manage several bacterial infections such as lower respiratory tract infections such as pneumonia, acute bacterial exacerbation causing breathing difficulties, urinary tract infections, pyelonephritis, skin infections, abdominal, biliary tract infections and female pelvic infections such as postpartum endometritis or pelvic inflammatory disease, bacteraemia, and bacterial meningitis in infants and children. TAZAR 4.5 COMBIPACK INJECTION is also used along with other antibacterial agents in the management of neutropenic caused by bacterial infection. TAZAR 4.5 COMBIPACK INJECTION is a combination of Piperacillin and Tazobactam which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics which works by destroying the bacterial growth responsible for causing infections.

Inform your doctor or your health-care professional before any laboratory tests as TAZAR 4.5 COMBIPACK INJECTION will interact with medical investigations. Inform your doctor if you are allergic to any antibiotics or other medicines. TAZAR 4.5 COMBIPACK INJECTION should not be used in patients allergic to penicillin antibiotics, cephalosporin, and other beta-lactam antibiotics. TAZAR 4.5 COMBIPACK INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with pre-existing diarrhoea, low potassium levels, kidney, and liver diseases.

Avoid concomitant use of other aminoglycoside antibiotics and vancomycin along with this medicine. TAZAR 4.5 COMBIPACK INJECTION should be used with caution in pregnant and breast-feeding women. TAZAR 4.5 COMBIPACK INJECTION should be used with caution in children above 2 months and in elderly people. Your doctor will administer the right dose depends on your child’s age, body weight and severity of the infection. The common side effects of TAZAR 4.5 COMBIPACK INJECTION are diarrhoea, yeast infection, headache, sleeplessness, stomach pain, vomiting, nausea, constipation, skin rash, itching, fever, and injection site reaction.
usesDetails:

mechanismOfAction:
How TAZAR 4.5 COMBIPACK INJECTION Works

TAZAR 4.5 COMBIPACK INJECTION works by inhibiting the bacterial growth responsible for causing infections. Piperacillin works by interrupting the cell wall formation by binding with the enzymes responsible for cell wall synthesis. This binding causes defects in the cell wall leading to cell death causing death of the organism. Tazobactam is responsible for the irreversible termination of enzymes (beta- lactamases) that protect the organism from antibiotics and produces less anti-bacterial actions when given alone so it’s always used in combination with other antibiotics. Thus, both the substances works by managing cell growth and function inhibiting bacterial growth.

TAZAR 4.5 COMBIPACK INJECTION will be administered into the vein (intravenously) by your doctor or nurse. Your doctor will administer the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About MOX 125MG DRY SYRUP

MOX 125MG DRY SYRUP is an antibiotic medicine used in the management of various bacterial infections such as respiratory tract infections, ear, nose, throat infections, stomach infections (H. Pylori infection), skin infections and urinary tract infections, especially in children. It contains a medicine called amoxycillin which is a powerful antibacterial agent that eradicates the susceptible microorganism that causes the infection.

Do not take MOX 125MG DRY SYRUP if you are allergic to Amoxycillin. Before taking MOX 125MG DRY SYRUP inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, glandular fever, urinary problems, etc. Consult your doctor before taking MOX 125MG DRY SYRUP if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking MOX 125MG DRY SYRUP are nausea, diarrhea and skin rashes. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.
usesDetails:
Uses Of MOX 125MG DRY SYRUP

Management of bacterial infections such as:

Respiratory tract infections
Ear, nose, throat infections
Stomach infections (H. Pylori infection)
Skin infections
Urinary tract infections
mechanismOfAction:
How MOX 125MG DRY SYRUP Works

MOX 125MG DRY SYRUP contains a medicine called Amoxicillin which is a type of antibiotic that belongs to the penicillin group. It works by inhibiting the synthesis of bacterial cell walls. Bacteria have a protective outer layer called the cell wall, which is essential for their survival. Amoxicillin interferes with the enzymes that are responsible for forming the cell wall, specifically targeting the cross-linking process. This weakens the cell wall, causing it to rupture and ultimately leading to the death of the bacteria. This action makes amoxicillin effective against a wide range of bacterial infections.
usageDetails:
How to use MOX 125MG DRY SYRUP

Take MOX 125MG DRY SYRUP as advised by the physician.

For Dry Syrup: Shake the medicine powder for dispersing the powder. Add the sterile water provided along with the package into the dry powder and shake it vigorously for 10-15 mins. Measure the required amount of the medicine in the measuring cup and drink it. Store the reconstituted mixture in refrigerator

For Syrups and Suspension: Shake the medicine well before use. Measure the required quantity of the medicine in the measuring cup provided with the package and drink it immediately.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of the therapy based on your age, body weight and severity of infection.

Introduction About LACOM CV 625MG TABLET

LACOM CV 625MG TABLET is used to manage bacterial infections, including middle ear and sinus infections, respiratory tract infections, genital tract infections, urinary tract infections, skin and soft tissue infections such as dental infections, bone and joint infections, septic abortion, and abdominal infections. The symptoms of bacterial infection include fever, difficulty breathing, pus formation, and pain.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belong to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It works by preventing the growth of bacteria and helps clear up the infection.

LACOM CV 625MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have liver problems or jaundice upon taking an antibiotic or amoxicillin-clavulanate. Before taking this medicine, inform your doctor if you are suffering from a hepatic impairment, liver disease, renal impairment, kidney disease, glandular fever, or are unable to pass water properly.

LACOM CV 625MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary. It should be used with caution in children (aged below 12 years) and elderly patients (above 50 years).

The common side effects associated with the use of LACOM CV 625MG TABLET are diarrhea, thrush (fungal infection in the vagina, skin folds, or mouth), nausea, and vomiting. Contact your doctor immediately if any of the symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About NOVAMOX 125MG REDIUSE SUSPENSION

NOVAMOX 125MG REDIUSE SUSPENSION is an antibiotic medicine used in the management of various bacterial infections such as respiratory tract infections, ear, nose, throat infections, stomach infections (H. Pylori infection), skin infections and urinary tract infections, especially in children. It contains a medicine called amoxycillin which is a powerful antibacterial agent that eradicates the susceptible microorganism that causes the infection.

Do not take NOVAMOX 125MG REDIUSE SUSPENSION if you are allergic to Amoxycillin. Before taking NOVAMOX 125MG REDIUSE SUSPENSION inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, glandular fever, urinary problems, etc. Consult your doctor before taking NOVAMOX 125MG REDIUSE SUSPENSION if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking NOVAMOX 125MG REDIUSE SUSPENSION are nausea, diarrhea and skin rashes. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.
usesDetails:
Uses Of NOVAMOX 125MG REDIUSE SUSPENSION

Management of bacterial infections such as:

Respiratory tract infections
Ear, nose, throat infections
Stomach infections (H. Pylori infection)
Skin infections
Urinary tract infections
mechanismOfAction:
How NOVAMOX 125MG REDIUSE SUSPENSION Works

NOVAMOX 125MG REDIUSE SUSPENSION contains a medicine called Amoxicillin which is a type of antibiotic that belongs to the penicillin group. It works by inhibiting the synthesis of bacterial cell walls. Bacteria have a protective outer layer called the cell wall, which is essential for their survival. Amoxicillin interferes with the enzymes that are responsible for forming the cell wall, specifically targeting the cross-linking process. This weakens the cell wall, causing it to rupture and ultimately leading to the death of the bacteria. This action makes amoxicillin effective against a wide range of bacterial infections.
usageDetails:
How to use NOVAMOX 125MG REDIUSE SUSPENSION

Take NOVAMOX 125MG REDIUSE SUSPENSION as advised by the physician.

For Dry Syrup: Shake the medicine powder for dispersing the powder. Add the sterile water provided along with the package into the dry powder and shake it vigorously for 10-15 mins. Measure the required amount of the medicine in the measuring cup and drink it. Store the reconstituted mixture in refrigerator

For Syrups and Suspension: Shake the medicine well before use. Measure the required quantity of the medicine in the measuring cup provided with the package and drink it immediately.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of the therapy based on your age, body weight and severity of infection.

introduction:
Introduction About OXIPOD 50MG SUSPENSION

OXIPOD 50MG SUSPENSION is used to manage a variety of bacterial infections in children, such as acute otitis media (inflammation of the middle ear leading to pain and fever), pharyngitis or tonsillitis (sore throat, difficulty swallowing, and tender lymph nodes), and sinusitis (inflammation around the nasal cavity leading to headache and runny nose).

It is also used to manage bronchitis (inflammation of tubes that carry air, leading to difficulty breathing), infection of the urinary tract (cystitis), pneumonia (an infection that inflames the air sacs in one or both lungs), and gonococcal infection (a sexually transmitted disease by indirect contact with an infected parent). 

It contains a medicine called Cefpodoxime, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It works by stopping the growth of the bacteria that causes the infections.

Before giving OXIPOD 50MG SUSPENSION to your child, inform your child’s doctor if your child has or has ever had colitis, liver problems, or impaired kidney function. Your child’s doctor may monitor the blood count and liver enzymes in blood tests during management with this medicine.

OXIPOD 50MG SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in pregnant or breast-feeding women and elderly individuals, as it is used only in children. It is not recommended for use in infants less than 2 months of age.

The most common side effects of taking OXIPOD 50MG SUSPENSION are diarrhea, nausea, abdominal pain, and headache. Consult your child’s doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

OXIPOD 50MG SUSPENSION manages infection by stopping or managing the bacteria from multiplying by inhibiting their cell wall formation, which is essential for the bacteria to survive as it provides protection from the environment. This kind of action that kills bacteria is useful in managing various bacterial infections.

introduction:
Introduction About TAZOPEN 4.5GM INJECTION

TAZOPEN 4.5GM INJECTION is a combination of Piperacillin and Tazobactam which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage several bacterial infections such as lower respiratory tract infections such as pneumonia, acute bacterial exacerbation causing breathing difficulties, urinary tract infections, pyelonephritis, skin infections, abdominal, biliary tract infections and female pelvic infections such as postpartum endometritis or pelvic inflammatory disease, bacteraemia, and bacterial meningitis in infants and children.

It is also used along with other antibacterial agents in the management of neutropenic caused by bacterial infection.

Pneumonia is an infection which causes inflammation in the air sac producing cough with phlegm and shortness of breath. Pyelonephritis is a urinary tract infection affecting the urinary bladder later gets spreads to the kidneys. Bacteraemia is an infectious condition indicating presence of bacteria in the blood stream.

Bacterial meningitis is an infection caused by bacteria in the region surrounding the brain. Neutropenic is low levels of neutrophils (a type of white blood cells) in our body.

Kindly inform your doctor or your health-care professional before any laboratory tests as TAZOPEN 4.5GM INJECTION will interact with medical investigations. Inform your doctor if you are allergic to any antibiotics or other medicines.

TAZOPEN 4.5GM INJECTION should not be used in patients allergic to penicillin antibiotics, cephalosporin, and other beta-lactam antibiotics.

TAZOPEN 4.5GM INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with pre-existing diarrhoea, low potassium levels, kidney, and liver diseases.

Avoid concomitant use of other aminoglycoside antibiotics and vancomycin along with this medicine.

TAZOPEN 4.5GM INJECTION should be used with caution in pregnant and breast-feeding women. TAZOPEN 4.5GM INJECTION should be used with caution in children above 2 months and in elderly people. Your doctor will administer the right dose depends on your child’s age, body weight and severity of the infection.

The common side effects of TAZOPEN 4.5GM INJECTION are diarrhoea, yeast infection, headache, sleeplessness, stomach pain, vomiting, nausea, constipation, skin rash, itching, fever, and injection site reaction.

mechanismOfAction:
How TAZOPEN 4.5GM INJECTION Works

TAZOPEN 4.5GM INJECTION works by destroying the bacterial growth responsible for causing infections. Piperacillin works by interrupting the cell wall formation by binding with the enzymes responsible for cell wall synthesis. This binding causes defects in the cell wall leading to cell death causing death of the organism. Tazobactam is responsible for the irreversible termination of enzymes (beta- lactamases) that protect the organism from antibiotics and produces less anti-bacterial actions when given alone so it’s always used in combination with other antibiotics. Thus, both the substances works by managing cell growth and function inhibiting bacterial growth.

TAZOPEN 4.5GM INJECTION will be administered into the vein (intravenously) by your doctor or nurse. Your doctor will administer the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About AMPILOX C DRY SYRUP

AMPILOX C DRY SYRUP is a combination of Ampicillin and Cloxacillin which belongs to the group of medicines called Penicillin Antibiotics. It is used to manage respiratory tract infections like bronchopneumonia, acute exacerbations of chronic bronchitis, post-operative wound infections, post-operative lung infections, puerperal fever and other infections such as septicaemia, bone infections like osteomyelitis, ear, nose and throat infections.

Before taking AMPILOX C DRY SYRUP inform your doctor if you have liver or kidney disease. There is no proper information on the use of AMPILOX C DRY SYRUP during pregnancy and breastfeeding, and therefore consult your doctor before taking.

AMPILOX C DRY SYRUP should be used with caution in neonates with jaundice and in children. Contact your doctor before taking.

AMPILOX C DRY SYRUP should be used with caution in elderly patients aged 65 years and above. Contact your doctor before taking.

The most common side effects of taking AMPILOX C DRY SYRUP are nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, skin rash, urticaria, pruritus. Contact your doctor if any of the side effects worsen

mechanismOfAction:
How AMPILOX C DRY SYRUP Works

AMPILOX C DRY SYRUP is a combination of Ampicillin and cloxacillin where ampicillin has a broad spectrum of bactericidal activity against many gram-positive and gram-negative aerobic and anaerobic bacteria. It acts through the inhibition of cell wall mucopeptide biosynthesis during the stage of active multiplication. Cloxacillin manages bacteria from reproducing, which allows your body to fight only the existing bacteria.
