introduction:
Introduction About TAZOTER 4.5GM INJECTION

TAZOTER 4.5GM INJECTION is a combination of Piperacillin and Tazobactam which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage several bacterial infections such as lower respiratory tract infections such as pneumonia, acute bacterial exacerbation causing breathing difficulties, urinary tract infections, pyelonephritis, skin infections, abdominal, biliary tract infections and female pelvic infections such as postpartum endometritis or pelvic inflammatory disease, bacteraemia, and bacterial meningitis in infants and children.

It is also used along with other antibacterial agents in the management of neutropenic caused by bacterial infection.

Pneumonia is an infection which causes inflammation in the air sac producing cough with phlegm and shortness of breath. Pyelonephritis is a urinary tract infection affecting the urinary bladder later gets spreads to the kidneys. Bacteraemia is an infectious condition indicating presence of bacteria in the blood stream.

Bacterial meningitis is an infection caused by bacteria in the region surrounding the brain. Neutropenic is low levels of neutrophils (a type of white blood cells) in our body.

Kindly inform your doctor or your health-care professional before any laboratory tests as TAZOTER 4.5GM INJECTION will interact with medical investigations. Inform your doctor if you are allergic to any antibiotics or other medicines.

TAZOTER 4.5GM INJECTION should not be used in patients allergic to penicillin antibiotics, cephalosporin, and other beta-lactam antibiotics.

TAZOTER 4.5GM INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with pre-existing diarrhoea, low potassium levels, kidney, and liver diseases.

Avoid concomitant use of other aminoglycoside antibiotics and vancomycin along with this medicine.

TAZOTER 4.5GM INJECTION should be used with caution in pregnant and breast-feeding women. TAZOTER 4.5GM INJECTION should be used with caution in children above 2 months and in elderly people. Your doctor will administer the right dose depends on your child’s age, body weight and severity of the infection.

The common side effects of TAZOTER 4.5GM INJECTION are diarrhoea, yeast infection, headache, sleeplessness, stomach pain, vomiting, nausea, constipation, skin rash, itching, fever, and injection site reaction.

mechanismOfAction:
How TAZOTER 4.5GM INJECTION Works

TAZOTER 4.5GM INJECTION works by destroying the bacterial growth responsible for causing infections. Piperacillin works by interrupting the cell wall formation by binding with the enzymes responsible for cell wall synthesis. This binding causes defects in the cell wall leading to cell death causing death of the organism. Tazobactam is responsible for the irreversible termination of enzymes (beta- lactamases) that protect the organism from antibiotics and produces less anti-bacterial actions when given alone so it’s always used in combination with other antibiotics. Thus, both the substances works by managing cell growth and function inhibiting bacterial growth.

TAZOTER 4.5GM INJECTION will be administered into the vein (intravenously) by your doctor or nurse. Your doctor will administer the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About SYMBIOTIK XL 375MG TABLET

SYMBIOTIK XL 375MG TABLET is used to manage bacterial infections, including middle ear and sinus infections, respiratory tract infections, genital tract infections, urinary tract infections, skin and soft tissue infections such as dental infections, bone and joint infections, septic abortion, and abdominal infections. The symptoms of bacterial infection include fever, difficulty breathing, pus formation, and pain.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belong to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It works by preventing the growth of bacteria and helps clear up the infection.

SYMBIOTIK XL 375MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have liver problems or jaundice upon taking an antibiotic or amoxicillin-clavulanate. Before taking this medicine, inform your doctor if you are suffering from a hepatic impairment, liver disease, renal impairment, kidney disease, glandular fever, or are unable to pass water properly.

SYMBIOTIK XL 375MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary. It should be used with caution in children (aged below 12 years) and elderly patients (above 50 years).

The common side effects associated with the use of SYMBIOTIK XL 375MG TABLET are diarrhea, thrush (fungal infection in the vagina, skin folds, or mouth), nausea, and vomiting. Contact your doctor immediately if any of the symptoms worsen.

name: Mega CV 1.2Gm Injection 1's
introduction:
Introduction About MEGA CV 1.2GM INJECTION

MEGA CV 1.2GM INJECTION is used in the management of various bacterial infections such as respiratory tract infections (pneumonia, acute exacerbation of chronic bronchitis), urinary tract infections (cystitis, urethritis, pyelonephritis), bone and joint infections (osteomyelitis), middle ear infections (otitis media), tonsillitis, sinusitis, skin and soft tissue infections such as cellulitis, boils, wound infections, intra-abdominal sepsis, dental infections, and infections of genital organs in females.

MEGA CV 1.2GM INJECTION is also used as prophylaxis against various bacterial infections associated with major surgeries of the heart, joints, kidney, head and neck, stomach, biliary tract, intestine, and pelvic region. Along with management with this medicine, your doctor might order bacterial culture tests to enhance the outcomes of the management.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belong to the group of medicines called Penicillins and Beta-Lactamase Inhibitors. It works by preventing the growth of the bacteria and thus clearing up the infection.

MEGA CV 1.2GM INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney impairment who had a history of liver problems or jaundice after taking penicillin antibiotics. It should be used with caution in patients suffering from glandular fever (a viral infection causing sore throat, high fever, swelling of salivary glands, etc.), liver disease, kidney disease, who are not passing urine daily, convulsions (fits), or large intestine inflammation.

MEGA CV 1.2GM INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless necessary. It should be used with caution in breastfeeding women, as it may pass through breast milk. MEGA CV 1.2GM INJECTION should be used with caution in children as it may require dose modification.

The most common side effects after receiving MEGA CV 1.2GM INJECTION are diarrhea, thrush (fungal infection), etc. Consult your doctor immediately if any of your symptoms get worse or persist.
usesDetails:
Uses Of MEGA CV 1.2GM INJECTION
Management of various bacterial infections
mechanismOfAction:
How MEGA CV 1.2GM INJECTION Works

MEGA CV 1.2GM INJECTION helps in managing bacterial infection, where Amoxicillin works by inhibiting penicillin-binding proteins (which are involved in the synthesis of the bacterial cell wall), leading to the activation of autolytic enzymes in the bacterial cell wall. Therefore, leading to lysis of the cell wall and death of the bacterial cell, clavulanic acid inhibits the activity of bacterial enzymes known as beta-lactamases and hence enhances the antibacterial activity of amoxicillin.

name: MOX CV 228.5 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About MOX CV 228.5 TABLET

MOX CV 228.5 TABLET is used to manage bacterial infections, including middle ear and sinus infections, respiratory tract infections, genital tract infections, urinary tract infections, skin and soft tissue infections such as dental infections, bone and joint infections, septic abortion, and abdominal infections. The symptoms of bacterial infection include fever, difficulty breathing, pus formation, and pain.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belong to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It works by preventing the growth of bacteria and helps clear up the infection.

MOX CV 228.5 TABLET is not recommended for use if you have liver problems or jaundice upon taking an antibiotic or amoxicillin-clavulanate. Before taking this medicine, inform your doctor if you are suffering from a hepatic impairment, liver disease, renal impairment, kidney disease, glandular fever, or are unable to pass water properly.

MOX CV 228.5 TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary. It should be used with caution in children (aged below 12 years) and elderly patients (above 50 years).

The common side effects associated with the use of MOX CV 228.5 TABLET are diarrhea, thrush (fungal infection in the vagina, skin folds, or mouth), nausea, and vomiting. Contact your doctor immediately if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:

Manage bacterial infection
mechanismOfAction:
How MOX CV 228.5 TABLET Works

MOX CV 228.5 TABLET helps in managing bacterial infection where amoxicillin is a penicillin that works by inhibiting the enzymes that help in the synthesis of the integral structural component of the bacterial cell wall whereas clavulanic acid is a beta-lactam (structurally related to penicillin) that works by inactivating an enzyme, namely beta-lactamase, thereby managing the inactivation of amoxicillin.

name: Maxotaz 2.25gm Injection 1's
introduction:
Introduction About MAXOTAZ 2.25GM INJECTION

MAXOTAZ 2.25GM INJECTION is a combination of Piperacillin and Tazobactam which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage several bacterial infections such as lower respiratory tract infections such as pneumonia, acute bacterial exacerbation causing breathing difficulties, urinary tract infections, pyelonephritis, skin infections, abdominal, biliary tract infections and female pelvic infections such as postpartum endometritis or pelvic inflammatory disease, bacteraemia, and bacterial meningitis in infants and children. It is also used along with other antibacterial agents in the management of neutropenic caused by bacterial infection.

Inform your doctor or your health-care professional before any laboratory tests as MAXOTAZ 2.25GM INJECTION will interact with medical investigations. Inform your doctor if you are allergic to any antibiotics or other medicines. MAXOTAZ 2.25GM INJECTION should not be used in patients allergic to penicillin antibiotics, cephalosporin, and other beta-lactam antibiotics. MAXOTAZ 2.25GM INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with pre-existing diarrhoea, low potassium levels, kidney, and liver diseases.

Avoid concomitant use of other aminoglycoside antibiotics and vancomycin along with this medicine. MAXOTAZ 2.25GM INJECTION should be used with caution in pregnant and breast-feeding women. MAXOTAZ 2.25GM INJECTION should be used with caution in children above 2 months and in elderly people. Your doctor will administer the right dose depends on your child’s age, body weight and severity of the infection. The common side effects of MAXOTAZ 2.25GM INJECTION are diarrhoea, yeast infection, headache, sleeplessness, stomach pain, vomiting, nausea, constipation, skin rash, itching, fever, and injection site reaction.
usesDetails:
Uses Of MAXOTAZ 2.25GM INJECTION

It is used to manage the following infections:

Intra-abdominal infection
Skin and skin structure infections
Female pelvic infections
Lower respiratory tract infection
Bacterial septicaemia
mechanismOfAction:
How MAXOTAZ 2.25GM INJECTION Works

MAXOTAZ 2.25GM INJECTION works by destroying the bacterial growth responsible for causing infections. Piperacillin works by interrupting the cell wall formation by binding with the enzymes responsible for cell wall synthesis. This binding causes defects in the cell wall leading to cell death causing death of the organism. Tazobactam is responsible for the irreversible termination of enzymes (beta- lactamases) that protect the organism from antibiotics and produces less anti-bacterial actions when given alone so it’s always used in combination with other antibiotics. Thus, both the substances works by managing cell growth and function inhibiting bacterial growth.
usageDetails:
How to use MAXOTAZ 2.25GM INJECTION

MAXOTAZ 2.25GM INJECTION will be administered into the vein (intravenously) by your doctor or nurse. Your doctor will administer the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.
sideEffects: Lack of white blood cells (agranulocytosis), bleeding nose
Inflammation of inner lining of mouth

Serious skin rashes appear as reddish target-like spots or circular patches often with blisters,) ulcers in mouth, throat, nose, extremities, genitals red and swollen eyes (Stevens-Johnson syndrome, dermatitis bullous, dermatitis exfoliative, toxic epidermal necrolysis)
A potentially fatal allergic condition (drug reaction with eosinophilia and systemic symptoms) involving skin and other organs such as the kidney and liver
Skin condition (acute generalised exanthemata’s pustulosis) symptoms include numerous tiny fluids filled blisters with swollen and reddened skin
Swelling of the face, lips, tongue or other parts of the body, shortness of breath, wheezing or trouble breathing (angioedema)
Yellowing of the eyes or skin (jaundice)

Introduction About MOX CV DT 228.5MG TABLET

MOX CV DT 228.5MG TABLET is used to manage bacterial infections, including middle ear and sinus infections, respiratory tract infections, genital tract infections, urinary tract infections, skin and soft tissue infections such as dental infections, bone and joint infections, septic abortion, and abdominal infections. The symptoms of bacterial infection include fever, difficulty breathing, pus formation, and pain.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belong to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It works by preventing the growth of bacteria and helps clear up the infection.

MOX CV DT 228.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have liver problems or jaundice upon taking an antibiotic or amoxicillin-clavulanate. Before taking this medicine, inform your doctor if you are suffering from a hepatic impairment, liver disease, renal impairment, kidney disease, glandular fever, or are unable to pass water properly.

MOX CV DT 228.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary. It should be used with caution in children (aged below 12 years) and elderly patients (above 50 years).

The common side effects associated with the use of MOX CV DT 228.5MG TABLET are diarrhea, thrush (fungal infection in the vagina, skin folds, or mouth), nausea, and vomiting. Contact your doctor immediately if any of the symptoms worsen.

Introduction About NOVAMOX CV ES ORANGE FLAVOUR 642.9MG ORAL SUSPENSION

NOVAMOX CV ES ORANGE FLAVOUR 642.9MG ORAL SUSPENSION is used to manage bacterial infections such as middle ear and sinus infections, respiratory tract infections, genital tract infections, urinary tract infections, skin and soft tissue infections such as dental infections, bone and joint infections, septic abortion (any abortion complicated by uterine infection), and abdominal infections. The symptoms of a bacterial infection may include fever, difficulty breathing, pus formation, and pain.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It works by preventing the growth of bacteria and helps clear up the infection.

Do not take NOVAMOX CV ES ORANGE FLAVOUR 642.9MG ORAL SUSPENSION if you have a history of hypersensitivity to beta-lactams, including penicillin and cephalosporins, or any other ingredients of this medicine. It is not recommended for use if you have a history of amoxicillin-clavulanate-associated jaundice or hepatic dysfunction.

Before taking NOVAMOX CV ES ORANGE FLAVOUR 642.9MG ORAL SUSPENSION, inform your doctor if you are suffering from hepatic or renal impairment. This medicine should be used with caution in pregnant women and only when necessary.

In breastfeeding women, it should be used with caution. NOVAMOX CV ES ORANGE FLAVOUR 642.9MG ORAL SUSPENSION should be used with caution in children (aged below 12 years) and elderly patients (above 50 years).

The common side effects associated with the use of NOVAMOX CV ES ORANGE FLAVOUR 642.9MG ORAL SUSPENSION are diarrhea, thrush (a fungal infection in the vagina, skin folds, or mouth), nausea, and vomiting. Contact your doctor immediately if any of the symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About BACTOCLAV DROPS

BACTOCLAV DROPS is used in infants for the management of various bacterial infections such as respiratory tract infections, urinary tract infections, bone and joint infections, middle ear infections (otitis media), tonsillitis, sinusitis, skin, and soft tissue infections such as cellulitis, animal bites, etc.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belong to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It works by preventing the growth of the bacteria, thus clearing up the infection.

BACTOCLAV DROPS is not recommended for children with a history of severe kidney impairment, history of liver problems, or jaundice after taking penicillin antibiotics. It should be used with caution in children suffering from glandular fever (viral infection causing sore throat, high fever, swelling of salivary glands), liver disease, or kidney disease who are not passing urine daily.

BACTOCLAV DROPS is for pediatric use only. It should be used with caution in neonates and infants less than 12 weeks of age. The most common side effects after giving BACTOCLAV DROPS are vomiting, diarrhea, nausea, and thrush (fungal infections). Consult your doctor immediately if your child experiences any of the above side effects.
uses: Used to manage bacterial infections in children
usesDetails:

Used to manage bacterial infections in children
mechanismOfAction:
How BACTOCLAV DROPS Works

BACTOCLAV DROPS work against bacterial infections. Amoxicillin in Clavam stops bacteria from making their cell walls, causing them to break apart and die. Clavulanic acid in Clavam stops bacteria from destroying amoxicillin, making it more effective at killing bacteria. So together, they help kill bacteria and manage infections.

name: MOX Redimix Drops 10ml
introduction:
Introduction About MOX REDIMIX DROPS

MOX REDIMIX DROPS contains Amoxycillin which belongs to the group of medicines called Penicillin. MOX REDIMIX DROPS is used to manage bacterial infections in pediatric patients caused by susceptible strains of gram-positive and gram-negative bacteria that affect different parts of the body.

It is also used in combination with other medicines in pediatric patients to manage stomach ulcers.

MOX REDIMIX DROPS is not recommended for use in children allergic to amoxicillin, penicillin, and/or other antibiotics.

Before administering MOX REDIMIX DROPS, inform your doctor if the child has glandular fever (viral infection caused by Epstein Barr Virus), is unable to urinate regularly, has kidney problems, and/or liver problems (such as hepatic impairment).

MOX REDIMIX DROPS is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women since it is used only in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). It is also not recommended for use in elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking MOX REDIMIX DROPS are skin rash, nausea and diarrhoea. Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.

To manage stomach ulcers (in combination with other medicines)

How MOX REDIMIX DROPS Works

MOX REDIMIX DROPS works by inhibiting the synthesis of penicillin-binding proteins which leads to the activation of autolytic enzymes in bacterial cell wall resulting in lysis/destruction of bacterial cell wall thus managing the spread of infection in affected children.

Administer MOX REDIMIX DROPS in a child as advised by your physician. Shake well before use. Your doctor will decide the exact dose and duration of management for the child depending on the child’s age, body weight and disease condition.
sideEffects: Mild itchy rash (round, pink-red patches), ‘hive-like’ swollen areas on the forearms, legs, palms, hands or feet
Signs of allergic reactions such as skin itching/rash, swelling of the face/lips/tongue/body, and/or breathing difficulties
Signs of inflammation of blood vessel walls (due to allergic reaction) such as rash/pinpoint red round spots under the skin surface or bruising of the skin, joint pain (arthritis) and kidney problems
Signs of a delayed allergic reaction (that occurs usually after 7 to 12 days of use) such as rashes, rashes, fever, joint pains and enlargement of lymph nodes under the arms

Signs of erythema multiforme (skin reaction) such as itchy reddish-purple patches on the skin (especially on the palms of the hands or soles of the feet), ‘hive-like’ raised swollen areas on the skin, tender areas on the surfaces of the mouth, eyes and genitals, fever, tiredness)
Signs of other severe skin reactions include changes in skin colour, bumps under the skin, blistering, pustules, peeling, redness, pain, itching, scaling, fever, headaches and body aches

Signs of problems (associated with blood cell) such as fever, chills, sore throat or other signs of an infection, or bruise easily
Signs of Jarisch-Herxheimer reaction (acute febrile reaction) such as fever, chills, headache, muscle pain and skin rash
Inflammation of the colon with diarrhoea (sometimes containing blood), pain and fever

Signs of serious (reversible) liver effects such as severe diarrhoea with bleeding, blisters/ redness/bruising of the skin, darker urine/paler stools, yellowing of the skin/the whites of the eyes (jaundice)

introduction:
Introduction About CEFTRU CV TABLET

CEFTRU CV TABLET is a combination of Cefpodoxime and Clavulanic acid, which belongs to the group of medicines called Cephalosporins and Beta-lactamase inhibitors, respectively. CEFTRU CV TABLET is used to manage mild to moderate infections caused by susceptible strains of microorganisms in conditions such as acute otitis media (middle ear infection), pharyngitis (sore throat)/tonsillitis (inflammation of tonsils), community-acquired pneumonia, chronic bronchitis (respiratory infection), and acute maxillary sinusitis (sinus infection) in affected individuals.

CEFTRU CV TABLET is also used to manage uncomplicated skin structure infections, urethral and cervical gonorrhoea (sexually transmitted disease), anorectal (anal/rectal) infections, and urinary tract infections in affected individuals.

CEFTRU CV TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Cefpodoxime, Clavulanic Acid, and/or other cephalosporin groups of antibiotics. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency (lactose intolerance), and glucose-galactose malabsorption (a condition marked by the inability of the body to absorb glucose and galactose sugars).

Before taking CEFTRU CV TABLET, inform your doctor if you have previous history of hypersensitivity reactions to medicines such as cefpodoxime, other cephalosporins, penicillin, and/or have kidney problems (such as mild/moderate/severe renal impairment) and liver problems (such as hepatic insufficiency/impairment).

CEFTRU CV TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women only if it is clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through breastmilk.

CEFTRU CV TABLET is indicated for use in children and adolescents (aged above 12 years). Consult your doctor before administering the medicine to infants (less than 2 years), as the safety and efficacy of the medicine have not been established. The medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking CEFTRU CV TABLET are diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, headache, vaginal fungal infections, and/or vulvovaginal infections. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

CEFTRU CV TABLET helps to manage mild to moderate infections, where Cefpodoxime works by managing the formation of the protective covering of the bacteria, which is essential for the survival of bacteria, and Clavulanic Acid works by reducing the resistance and enhancing the activity of Cefpodoxime against bacteria, thus managing the occurrence of infections in affected individuals.

introduction:
Introduction About CLAMP 625MG TABLET

CLAMP 625MG TABLET is used to manage bacterial infections, including middle ear and sinus infections, respiratory tract infections, genital tract infections, urinary tract infections, skin and soft tissue infections such as dental infections, bone and joint infections, septic abortion, and abdominal infections. The symptoms of bacterial infection include fever, difficulty breathing, pus formation, and pain.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belong to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It works by preventing the growth of bacteria and helps clear up the infection.

CLAMP 625MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have liver problems or jaundice upon taking an antibiotic or amoxicillin-clavulanate. Before taking this medicine, inform your doctor if you are suffering from a hepatic impairment, liver disease, renal impairment, kidney disease, glandular fever, or are unable to pass water properly.

CLAMP 625MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary. It should be used with caution in children (aged below 12 years) and elderly patients (above 50 years).

The common side effects associated with the use of CLAMP 625MG TABLET are diarrhea, thrush (fungal infection in the vagina, skin folds, or mouth), nausea, and vomiting. Contact your doctor immediately if any of the symptoms worsen.

Manage bacterial infection

CLAMP 625MG TABLET helps in managing bacterial infection where amoxicillin is a penicillin that works by inhibiting the enzymes that help in the synthesis of the integral structural component of the bacterial cell wall whereas clavulanic acid is a beta-lactam (structurally related to penicillin) that works by inactivating an enzyme, namely beta-lactamase, thereby managing the inactivation of amoxicillin.

MOXCLAV 156.25MG ORAL SUSPENSION is used to manage bacterial infections such as middle ear and sinus infections, respiratory tract infections, genital tract infections, urinary tract infections, skin and soft tissue infections such as dental infections, bone and joint infections, septic abortion (any abortion complicated by uterine infection), and abdominal infections. The symptoms of a bacterial infection may include fever, difficulty breathing, pus formation, and pain.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It works by preventing the growth of bacteria and helps clear up the infection.

Do not take MOXCLAV 156.25MG ORAL SUSPENSION if you have a history of hypersensitivity to beta-lactams, including penicillin and cephalosporins, or any other ingredients of this medicine. It is not recommended for use if you have a history of amoxicillin-clavulanate-associated jaundice or hepatic dysfunction.

Before taking MOXCLAV 156.25MG ORAL SUSPENSION, inform your doctor if you are suffering from hepatic or renal impairment. This medicine should be used with caution in pregnant women and only when necessary.

In breastfeeding women, it should be used with caution. MOXCLAV 156.25MG ORAL SUSPENSION should be used with caution in children (aged below 12 years) and elderly patients (above 50 years).

The common side effects associated with the use of MOXCLAV 156.25MG ORAL SUSPENSION are diarrhea, thrush (a fungal infection in the vagina, skin folds, or mouth), nausea, and vomiting. Contact your doctor immediately if any of the symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How MOXCLAV 156.25MG ORAL SUSPENSION Works

MOXCLAV 156.25MG ORAL SUSPENSION helps in managing bacterial infection where amoxicillin is a penicillin that works by inhibiting the enzymes that help in the synthesis of an integral structural component of the bacterial cell wall whereas clavulanic acid is a beta-lactam (structurally related to penicillin) that works by inactivating an enzyme, namely beta-lactamase, thereby managing the inactivation of amoxicillin.
usageInstructions: Shake well before use.
Use the dosing syringe, cup, or spoon supplied with the pack to measure the dose accurately.
A dosing syringe is recommended to dose a child below the age of 3 months accurately.
Open the sachet, reconstitute the dry powder thoroughly in a glass of water, and swallow the mixture immediately.
usageDetails:
How to use MOXCLAV 156.25MG ORAL SUSPENSION

Take this medicine as advised by your physician.

Syrup/Oral Suspension:

Shake well before use.
Use the dosing syringe, cup, or spoon supplied with the pack to measure the dose accurately.
A dosing syringe is recommended to dose a child below the age of 3 months accurately.

Dry syrup/dry suspension:

Open the sachet, reconstitute the dry powder thoroughly in a glass of water, and swallow the mixture immediately.

Your doctor will determine the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

Signs of allergic reactions such as skin rash, swelling on the face or mouth resulting in difficulty breathing or collapse
Signs of vasculitis (inflammation of blood vessels) such as raised red or purple spots on the skin

Side Effects Of MOXCLAV 156.25MG ORAL SUSPENSION
Common Side Effects of MOXCLAV 156.25MG ORAL SUSPENSION:
Diarrhoea
Thrush (fungal infection in the vagina, skin folds, or mouth)
Nausea
Vomiting

Stop taking MOXCLAV 156.25MG ORAL SUSPENSION and contact your doctor if you experience any of the following side effects: 

Signs of allergic reactions such as skin rash, swelling on the face or mouth resulting in difficulty breathing or collapse
Signs of vasculitis (inflammation of blood vessels) such as raised red or purple spots on the skin
Inflammation of the liver (hepatitis), jaundice
Severe diarrhoea

MOXCLAV 156.25MG ORAL SUSPENSION should be used with caution in patients with renal impairment.
Do not take MOXCLAV 156.25MG ORAL SUSPENSION if you have a history of hypersensitivity to beta-lactams, including penicillin and cephalosporins, or any other ingredients of this medicine.
MOXCLAV 156.25MG ORAL SUSPENSION should be used with caution in children (below 12 years).

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

Before taking MOXCLAV 156.25MG ORAL SUSPENSION, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Medicine used to manage gout Ex. allopurinol, probenecid
Medicine used to delay blood clotting, Ex. warfarin, acenocoumarol
Mycophenolate mofetil (a medicine used to manage organ rejection after an organ transplant)
Contraceptives (medicines used to manage conception) Ex. oestrogen

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of MOXCLAV 156.25MG ORAL SUSPENSION, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose are gastrointestinal symptoms (including heartburn, indigestion, bloating, and constipation), fluid and electrolyte disturbance, and amoxicillin crystalluria, which may lead to renal failure in some cases.

name: Augpen 1.2Gm Injection 1's
introduction:
Introduction About AUGPEN 1.2GM INJECTION

AUGPEN 1.2GM INJECTION is used in the management of various bacterial infections such as respiratory tract infections (pneumonia, acute exacerbation of chronic bronchitis), urinary tract infections (cystitis, urethritis, pyelonephritis), bone and joint infections (osteomyelitis), middle ear infections (otitis media), tonsillitis, sinusitis, skin and soft tissue infections such as cellulitis, boils, wound infections, intra-abdominal sepsis, dental infections, and infections of genital organs in females.

AUGPEN 1.2GM INJECTION is also used as prophylaxis against various bacterial infections associated with major surgeries of the heart, joints, kidney, head and neck, stomach, biliary tract, intestine, and pelvic region. Along with management with this medicine, your doctor might order bacterial culture tests to enhance the outcomes of the management.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belong to the group of medicines called Penicillins and Beta-Lactamase Inhibitors. It works by preventing the growth of the bacteria and thus clearing up the infection.

AUGPEN 1.2GM INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney impairment who had a history of liver problems or jaundice after taking penicillin antibiotics. It should be used with caution in patients suffering from glandular fever (a viral infection causing sore throat, high fever, swelling of salivary glands, etc.), liver disease, kidney disease, who are not passing urine daily, convulsions (fits), or large intestine inflammation.

AUGPEN 1.2GM INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless necessary. It should be used with caution in breastfeeding women, as it may pass through breast milk. AUGPEN 1.2GM INJECTION should be used with caution in children as it may require dose modification.

The most common side effects after receiving AUGPEN 1.2GM INJECTION are diarrhea, thrush (fungal infection), etc. Consult your doctor immediately if any of your symptoms get worse or persist.
usesDetails:
Uses Of AUGPEN 1.2GM INJECTION
Management of various bacterial infections
mechanismOfAction:
How AUGPEN 1.2GM INJECTION Works

AUGPEN 1.2GM INJECTION helps in managing bacterial infection, where Amoxicillin works by inhibiting penicillin-binding proteins (which are involved in the synthesis of the bacterial cell wall), leading to the activation of autolytic enzymes in the bacterial cell wall. Therefore, leading to lysis of the cell wall and death of the bacterial cell, clavulanic acid inhibits the activity of bacterial enzymes known as beta-lactamases and hence enhances the antibacterial activity of amoxicillin.
usageInstructions: This medicine will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as an intravenous infusion or intravenous injection.
Your doctor will decide the exact dose and duration of management for you depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

This medicine will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as an intravenous infusion or intravenous injection.
Your doctor will decide the exact dose and duration of management for you depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.
sideEffects: Severe allergic reaction, which includes rashes, collapsing or fainting, swelling of the face and throat, which may cause difficulty breathing, fever, joint pain, swollen lymph nodes of the neck, armpits, and groin, and red or purple raised spots on skin due to inflammation of blood vessels
Watery diarrhea with blood or mucus, fever, and abdominal pain that occurs due to inflammation of the large intestine

Diarrhoea
Thrush (candida fungal infection)

Stop receiving AUGPEN 1.2GM INJECTION and consult your doctor immediately in case you experience:

Severe allergic reaction, which includes rashes, collapsing or fainting, swelling of the face and throat, which may cause difficulty breathing, fever, joint pain, swollen lymph nodes of the neck, armpits, and groin, and red or purple raised spots on skin due to inflammation of blood vessels
Watery diarrhea with blood or mucus, fever, and abdominal pain that occurs due to inflammation of the large intestine

AUGPEN 1.2GM INJECTION should be used with caution in breastfeeding women as it may pass through breast milk.
Do not drive or operate machinery after receiving AUGPEN 1.2GM INJECTION.
AUGPEN 1.2GM INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney impairment. It should be used with caution in patients suffering from kidney problems.

AUGPEN 1.2GM INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients who had a history of liver problems or jaundice after taking penicillin antibiotics. It should be used with caution in patients suffering from liver disease.
Do not receive AUGPEN 1.2GM INJECTION if you are allergic to amoxicillin, clavulanic acid, or any other ingredients in this medicine.
AUGPEN 1.2GM INJECTION should be used with caution in children as it may require dose modification.
AUGPEN 1.2GM INJECTION should be used with caution in the elderly.

name: Oxipod CV Dry Syrup 30ml
introduction:
Introduction About OXIPOD CV DRY SYRUP

OXIPOD CV DRY SYRUP is a combination of Cefpodoxime and Clavulanic acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Cephalosporins and Beta-lactamase inhibitors, respectively. OXIPOD CV DRY SYRUP is used in children to manage mild to moderate infections such as otitis media (middle ear infection), nose & throat infections, respiratory tract infection, urinary tract infection, reproductive tract infection, and skin infection.

OXIPOD CV DRY SYRUP is not recommended for use in children allergic to Cefpodoxime, Clavulanic acid, and/or other cephalosporin group of antibiotics. It is also not recommended for use in children suffering from galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency (lactose intolerance), and glucose-galactose malabsorption (condition marked by body’s inability to absorb glucose and galactose sugars).

Before administering OXIPOD CV DRY SYRUP, inform your doctor if the child has previous history of hypersensitivity reactions to medicines such as cefpodoxime, other cephalosporins, penicillin, and/or have kidney problems (such as mild/moderate/severe renal impairment), and liver problems (such as hepatic insufficiency/impairment).

OXIPOD CV DRY SYRUP is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women since it is used only in children (aged below 12 years). It is also not recommended for use in elderly patients.

The most common side effects of administering OXIPOD CV DRY SYRUP in child are diarrhoea, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, headache, vaginal fungal infections, and/or vulvovaginal infections. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

introduction:
Introduction About TAZOMAC 4.5GM INJECTION

TAZOMAC 4.5GM INJECTION is a combination of Piperacillin and Tazobactam which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage several bacterial infections such as lower respiratory tract infections such as pneumonia, acute bacterial exacerbation causing breathing difficulties, urinary tract infections, pyelonephritis, skin infections, abdominal, biliary tract infections and female pelvic infections such as postpartum endometritis or pelvic inflammatory disease, bacteraemia, and bacterial meningitis in infants and children.

It is also used along with other antibacterial agents in the management of neutropenic caused by bacterial infection.

Pneumonia is an infection which causes inflammation in the air sac producing cough with phlegm and shortness of breath. Pyelonephritis is a urinary tract infection affecting the urinary bladder later gets spreads to the kidneys. Bacteraemia is an infectious condition indicating presence of bacteria in the blood stream.

Bacterial meningitis is an infection caused by bacteria in the region surrounding the brain. Neutropenic is low levels of neutrophils (a type of white blood cells) in our body.

Kindly inform your doctor or your health-care professional before any laboratory tests as TAZOMAC 4.5GM INJECTION will interact with medical investigations. Inform your doctor if you are allergic to any antibiotics or other medicines.

TAZOMAC 4.5GM INJECTION should not be used in patients allergic to penicillin antibiotics, cephalosporin, and other beta-lactam antibiotics.

TAZOMAC 4.5GM INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with pre-existing diarrhoea, low potassium levels, kidney, and liver diseases.

Avoid concomitant use of other aminoglycoside antibiotics and vancomycin along with this medicine.

TAZOMAC 4.5GM INJECTION should be used with caution in pregnant and breast-feeding women. TAZOMAC 4.5GM INJECTION should be used with caution in children above 2 months and in elderly people. Your doctor will administer the right dose depends on your child’s age, body weight and severity of the infection.

The common side effects of TAZOMAC 4.5GM INJECTION are diarrhoea, yeast infection, headache, sleeplessness, stomach pain, vomiting, nausea, constipation, skin rash, itching, fever, and injection site reaction.

mechanismOfAction:
How TAZOMAC 4.5GM INJECTION Works

TAZOMAC 4.5GM INJECTION works by destroying the bacterial growth responsible for causing infections. Piperacillin works by interrupting the cell wall formation by binding with the enzymes responsible for cell wall synthesis. This binding causes defects in the cell wall leading to cell death causing death of the organism. Tazobactam is responsible for the irreversible termination of enzymes (beta- lactamases) that protect the organism from antibiotics and produces less anti-bacterial actions when given alone so it’s always used in combination with other antibiotics. Thus, both the substances works by managing cell growth and function inhibiting bacterial growth.

TAZOMAC 4.5GM INJECTION will be administered into the vein (intravenously) by your doctor or nurse. Your doctor will administer the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Augmentin Dds Syrup 30ml
introduction:
Introduction About AUGMENTIN DDS SYRUP

AUGMENTIN DDS SYRUP is used to manage bacterial infections such as middle ear and sinus infections, respiratory tract infections, genital tract infections, urinary tract infections, skin and soft tissue infections such as dental infections, bone and joint infections, septic abortion (any abortion complicated by uterine infection), and abdominal infections. The symptoms of a bacterial infection may include fever, difficulty breathing, pus formation, and pain.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It works by preventing the growth of bacteria and helps clear up the infection.

Do not take AUGMENTIN DDS SYRUP if you have a history of hypersensitivity to beta-lactams, including penicillin and cephalosporins, or any other ingredients of this medicine. It is not recommended for use if you have a history of amoxicillin-clavulanate-associated jaundice or hepatic dysfunction.

Before taking AUGMENTIN DDS SYRUP, inform your doctor if you are suffering from hepatic or renal impairment. This medicine should be used with caution in pregnant women and only when necessary.

In breastfeeding women, it should be used with caution. AUGMENTIN DDS SYRUP should be used with caution in children (aged below 12 years) and elderly patients (above 50 years).

The common side effects associated with the use of AUGMENTIN DDS SYRUP are diarrhea, thrush (a fungal infection in the vagina, skin folds, or mouth), nausea, and vomiting. Contact your doctor immediately if any of the symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How AUGMENTIN DDS SYRUP Works

AUGMENTIN DDS SYRUP helps in managing bacterial infection where amoxicillin is a penicillin that works by inhibiting the enzymes that help in the synthesis of an integral structural component of the bacterial cell wall whereas clavulanic acid is a beta-lactam (structurally related to penicillin) that works by inactivating an enzyme, namely beta-lactamase, thereby managing the inactivation of amoxicillin.

introduction:
Introduction About DOO CLAV 625MG TABLET

DOO CLAV 625MG TABLET is used to manage bacterial infections, including middle ear and sinus infections, respiratory tract infections, genital tract infections, urinary tract infections, skin and soft tissue infections such as dental infections, bone and joint infections, septic abortion, and abdominal infections. The symptoms of bacterial infection include fever, difficulty breathing, pus formation, and pain.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belong to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It works by preventing the growth of bacteria and helps clear up the infection.

DOO CLAV 625MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have liver problems or jaundice upon taking an antibiotic or amoxicillin-clavulanate. Before taking this medicine, inform your doctor if you are suffering from a hepatic impairment, liver disease, renal impairment, kidney disease, glandular fever, or are unable to pass water properly.

DOO CLAV 625MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary. It should be used with caution in children (aged below 12 years) and elderly patients (above 50 years).

The common side effects associated with the use of DOO CLAV 625MG TABLET are diarrhea, thrush (fungal infection in the vagina, skin folds, or mouth), nausea, and vomiting. Contact your doctor immediately if any of the symptoms worsen.

Manage bacterial infection
mechanismOfAction:
How DOO CLAV 625MG TABLET Works

CLANEM 625 LB TABLET is not recommended for use if you have liver problems or jaundice upon taking an antibiotic or amoxicillin-clavulanate. introduction:
Introduction About ZOVAX 500MG CAPSULE

ZOVAX 500MG CAPSULE is an antibiotic medicine used in the management of various bacterial infections such as respiratory tract infections, ear, nose, throat infections, stomach infections (H. Pylori infection), skin infections and urinary tract infections. It contains a medicine called amoxycillin which is a powerful antibacterial agent that eradicates the susceptible microorganism that causes the infection.

Take ZOVAX 500MG CAPSULE as advised by the physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Do not skip doses or stop therapy with ZOVAX 500MG CAPSULE without consulting your doctor, as it will make this medicine less effective against the bacteria which causes infection.

Therefore, make sure to complete the duration of therapy as suggested by your doctor for fast recovery. Do not take ZOVAX 500MG CAPSULE if you are allergic to Amoxycillin. Before taking ZOVAX 500MG CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, glandular fever, urinary problems, etc. Consult your doctor before taking ZOVAX 500MG CAPSULE if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking ZOVAX 500MG CAPSULE are nausea, diarrhea and skin rashes. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How ZOVAX 500MG CAPSULE Works

ZOVAX 500MG CAPSULE contains a medicine called Amoxicillin which is a type of antibiotic that belongs to the penicillin group. It works by inhibiting the synthesis of bacterial cell walls. Bacteria have a protective outer layer called the cell wall, which is essential for their survival. Amoxicillin interferes with the enzymes that are responsible for forming the cell wall, specifically targeting the cross-linking process. This weakens the cell wall, causing it to rupture and ultimately leading to the death of the bacteria. This action makes amoxicillin effective against a wide range of bacterial infections.

name: Durataz 4.5gm Injection 1's
introduction:
Introduction About DURATAZ 4.5GM INJECTION

DURATAZ 4.5GM INJECTION is a combination of Piperacillin and Tazobactam which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage several bacterial infections such as lower respiratory tract infections such as pneumonia, acute bacterial exacerbation causing breathing difficulties, urinary tract infections, pyelonephritis, skin infections, abdominal, biliary tract infections and female pelvic infections such as postpartum endometritis or pelvic inflammatory disease, bacteraemia, and bacterial meningitis in infants and children.

It is also used along with other antibacterial agents in the management of neutropenic caused by bacterial infection.

Pneumonia is an infection which causes inflammation in the air sac producing cough with phlegm and shortness of breath. Pyelonephritis is a urinary tract infection affecting the urinary bladder later gets spreads to the kidneys. Bacteraemia is an infectious condition indicating presence of bacteria in the blood stream.

Bacterial meningitis is an infection caused by bacteria in the region surrounding the brain. Neutropenic is low levels of neutrophils (a type of white blood cells) in our body.

Kindly inform your doctor or your health-care professional before any laboratory tests as DURATAZ 4.5GM INJECTION will interact with medical investigations. Inform your doctor if you are allergic to any antibiotics or other medicines.

DURATAZ 4.5GM INJECTION should not be used in patients allergic to penicillin antibiotics, cephalosporin, and other beta-lactam antibiotics.

DURATAZ 4.5GM INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with pre-existing diarrhoea, low potassium levels, kidney, and liver diseases.

Avoid concomitant use of other aminoglycoside antibiotics and vancomycin along with this medicine.

DURATAZ 4.5GM INJECTION should be used with caution in pregnant and breast-feeding women. DURATAZ 4.5GM INJECTION should be used with caution in children above 2 months and in elderly people. Your doctor will administer the right dose depends on your child’s age, body weight and severity of the infection.

The common side effects of DURATAZ 4.5GM INJECTION are diarrhoea, yeast infection, headache, sleeplessness, stomach pain, vomiting, nausea, constipation, skin rash, itching, fever, and injection site reaction.

mechanismOfAction:
How DURATAZ 4.5GM INJECTION Works

DURATAZ 4.5GM INJECTION works by destroying the bacterial growth responsible for causing infections. Piperacillin works by interrupting the cell wall formation by binding with the enzymes responsible for cell wall synthesis. This binding causes defects in the cell wall leading to cell death causing death of the organism. Tazobactam is responsible for the irreversible termination of enzymes (beta- lactamases) that protect the organism from antibiotics and produces less anti-bacterial actions when given alone so it’s always used in combination with other antibiotics. Thus, both the substances works by managing cell growth and function inhibiting bacterial growth.

introduction:
Introduction About MPX CV

MPX CV is used to manage bacterial infections, including middle ear and sinus infections, respiratory tract infections, genital tract infections, urinary tract infections, skin and soft tissue infections such as dental infections, bone and joint infections, septic abortion, and abdominal infections. The symptoms of bacterial infection include fever, difficulty breathing, pus formation, and pain.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belong to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It works by preventing the growth of bacteria and helps clear up the infection.

MPX CV is not recommended for use if you have liver problems or jaundice upon taking an antibiotic or amoxicillin-clavulanate. Before taking this medicine, inform your doctor if you are suffering from a hepatic impairment, liver disease, renal impairment, kidney disease, glandular fever, or are unable to pass water properly.

MPX CV should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary. It should be used with caution in children (aged below 12 years) and elderly patients (above 50 years).

The common side effects associated with the use of MPX CV are diarrhea, thrush (fungal infection in the vagina, skin folds, or mouth), nausea, and vomiting. Contact your doctor immediately if any of the symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How MPX CV Works

MPX CV helps in managing bacterial infection where amoxicillin is a penicillin that works by inhibiting the enzymes that help in the synthesis of the integral structural component of the bacterial cell wall whereas clavulanic acid is a beta-lactam (structurally related to penicillin) that works by inactivating an enzyme, namely beta-lactamase, thereby managing the inactivation of amoxicillin.

introduction:
Introduction About ARISTOCILLIN 125MG DRY SYRUP

ARISTOCILLIN 125MG DRY SYRUP contains Ampicillin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage bacterial infections of the ear, respiratory tract (bronchus, lungs), urinary tract, genital tract, stomach, blood, brain or skin and soft tissues.

It can also be used to manage typhoid fever and can manage endocarditis (inflammation of the lining of the heart and its valves) after any surgery or a dental procedure.

ARISTOCILLIN 125MG DRY SYRUP should be taken on an empty stomach. It is important to take ARISTOCILLIN 125MG DRY SYRUP for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor to achieve better results even if you feel better during the midway of the therapy. Failing to complete the full course of the therapy or skipping doses in between the therapy may not result in adequate infection control.

During therapy with ARISTOCILLIN 125MG DRY SYRUP, your doctor will periodically monitor your health condition through several blood tests/urine tests to access the improvement in your condition and to reduce the risk of unwanted side effects.

Before taking ARISTOCILLIN 125MG DRY SYRUP inform your doctor if you have diabetes or any kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any viral infections (such as HIV infection, syphilis or cytomegalovirus infection) as a precaution.

ARISTOCILLIN 125MG DRY SYRUP should be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women only if considered necessary by the physician. The most common side effects of taking ARISTOCILLIN 125MG DRY SYRUP are nausea, vomiting and diarrhea. Inform your doctor if they trouble you.

ARISTOCILLIN 125MG DRY SYRUP is a bactericidal agent. It kills the susceptible bacteria by blocking the bacterial cell wall synthesis that is essential for the bacterial cell to survive. This action destroys the susceptible bacteria, manage their further growth and multiplication and reduce the severity of the infection.
usageDetails:
How to use ARISTOCILLIN 125MG DRY SYRUP

Take ARISTOCILLIN 125MG DRY SYRUP on an empty stomach or at least 30 minutes to 1 hour before meals. Shake the bottle well to loosen the dry powder. Add the sterile water provided with this pack up to the ring mark present on the bottle surface. Add extra water if required to adjust the volume up to the ring mark. Close the bottle tightly and shake the mixture well.

Measure and consume the reconstituted mixture as advised by your doctor.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of the infection.

Do not stop taking ARISTOCILLIN 125MG DRY SYRUP once your symptoms subside. It is important to complete course of therapy with ARISTOCILLIN 125MG DRY SYRUP to achieve better control over the infection.

introduction:
Introduction About MOXIBOND 625 TABLET

MOXIBOND 625 TABLET is used to manage bacterial infections, including middle ear and sinus infections, respiratory tract infections, genital tract infections, urinary tract infections, skin and soft tissue infections such as dental infections, bone and joint infections, septic abortion, and abdominal infections. The symptoms of bacterial infection include fever, difficulty breathing, pus formation, and pain.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belong to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It works by preventing the growth of bacteria and helps clear up the infection.

MOXIBOND 625 TABLET is not recommended for use if you have liver problems or jaundice upon taking an antibiotic or amoxicillin-clavulanate. Before taking this medicine, inform your doctor if you are suffering from a hepatic impairment, liver disease, renal impairment, kidney disease, glandular fever, or are unable to pass water properly.

MOXIBOND 625 TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary. It should be used with caution in children (aged below 12 years) and elderly patients (above 50 years).

The common side effects associated with the use of MOXIBOND 625 TABLET are diarrhea, thrush (fungal infection in the vagina, skin folds, or mouth), nausea, and vomiting. Contact your doctor immediately if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:

Manage bacterial infection
mechanismOfAction:
How MOXIBOND 625 TABLET Works

MOXIBOND 625 TABLET helps in managing bacterial infection where amoxicillin is a penicillin that works by inhibiting the enzymes that help in the synthesis of the integral structural component of the bacterial cell wall whereas clavulanic acid is a beta-lactam (structurally related to penicillin) that works by inactivating an enzyme, namely beta-lactamase, thereby managing the inactivation of amoxicillin.

introduction:
Introduction About WARCILIN DRY SYRUP

WARCILIN DRY SYRUP is an antibiotic medicine used in the management of various bacterial infections such as respiratory tract infections, ear, nose, throat infections, stomach infections (H. Pylori infection), skin infections and urinary tract infections, especially in children. It contains a medicine called amoxycillin which is a powerful antibacterial agent that eradicates the susceptible microorganism that causes the infection.

Do not take WARCILIN DRY SYRUP if you are allergic to Amoxycillin. Before taking WARCILIN DRY SYRUP inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, glandular fever, urinary problems, etc. Consult your doctor before taking WARCILIN DRY SYRUP if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking WARCILIN DRY SYRUP are nausea, diarrhea and skin rashes. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.
usesDetails:
Uses Of WARCILIN DRY SYRUP

Management of bacterial infections such as:

Respiratory tract infections
Ear, nose, throat infections
Stomach infections (H. Pylori infection)
Skin infections
Urinary tract infections
mechanismOfAction:
How WARCILIN DRY SYRUP Works

WARCILIN DRY SYRUP contains a medicine called Amoxicillin which is a type of antibiotic that belongs to the penicillin group. It works by inhibiting the synthesis of bacterial cell walls. Bacteria have a protective outer layer called the cell wall, which is essential for their survival. Amoxicillin interferes with the enzymes that are responsible for forming the cell wall, specifically targeting the cross-linking process. This weakens the cell wall, causing it to rupture and ultimately leading to the death of the bacteria. This action makes amoxicillin effective against a wide range of bacterial infections.
usageDetails:
How to use WARCILIN DRY SYRUP

Take WARCILIN DRY SYRUP as advised by the physician.

For Dry Syrup: Shake the medicine powder for dispersing the powder. Add the sterile water provided along with the package into the dry powder and shake it vigorously for 10-15 mins. Measure the required amount of the medicine in the measuring cup and drink it. Store the reconstituted mixture in refrigerator

For Syrups and Suspension: Shake the medicine well before use. Measure the required quantity of the medicine in the measuring cup provided with the package and drink it immediately.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of the therapy based on your age, body weight and severity of infection.

introduction:
Introduction About TAZOMAC 2.25GM INJECTION

TAZOMAC 2.25GM INJECTION is a combination of Piperacillin and Tazobactam which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage several bacterial infections such as lower respiratory tract infections such as pneumonia, acute bacterial exacerbation causing breathing difficulties, urinary tract infections, pyelonephritis, skin infections, abdominal, biliary tract infections and female pelvic infections such as postpartum endometritis or pelvic inflammatory disease, bacteraemia, and bacterial meningitis in infants and children. It is also used along with other antibacterial agents in the management of neutropenic caused by bacterial infection.

Inform your doctor or your health-care professional before any laboratory tests as TAZOMAC 2.25GM INJECTION will interact with medical investigations. Inform your doctor if you are allergic to any antibiotics or other medicines. TAZOMAC 2.25GM INJECTION should not be used in patients allergic to penicillin antibiotics, cephalosporin, and other beta-lactam antibiotics. TAZOMAC 2.25GM INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with pre-existing diarrhoea, low potassium levels, kidney, and liver diseases.

Avoid concomitant use of other aminoglycoside antibiotics and vancomycin along with this medicine. TAZOMAC 2.25GM INJECTION should be used with caution in pregnant and breast-feeding women. TAZOMAC 2.25GM INJECTION should be used with caution in children above 2 months and in elderly people. Your doctor will administer the right dose depends on your child’s age, body weight and severity of the infection. The common side effects of TAZOMAC 2.25GM INJECTION are diarrhoea, yeast infection, headache, sleeplessness, stomach pain, vomiting, nausea, constipation, skin rash, itching, fever, and injection site reaction.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TAZOMAC 2.25GM INJECTION

It is used to manage the following infections:

Intra-abdominal infection
Skin and skin structure infections
Female pelvic infections
Lower respiratory tract infection
Bacterial septicaemia
mechanismOfAction:
How TAZOMAC 2.25GM INJECTION Works

TAZOMAC 2.25GM INJECTION works by destroying the bacterial growth responsible for causing infections. Piperacillin works by interrupting the cell wall formation by binding with the enzymes responsible for cell wall synthesis. This binding causes defects in the cell wall leading to cell death causing death of the organism. Tazobactam is responsible for the irreversible termination of enzymes (beta- lactamases) that protect the organism from antibiotics and produces less anti-bacterial actions when given alone so it’s always used in combination with other antibiotics. Thus, both the substances works by managing cell growth and function inhibiting bacterial growth.
usageDetails:
How to use TAZOMAC 2.25GM INJECTION

TAZOMAC 2.25GM INJECTION will be administered into the vein (intravenously) by your doctor or nurse. Your doctor will administer the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: MPX CV Delicious Mango Flavour Dry Syrup 30ml
introduction:
Introduction About MPX CV DRY SYRUP

MPX CV DRY SYRUP is used to manage bacterial infections such as middle ear and sinus infections, respiratory tract infections, genital tract infections, urinary tract infections, skin and soft tissue infections such as dental infections, bone and joint infections, septic abortion (any abortion complicated by uterine infection), and abdominal infections. The symptoms of a bacterial infection may include fever, difficulty breathing, pus formation, and pain.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It works by preventing the growth of bacteria and helps clear up the infection.

Do not take MPX CV DRY SYRUP if you have a history of hypersensitivity to beta-lactams, including penicillin and cephalosporins, or any other ingredients of this medicine. It is not recommended for use if you have a history of amoxicillin-clavulanate-associated jaundice or hepatic dysfunction.

Before taking MPX CV DRY SYRUP, inform your doctor if you are suffering from hepatic or renal impairment. This medicine should be used with caution in pregnant women and only when necessary.

In breastfeeding women, it should be used with caution. MPX CV DRY SYRUP should be used with caution in children (aged below 12 years) and elderly patients (above 50 years).

The common side effects associated with the use of MPX CV DRY SYRUP are diarrhea, thrush (a fungal infection in the vagina, skin folds, or mouth), nausea, and vomiting. Contact your doctor immediately if any of the symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About KIVIZA 1GM INJECTION

KIVIZA 1GM INJECTION is used in the management of severe bacterial infections in combination with other antibiotics. It is one of the most powerful antibiotics used against the strains of Acinetobacter baumannii which is resistant to conventional medicines. It contains Sulbactam which blocks beta-lactamase enzymes produced by bacteria, that allows antibiotics to work better against resistant bacteria.

KIVIZA 1GM INJECTION should be used only under medical supervision. It will be administered to you into the veins or muscles by a trained medical professional. Before receiving KIVIZA 1GM INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have any kidney problems, electrolyte disorders, epilepsy, meningitis or if you are pregnant or breastfeeding as a precaution.

The most common side effects of receiving KIVIZA 1GM INJECTION are pain at injection site, diarrhea, dizziness, headache, low WBC, RBC and platelets, indigestion, excess gas and loss of appetite. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
uses: Effective against the strains of Acinetobacter baumannii which is resistant to conventional medicines

mechanismOfAction:
How KIVIZA 1GM INJECTION Works

KIVIZA 1GM INJECTION contains sulbactam which is a beta-lactamase inhibitor. It works by blocking the action of enzymes called beta-lactamases that are produced by some bacteria to resist certain antibiotics. By inhibiting these enzymes, sulbactam allows antibiotics (like penicillins) to remain effective against bacteria that would otherwise be resistant, helping to manage infections more effectively.

KIVIZA 1GM INJECTION should be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into the veins (as intravenous injection or into the muscles as intramuscular injection.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and dosing frequency for you based on your age, body weight and health condition. Do not skip doses to ensure maximum protection against the infection.

introduction:
Introduction About ARISTOMOX 500MG CAPSULE

ARISTOMOX 500MG CAPSULE is an antibiotic medicine used in the management of various bacterial infections such as respiratory tract infections, ear, nose, throat infections, stomach infections (H. Pylori infection), skin infections and urinary tract infections. It contains a medicine called amoxycillin which is a powerful antibacterial agent that eradicates the susceptible microorganism that causes the infection.

Take ARISTOMOX 500MG CAPSULE as advised by the physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Do not skip doses or stop therapy with ARISTOMOX 500MG CAPSULE without consulting your doctor, as it will make this medicine less effective against the bacteria which causes infection.

Therefore, make sure to complete the duration of therapy as suggested by your doctor for fast recovery. Do not take ARISTOMOX 500MG CAPSULE if you are allergic to Amoxycillin. Before taking ARISTOMOX 500MG CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, glandular fever, urinary problems, etc. Consult your doctor before taking ARISTOMOX 500MG CAPSULE if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking ARISTOMOX 500MG CAPSULE are nausea, diarrhea and skin rashes. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How ARISTOMOX 500MG CAPSULE Works

ARISTOMOX 500MG CAPSULE contains a medicine called Amoxicillin which is a type of antibiotic that belongs to the penicillin group. It works by inhibiting the synthesis of bacterial cell walls. Bacteria have a protective outer layer called the cell wall, which is essential for their survival. Amoxicillin interferes with the enzymes that are responsible for forming the cell wall, specifically targeting the cross-linking process. This weakens the cell wall, causing it to rupture and ultimately leading to the death of the bacteria. This action makes amoxicillin effective against a wide range of bacterial infections.

introduction:
Introduction About MOKCAN 250MG TABLET

MOKCAN 250MG TABLET contains Amoxicillin which belongs to the group of medicines called Penicillins. It is used to manage wide range of infections caused by gram positive and gram-negative bacteria which includes respiratory infection (such as otitis media), sinus infection, gynaecological infection, urinary tract infection and other serious infections (such as septicaemia).

MOKCAN 250MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients suffering from mononucleosis (glandular fever caused by Epstein Barr Virus) and/or certain infections (especially urinary tract infection, a severe infection of ear/nose/throat) caused by the non-susceptible pathogen.

Before taking MOKCAN 250MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have a history of seizures/fits, meningeal disorders, diarrhoea, kidney problems (such as renal impairment) and/or liver problems (such as hepatic impairment).

MOKCAN 250MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if it is clearly necessary. MOKCAN 250MG TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents (from 6 months to 18 years of age) and elderly patients (aged above 65 years). Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.

The most common side effects of taking MOKCAN 250MG TABLET are skin rash, nausea and diarrhoea. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About ACUCLAV 1.2GM INJECTION

ACUCLAV 1.2GM INJECTION is used in the management of various bacterial infections such as respiratory tract infections (pneumonia, acute exacerbation of chronic bronchitis), urinary tract infections (cystitis, urethritis, pyelonephritis), bone and joint infections (osteomyelitis), middle ear infections (otitis media), tonsillitis, sinusitis, skin and soft tissue infections such as cellulitis, boils, wound infections, intra-abdominal sepsis, dental infections, and infections of genital organs in females.

ACUCLAV 1.2GM INJECTION is also used as prophylaxis against various bacterial infections associated with major surgeries of the heart, joints, kidney, head and neck, stomach, biliary tract, intestine, and pelvic region. Along with management with this medicine, your doctor might order bacterial culture tests to enhance the outcomes of the management.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belong to the group of medicines called Penicillins and Beta-Lactamase Inhibitors. It works by preventing the growth of the bacteria and thus clearing up the infection.

ACUCLAV 1.2GM INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney impairment who had a history of liver problems or jaundice after taking penicillin antibiotics. It should be used with caution in patients suffering from glandular fever (a viral infection causing sore throat, high fever, swelling of salivary glands, etc.), liver disease, kidney disease, who are not passing urine daily, convulsions (fits), or large intestine inflammation.

ACUCLAV 1.2GM INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless necessary. It should be used with caution in breastfeeding women, as it may pass through breast milk. ACUCLAV 1.2GM INJECTION should be used with caution in children as it may require dose modification.

The most common side effects after receiving ACUCLAV 1.2GM INJECTION are diarrhea, thrush (fungal infection), etc. Consult your doctor immediately if any of your symptoms get worse or persist.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ACUCLAV 1.2GM INJECTION
Management of various bacterial infections
mechanismOfAction:
How ACUCLAV 1.2GM INJECTION Works

ACUCLAV 1.2GM INJECTION helps in managing bacterial infection, where Amoxicillin works by inhibiting penicillin-binding proteins (which are involved in the synthesis of the bacterial cell wall), leading to the activation of autolytic enzymes in the bacterial cell wall. Therefore, leading to lysis of the cell wall and death of the bacterial cell, clavulanic acid inhibits the activity of bacterial enzymes known as beta-lactamases and hence enhances the antibacterial activity of amoxicillin.

introduction:
Introduction About WARCILIN 500MG CAPSULE

WARCILIN 500MG CAPSULE is an antibiotic medicine used in the management of various bacterial infections such as respiratory tract infections, ear, nose, throat infections, stomach infections (H. Pylori infection), skin infections and urinary tract infections. It contains a medicine called amoxycillin which is a powerful antibacterial agent that eradicates the susceptible microorganism that causes the infection.

Take WARCILIN 500MG CAPSULE as advised by the physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Do not skip doses or stop therapy with WARCILIN 500MG CAPSULE without consulting your doctor, as it will make this medicine less effective against the bacteria which causes infection.

Therefore, make sure to complete the duration of therapy as suggested by your doctor for fast recovery. Do not take WARCILIN 500MG CAPSULE if you are allergic to Amoxycillin. Before taking WARCILIN 500MG CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, glandular fever, urinary problems, etc. Consult your doctor before taking WARCILIN 500MG CAPSULE if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking WARCILIN 500MG CAPSULE are nausea, diarrhea and skin rashes. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.
usesDetails:
Uses Of WARCILIN 500MG CAPSULE

Management of bacterial infections such as:

Respiratory tract infections
Ear, nose, throat infections
Stomach infections (H. Pylori infection)
Skin infections
Urinary tract infections
mechanismOfAction:
How WARCILIN 500MG CAPSULE Works

WARCILIN 500MG CAPSULE contains a medicine called Amoxicillin which is a type of antibiotic that belongs to the penicillin group. It works by inhibiting the synthesis of bacterial cell walls. Bacteria have a protective outer layer called the cell wall, which is essential for their survival. Amoxicillin interferes with the enzymes that are responsible for forming the cell wall, specifically targeting the cross-linking process. This weakens the cell wall, causing it to rupture and ultimately leading to the death of the bacteria. This action makes amoxicillin effective against a wide range of bacterial infections.

introduction:
Introduction About PULMOXYL DT 250MG TABLET

PULMOXYL DT 250MG TABLET contains Amoxicillin which belongs to the group of medicines called Penicillins. It is used to manage wide range of infections caused by gram positive and gram-negative bacteria which includes respiratory infection (such as otitis media), sinus infection, gynaecological infection, urinary tract infection and other serious infections (such as septicaemia).

PULMOXYL DT 250MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients suffering from mononucleosis (glandular fever caused by Epstein Barr Virus) and/or certain infections (especially urinary tract infection, a severe infection of ear/nose/throat) caused by the non-susceptible pathogen.

Before taking PULMOXYL DT 250MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have a history of seizures/fits, meningeal disorders, diarrhoea, kidney problems (such as renal impairment) and/or liver problems (such as hepatic impairment).

PULMOXYL DT 250MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if it is clearly necessary. PULMOXYL DT 250MG TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents (from 6 months to 18 years of age) and elderly patients (aged above 65 years). Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.

The most common side effects of taking PULMOXYL DT 250MG TABLET are skin rash, nausea and diarrhoea. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About CLEDOMOX 625MG TABLET

CLEDOMOX 625MG TABLET is used to manage bacterial infections, including middle ear and sinus infections, respiratory tract infections, genital tract infections, urinary tract infections, skin and soft tissue infections such as dental infections, bone and joint infections, septic abortion, and abdominal infections. The symptoms of bacterial infection include fever, difficulty breathing, pus formation, and pain.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belong to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It works by preventing the growth of bacteria and helps clear up the infection.

CLEDOMOX 625MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have liver problems or jaundice upon taking an antibiotic or amoxicillin-clavulanate. Before taking this medicine, inform your doctor if you are suffering from a hepatic impairment, liver disease, renal impairment, kidney disease, glandular fever, or are unable to pass water properly.

CLEDOMOX 625MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary. It should be used with caution in children (aged below 12 years) and elderly patients (above 50 years).

The common side effects associated with the use of CLEDOMOX 625MG TABLET are diarrhea, thrush (fungal infection in the vagina, skin folds, or mouth), nausea, and vomiting. Contact your doctor immediately if any of the symptoms worsen.
