introduction:
Introduction About MOXINTA (ORANGE) 500 CAPSULE

MOXINTA (ORANGE) 500 CAPSULE is an antibiotic medicine used in the management of various bacterial infections such as respiratory tract infections, ear, nose, throat infections, stomach infections (H. Pylori infection), skin infections and urinary tract infections. It contains a medicine called amoxycillin which is a powerful antibacterial agent that eradicates the susceptible microorganism that causes the infection.

Take MOXINTA (ORANGE) 500 CAPSULE as advised by the physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Do not skip doses or stop therapy with MOXINTA (ORANGE) 500 CAPSULE without consulting your doctor, as it will make this medicine less effective against the bacteria which causes infection.

Therefore, make sure to complete the duration of therapy as suggested by your doctor for fast recovery. Do not take MOXINTA (ORANGE) 500 CAPSULE if you are allergic to Amoxycillin. Before taking MOXINTA (ORANGE) 500 CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, glandular fever, urinary problems, etc. Consult your doctor before taking MOXINTA (ORANGE) 500 CAPSULE if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking MOXINTA (ORANGE) 500 CAPSULE are nausea, diarrhea and skin rashes. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.
usesDetails:
Uses Of MOXINTA (ORANGE) 500 CAPSULE

Management of bacterial infections such as:

Respiratory tract infections
Ear, nose, throat infections
Stomach infections (H. Pylori infection)
Skin infections
Urinary tract infections
mechanismOfAction:
How MOXINTA (ORANGE) 500 CAPSULE Works

MOXINTA (ORANGE) 500 CAPSULE contains a medicine called Amoxicillin which is a type of antibiotic that belongs to the penicillin group. It works by inhibiting the synthesis of bacterial cell walls. Bacteria have a protective outer layer called the cell wall, which is essential for their survival. Amoxicillin interferes with the enzymes that are responsible for forming the cell wall, specifically targeting the cross-linking process. This weakens the cell wall, causing it to rupture and ultimately leading to the death of the bacteria. This action makes amoxicillin effective against a wide range of bacterial infections.

Take MOXINTA (ORANGE) 500 CAPSULE as advised by the physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of the therapy based on your age, body weight and severity of infection.

introduction:
Introduction About ORO CV 625MG TABLET

ORO CV 625MG TABLET is used to manage bacterial infections, including middle ear and sinus infections, respiratory tract infections, genital tract infections, urinary tract infections, skin and soft tissue infections such as dental infections, bone and joint infections, septic abortion, and abdominal infections. The symptoms of bacterial infection include fever, difficulty breathing, pus formation, and pain.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belong to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It works by preventing the growth of bacteria and helps clear up the infection.

ORO CV 625MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have liver problems or jaundice upon taking an antibiotic or amoxicillin-clavulanate. Before taking this medicine, inform your doctor if you are suffering from a hepatic impairment, liver disease, renal impairment, kidney disease, glandular fever, or are unable to pass water properly.

ORO CV 625MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary. It should be used with caution in children (aged below 12 years) and elderly patients (above 50 years).

The common side effects associated with the use of ORO CV 625MG TABLET are diarrhea, thrush (fungal infection in the vagina, skin folds, or mouth), nausea, and vomiting. Contact your doctor immediately if any of the symptoms worsen.

Manage bacterial infection

How ORO CV 625MG TABLET Works

introduction:
Introduction About BROADICILIN 125MG SYRUP

BROADICILIN 125MG SYRUP contains Ampicillin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage bacterial infections of the ear, respiratory tract (bronchus, lungs), urinary tract, genital tract, stomach, blood, brain or skin and soft tissues.

It can also be used to manage typhoid fever and can manage endocarditis (inflammation of the lining of the heart and its valves) after any surgery or a dental procedure.

BROADICILIN 125MG SYRUP should be taken on an empty stomach. It is important to take BROADICILIN 125MG SYRUP for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor to achieve better results even if you feel better during the midway of the therapy. Failing to complete the full course of the therapy or skipping doses in between the therapy may not result in adequate infection control.

During therapy with BROADICILIN 125MG SYRUP, your doctor will periodically monitor your health condition through several blood tests/urine tests to access the improvement in your condition and to reduce the risk of unwanted side effects.

Before taking BROADICILIN 125MG SYRUP inform your doctor if you have diabetes or any kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any viral infections (such as HIV infection, syphilis or cytomegalovirus infection) as a precaution.

BROADICILIN 125MG SYRUP should be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women only if considered necessary by the physician. The most common side effects of taking BROADICILIN 125MG SYRUP are nausea, vomiting and diarrhea. Inform your doctor if they trouble you.

It is used to manage various bacterial infections such as:

Ear infections (Ex. otitis media)

Typhoid fever
mechanismOfAction:
How BROADICILIN 125MG SYRUP Works

BROADICILIN 125MG SYRUP is a bactericidal agent. It kills the susceptible bacteria by blocking the bacterial cell wall synthesis that is essential for the bacterial cell to survive. This action destroys the susceptible bacteria, manage their further growth and multiplication and reduce the severity of the infection.
usageDetails:
How to use BROADICILIN 125MG SYRUP

Take BROADICILIN 125MG SYRUP on an empty stomach or at least 30 minutes to 1 hour before meals. Shake the bottle well to loosen the dry powder. Add the sterile water provided with this pack up to the ring mark present on the bottle surface. Add extra water if required to adjust the volume up to the ring mark. Close the bottle tightly and shake the mixture well.

Measure and consume the reconstituted mixture as advised by your doctor.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of the infection.

Do not stop taking BROADICILIN 125MG SYRUP once your symptoms subside. It is important to complete course of therapy with BROADICILIN 125MG SYRUP to achieve better control over the infection.

PENIDURE LA 6LAC INJECTION is not recommended for use if you have ever had an allergic reaction (skin rash or swelling of the face or neck) to any antibiotic. Consult your doctor before receiving it.

PENIDURE LA 6LAC INJECTION should be used during pregnancy only if clearly necessary. It should be used with caution in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before receiving it.

PENIDURE LA 6LAC INJECTION should be used with caution in children and in elderly patients. The most common side effect of receiving this medicine is fungal infection (candidiasis), diarrhea, nausea. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About BIOCILIN 250MG CAPSULE

BIOCILIN 250MG CAPSULE contains Ampicillin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage bacterial infections of the ears, nose, throat, respiratory tract (bronchus, lungs), urinary tract, genital tract, stomach, blood, brain or skin and soft tissues.

It can also be used to manage typhoid fever, meningitis (inflammation of the lining of the brain), peritonitis (inflammation of the lining of the stomach) and endocarditis (inflammation of the lining of the heart and its valves).

BIOCILIN 250MG CAPSULE should be taken on an empty stomach. It is important to take BIOCILIN 250MG CAPSULE for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor to achieve better results even if you feel better during the midway of the therapy. Failing to complete the full course of the therapy or skipping doses in between the therapy may not result in adequate infection control.

During therapy with BIOCILIN 250MG CAPSULE, your doctor will periodically monitor your health condition through several blood tests/urine tests to access the improvement in your condition and to reduce the risk of unwanted side effects. BIOCILIN 250MG CAPSULE is suitable for use in adults and in children (aged 10 years or older; weighing 20 kg or more).

Before taking BIOCILIN 250MG CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have diabetes or any kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have blood cancer or any viral infections (such as cytomegalovirus infection) as a precaution.

BIOCILIN 250MG CAPSULE should be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women only if considered necessary by the physician. The most common side effects of taking BIOCILIN 250MG CAPSULE are nausea, vomiting and diarrhea. Inform your doctor if they trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How BIOCILIN 250MG CAPSULE Works

BIOCILIN 250MG CAPSULE is a bactericidal agent. It kills the susceptible bacteria by blocking the bacterial cell wall synthesis that is essential for the bacterial cell to survive. This action destroys the susceptible bacteria, manage their further growth and multiplication and reduce the severity of the infection.
usageDetails:
How to use BIOCILIN 250MG CAPSULE

Take BIOCILIN 250MG CAPSULE on an empty stomach or at least 30 minutes to 1 hour before meals or as advised by your physician.

For Tablet, Capsule: Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse the medicine in the specified quantity of water as mentioned in the label. Consume the medicine immediately after reconstitution.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of the infection.

It is important to take the full course of BIOCILIN 250MG CAPSULE without any interruption. Therefore, do not miss a dose or stop taking BIOCILIN 250MG CAPSULE without consulting your doctor as it may lead to growth of harmful bacteria within the body which cannot be further controlled by BIOCILIN 250MG CAPSULE.

The common side effects associated with the use of CLEDOMOX DS 457MG DRY SYRUP are diarrhea, thrush (a fungal infection in the vagina, skin folds, or mouth), nausea, and vomiting. Contact your doctor immediately if any of the symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About WARCILIN DT 125MG TABLET

WARCILIN DT 125MG TABLET is an antibiotic medicine used in the management of various bacterial infections such as respiratory tract infections, ear, nose, throat infections, stomach infections (H. Pylori infection), skin infections and urinary tract infections, especially in children. It contains a medicine called amoxycillin which is a powerful antibacterial agent that eradicates the susceptible microorganism that causes the infection.

Do not take WARCILIN DT 125MG TABLET if you are allergic to Amoxycillin. Before taking WARCILIN DT 125MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, glandular fever, urinary problems, etc. Consult your doctor before taking WARCILIN DT 125MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking WARCILIN DT 125MG TABLET are nausea, diarrhea and skin rashes. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.
usesDetails:
Uses Of WARCILIN DT 125MG TABLET

Management of bacterial infections such as:

Respiratory tract infections
Ear, nose, throat infections
Stomach infections (H. Pylori infection)
Skin infections
Urinary tract infections
mechanismOfAction:
How WARCILIN DT 125MG TABLET Works

WARCILIN DT 125MG TABLET contains a medicine called Amoxicillin which is a type of antibiotic that belongs to the penicillin group. It works by inhibiting the synthesis of bacterial cell walls. Bacteria have a protective outer layer called the cell wall, which is essential for their survival. Amoxicillin interferes with the enzymes that are responsible for forming the cell wall, specifically targeting the cross-linking process. This weakens the cell wall, causing it to rupture and ultimately leading to the death of the bacteria. This action makes amoxicillin effective against a wide range of bacterial infections.
usageDetails:
How to use WARCILIN DT 125MG TABLET

Take WARCILIN DT 125MG TABLET as advised by the physician. Disperse the medicine in a glass of water before consumption. Do not crush, swallow or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of the therapy based on your age, body weight and severity of infection.

introduction:
Introduction About PEXOMOX 250MG TABLET

PEXOMOX 250MG TABLET contains Amoxicillin which belongs to a group of medicines called Penicillins. It is used to manage infections caused by bacteria in different parts of the body in affected individuals.

PEXOMOX 250MG TABLET is also used in combination with other medicines to manage stomach ulcers in affected individuals. It is not recommended for use in patients allergic to amoxicillin, penicillin, and/or other antibiotics.

Before taking PEXOMOX 250MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have glandular fever (viral infection caused by Epstein Barr Virus), are unable to urinate regularly, scheduled for urine, blood or oestriol tests, kidney problems, and/or liver problems (such as hepatic impairment).

PEXOMOX 250MG TABLET should be used with caution during pregnancy and in breastfeeding women. PEXOMOX 250MG TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) and in elders (aged above 65 years).

The most common side effects of taking PEXOMOX 250MG TABLET are skin rash, nausea, and/or diarrhoea. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How PEXOMOX 250MG TABLET Works

PEXOMOX 250MG TABLET works by inhibiting the synthesis of penicillin-binding proteins which leads to the activation of autolytic enzymes in bacterial cell wall resulting in lysis/destruction of bacterial cell wall thus managing the spread of infection in affected individuals.

Tablet, Capsule:

Take PEXOMOX 250MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicines with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Dispersible Tablet:

Take PEXOMOX 250MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Disperse PEXOMOX 250MG TABLET in the specified quantity of water as mentioned in the label. sideEffects: Mild itchy rash (round, pink-red patches), ‘hive-like’ swollen areas on the forearms, legs, palms, hands or feet
Signs of allergic reactions such as skin itching/rash, swelling of the face/lips/tongue/body, and/or breathing difficulties
Signs of inflammation of blood vessel walls (due to allergic reaction) such as rash/pinpoint red round spots under the skin surface or bruising of the skin, joint pain (arthritis) and kidney problems
Signs of delayed allergic reaction (that occurs usually after 7 to 12 days of use) such as rashes, rashes, fever, joint pains and enlargement of lymph nodes under the arms

Signs of erythema multiforme (skin reaction) such as itchy reddish-purple patches on the skin (especially on the palms of the hands or soles of the feet), ‘hive-like’ raised swollen areas on the skin, tender areas on the surfaces of the mouth, eyes and genitals, fever, tiredness)
Signs of other severe skin reactions include changes in skin colour, bumps under the skin, blistering, pustules, peeling, redness, pain, itching, scaling, fever, headaches and body aches

Signs of Dress (Drug Reaction with Eosinophilia and Systemic Symptoms) such as flu-like symptoms such as rash, fever, swollen glands, and abnormal blood test results (including increased white blood cells (eosinophilia) and liver enzymes)
Signs of problems (associated with blood cell) such as fever, chills, sore throat or other signs of an infection, or bruise easily
Signs of Jarisch-Herxheimer reaction (acute febrile reaction) such as fever, chills, headache, muscle pain and skin rash
Inflammation of the colon with diarrhoea (sometimes containing blood), pain and fever

Signs of serious (reversible) liver effects such as severe diarrhoea with bleeding, blisters/ redness/bruising of the skin, darker urine/paler stools, yellowing of the skin/the whites of the eyes (jaundice)

introduction:
Introduction About SALTUM DS TABLET

SALTUM DS TABLET contains Sultamicillin which belongs to the group of medicines called Penicillins. SALTUM DS TABLET is used to manage upper respiratory tract infections (such as sinusitis, otitis media, tonsillitis), lower respiratory tract infections (such as bacterial pneumonias, bronchitis), urinary tract infections, pyelonephritis (inflammation of kidney), skin & soft tissue infections, and gonococcal infections (sexually transmitted disease) in affected individuals.

SALTUM DS TABLET is also indicated in patients who require sulbactam/ampicillin therapy (antibacterial therapy) following initial therapy with intramuscular/intravenous sulbactam/ampicillin medicine. SALTUM DS TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Sultamicillin. It is also not recommended for use in patients with infectious mononucleosis (a viral infection), galactose intolerance, Lapp-lactase deficiency, and/or glucose-galactose malabsorption (rare hereditary problems).

Before taking SALTUM DS TABLET, inform your doctor if you had previously suffered from hypersensitivity reactions (to penicillins, cephalosporins, carbapenems, and/or other beta-lactam antibiotic agents), and/or have kidney problems (such as severe renal impairment), and/or liver problems (such as liver dysfunction).

SALTUM DS TABLET should be used with caution during pregnancy only if it is clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through breast milk.

SALTUM DS TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) which is also advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years/above) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking SALTUM DS TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, stomach pain, itching, and/or rashes. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

introduction:
Introduction About AUGPEN 600MG INJECTION

AUGPEN 600MG INJECTION is used in the management of various bacterial infections such as respiratory tract infections (pneumonia, acute exacerbation of chronic bronchitis), urinary tract infections (cystitis, urethritis, pyelonephritis), bone and joint infections (osteomyelitis), middle ear infections (otitis media), tonsillitis, sinusitis, skin and soft tissue infections such as cellulitis, boils, wound infections, intra-abdominal sepsis, dental infections, and infections of genital organs in females.

AUGPEN 600MG INJECTION is also used as prophylaxis against various bacterial infections associated with major surgeries of the heart, joints, kidney, head and neck, stomach, biliary tract, intestine, and pelvic region. Along with management with this medicine, your doctor might order bacterial culture tests to enhance the outcomes of the management.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belong to the group of medicines called Penicillins and Beta-Lactamase Inhibitors. It works by preventing the growth of the bacteria and thus clearing up the infection.

AUGPEN 600MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney impairment who had a history of liver problems or jaundice after taking penicillin antibiotics. It should be used with caution in patients suffering from glandular fever (a viral infection causing sore throat, high fever, swelling of salivary glands, etc.), liver disease, kidney disease, who are not passing urine daily, convulsions (fits), or large intestine inflammation.

AUGPEN 600MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless necessary. It should be used with caution in breastfeeding women, as it may pass through breast milk. AUGPEN 600MG INJECTION should be used with caution in children as it may require dose modification.

The most common side effects after receiving AUGPEN 600MG INJECTION are diarrhea, thrush (fungal infection), etc. Consult your doctor immediately if any of your symptoms get worse or persist.

Management of various bacterial infections
mechanismOfAction:
How AUGPEN 600MG INJECTION Works

AUGPEN 600MG INJECTION helps in managing bacterial infection, where Amoxicillin works by inhibiting penicillin-binding proteins (which are involved in the synthesis of the bacterial cell wall), leading to the activation of autolytic enzymes in the bacterial cell wall. Therefore, leading to lysis of the cell wall and death of the bacterial cell, clavulanic acid inhibits the activity of bacterial enzymes known as beta-lactamases and hence enhances the antibacterial activity of amoxicillin.

introduction:
Introduction About ULTIMOX CLAV DRY SYRUP

ULTIMOX CLAV DRY SYRUP is used to manage bacterial infections such as middle ear and sinus infections, respiratory tract infections, genital tract infections, urinary tract infections, skin and soft tissue infections such as dental infections, bone and joint infections, septic abortion (any abortion complicated by uterine infection), and abdominal infections. The symptoms of a bacterial infection may include fever, difficulty breathing, pus formation, and pain.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It works by preventing the growth of bacteria and helps clear up the infection.

Do not take ULTIMOX CLAV DRY SYRUP if you have a history of hypersensitivity to beta-lactams, including penicillin and cephalosporins, or any other ingredients of this medicine. It is not recommended for use if you have a history of amoxicillin-clavulanate-associated jaundice or hepatic dysfunction.

Before taking ULTIMOX CLAV DRY SYRUP, inform your doctor if you are suffering from hepatic or renal impairment. This medicine should be used with caution in pregnant women and only when necessary.

In breastfeeding women, it should be used with caution. ULTIMOX CLAV DRY SYRUP should be used with caution in children (aged below 12 years) and elderly patients (above 50 years).

The common side effects associated with the use of ULTIMOX CLAV DRY SYRUP are diarrhea, thrush (a fungal infection in the vagina, skin folds, or mouth), nausea, and vomiting. Contact your doctor immediately if any of the symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About MOXYMOX CV 625 TABLET

MOXYMOX CV 625 TABLET is used to manage bacterial infections, including middle ear and sinus infections, respiratory tract infections, genital tract infections, urinary tract infections, skin and soft tissue infections such as dental infections, bone and joint infections, septic abortion, and abdominal infections. The symptoms of bacterial infection include fever, difficulty breathing, pus formation, and pain.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belong to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It works by preventing the growth of bacteria and helps clear up the infection.

MOXYMOX CV 625 TABLET is not recommended for use if you have liver problems or jaundice upon taking an antibiotic or amoxicillin-clavulanate. Before taking this medicine, inform your doctor if you are suffering from a hepatic impairment, liver disease, renal impairment, kidney disease, glandular fever, or are unable to pass water properly.

MOXYMOX CV 625 TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary. It should be used with caution in children (aged below 12 years) and elderly patients (above 50 years).

The common side effects associated with the use of MOXYMOX CV 625 TABLET are diarrhea, thrush (fungal infection in the vagina, skin folds, or mouth), nausea, and vomiting. Contact your doctor immediately if any of the symptoms worsen.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It works by preventing the growth of bacteria and helps clear up the infection.

Do not take WARCLAV DUO 200/28.5MG SYRUP if you have a history of hypersensitivity to beta-lactams, including penicillin and cephalosporins, or any other ingredients of this medicine. It is not recommended for use if you have a history of amoxicillin-clavulanate-associated jaundice or hepatic dysfunction.

Before taking WARCLAV DUO 200/28.5MG SYRUP, inform your doctor if you are suffering from hepatic or renal impairment. This medicine should be used with caution in pregnant women and only when necessary.

In breastfeeding women, it should be used with caution. WARCLAV DUO 200/28.5MG SYRUP should be used with caution in children (aged below 12 years) and elderly patients (above 50 years).

The common side effects associated with the use of WARCLAV DUO 200/28.5MG SYRUP are diarrhea, thrush (a fungal infection in the vagina, skin folds, or mouth), nausea, and vomiting. Contact your doctor immediately if any of the symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About MOXIBOND DROPS

MOXIBOND DROPS is used in infants for the management of various bacterial infections such as respiratory tract infections, urinary tract infections, bone and joint infections, middle ear infections (otitis media), tonsillitis, sinusitis, skin, and soft tissue infections such as cellulitis, animal bites, etc.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belong to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It works by preventing the growth of the bacteria, thus clearing up the infection.

MOXIBOND DROPS is not recommended for children with a history of severe kidney impairment, history of liver problems, or jaundice after taking penicillin antibiotics. It should be used with caution in children suffering from glandular fever (viral infection causing sore throat, high fever, swelling of salivary glands), liver disease, or kidney disease who are not passing urine daily.

MOXIBOND DROPS is for pediatric use only. It should be used with caution in neonates and infants less than 12 weeks of age. The most common side effects after giving MOXIBOND DROPS are vomiting, diarrhea, nausea, and thrush (fungal infections). Consult your doctor immediately if your child experiences any of the above side effects.

How MOXIBOND DROPS Works

MOXIBOND DROPS work against bacterial infections. Amoxicillin in Clavam stops bacteria from making their cell walls, causing them to break apart and die. Clavulanic acid in Clavam stops bacteria from destroying amoxicillin, making it more effective at killing bacteria. So together, they help kill bacteria and manage infections.

introduction:
Introduction About JONCLAV 625MG TABLET

JONCLAV 625MG TABLET is a combination of Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage bacterial infections, including middle ear and sinus infections, respiratory tract infections, genital tract infections, urinary tract infections, skin and soft tissue infections such as dental infections, bone and joint infections, septic abortion, and abdominal infections. The symptoms of bacterial infection include fever, difficulty breathing, pus formation, and pain.

JONCLAV 625MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have liver problems or jaundice upon taking an antibiotic or amoxicillin-clavulanate. Before taking this medicine, inform your doctor if you are suffering from a hepatic impairment, liver disease, renal impairment, kidney disease, glandular fever, or are unable to pass water properly.

JONCLAV 625MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary. It should be used with caution in children (aged below 12 years) and elderly patients (above 50 years). Consult your doctor before taking JONCLAV 625MG TABLET.

The common side effects associated with the use of JONCLAV 625MG TABLET are diarrhea, thrush (fungal infection in the vagina, skin folds, or mouth), nausea, and vomiting. Contact your doctor immediately if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of JONCLAV 625MG TABLET
Manage bacterial infection
mechanismOfAction:
How JONCLAV 625MG TABLET Works

JONCLAV 625MG TABLET helps in managing bacterial infection where amoxicillin is a penicillin that works by inhibiting the enzymes that help in the synthesis of the integral structural component of the bacterial cell wall whereas clavulanic acid is a beta-lactam (structurally related to penicillin) that works by inactivating an enzyme, namely beta-lactamase, thereby managing the inactivation of amoxicillin.

Take JONCLAV 625MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the tablet with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse JONCLAV 625MG TABLET in the specified quantity of water as mentioned in the label. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About TAZOCLIN 4.5MG INJECTION

TAZOCLIN 4.5MG INJECTION is a combination of Piperacillin and Tazobactam which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage several bacterial infections such as lower respiratory tract infections such as pneumonia, acute bacterial exacerbation causing breathing difficulties, urinary tract infections, pyelonephritis, skin infections, abdominal, biliary tract infections and female pelvic infections such as postpartum endometritis or pelvic inflammatory disease, bacteraemia, and bacterial meningitis in infants and children.

It is also used along with other antibacterial agents in the management of neutropenic caused by bacterial infection.

Pneumonia is an infection which causes inflammation in the air sac producing cough with phlegm and shortness of breath. Pyelonephritis is a urinary tract infection affecting the urinary bladder later gets spreads to the kidneys. Bacteraemia is an infectious condition indicating presence of bacteria in the blood stream.

Bacterial meningitis is an infection caused by bacteria in the region surrounding the brain. Neutropenic is low levels of neutrophils (a type of white blood cells) in our body.

Kindly inform your doctor or your health-care professional before any laboratory tests as TAZOCLIN 4.5MG INJECTION will interact with medical investigations. Inform your doctor if you are allergic to any antibiotics or other medicines.

TAZOCLIN 4.5MG INJECTION should not be used in patients allergic to penicillin antibiotics, cephalosporin, and other beta-lactam antibiotics.

TAZOCLIN 4.5MG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with pre-existing diarrhoea, low potassium levels, kidney, and liver diseases.

Avoid concomitant use of other aminoglycoside antibiotics and vancomycin along with this medicine.

TAZOCLIN 4.5MG INJECTION should be used with caution in pregnant and breast-feeding women. TAZOCLIN 4.5MG INJECTION should be used with caution in children above 2 months and in elderly people. Your doctor will administer the right dose depends on your child’s age, body weight and severity of the infection.

The common side effects of TAZOCLIN 4.5MG INJECTION are diarrhoea, yeast infection, headache, sleeplessness, stomach pain, vomiting, nausea, constipation, skin rash, itching, fever, and injection site reaction.

mechanismOfAction:
How TAZOCLIN 4.5MG INJECTION Works

TAZOCLIN 4.5MG INJECTION works by destroying the bacterial growth responsible for causing infections. Piperacillin works by interrupting the cell wall formation by binding with the enzymes responsible for cell wall synthesis. This binding causes defects in the cell wall leading to cell death causing death of the organism. Tazobactam is responsible for the irreversible termination of enzymes (beta- lactamases) that protect the organism from antibiotics and produces less anti-bacterial actions when given alone so it’s always used in combination with other antibiotics. Thus, both the substances works by managing cell growth and function inhibiting bacterial growth.

Introduction About MOXIBOND 457 MANGO FLAVOUR DRY SYRUP

MOXIBOND 457 MANGO FLAVOUR DRY SYRUP is used to manage bacterial infections such as middle ear and sinus infections, respiratory tract infections, genital tract infections, urinary tract infections, skin and soft tissue infections such as dental infections, bone and joint infections, septic abortion (any abortion complicated by uterine infection), and abdominal infections. The symptoms of a bacterial infection may include fever, difficulty breathing, pus formation, and pain.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It works by preventing the growth of bacteria and helps clear up the infection.

Do not take MOXIBOND 457 MANGO FLAVOUR DRY SYRUP if you have a history of hypersensitivity to beta-lactams, including penicillin and cephalosporins, or any other ingredients of this medicine. It is not recommended for use if you have a history of amoxicillin-clavulanate-associated jaundice or hepatic dysfunction.

Before taking MOXIBOND 457 MANGO FLAVOUR DRY SYRUP, inform your doctor if you are suffering from hepatic or renal impairment. This medicine should be used with caution in pregnant women and only when necessary.

In breastfeeding women, it should be used with caution. MOXIBOND 457 MANGO FLAVOUR DRY SYRUP should be used with caution in children (aged below 12 years) and elderly patients (above 50 years).

The common side effects associated with the use of MOXIBOND 457 MANGO FLAVOUR DRY SYRUP are diarrhea, thrush (a fungal infection in the vagina, skin folds, or mouth), nausea, and vomiting. Contact your doctor immediately if any of the symptoms worsen.

How MOXIBOND 457 MANGO FLAVOUR DRY SYRUP Works

MOXIBOND 457 MANGO FLAVOUR DRY SYRUP helps in managing bacterial infection where amoxicillin is a penicillin that works by inhibiting the enzymes that help in the synthesis of an integral structural component of the bacterial cell wall whereas clavulanic acid is a beta-lactam (structurally related to penicillin) that works by inactivating an enzyme, namely beta-lactamase, thereby managing the inactivation of amoxicillin.

How to use MOXIBOND 457 MANGO FLAVOUR DRY SYRUP

Take this medicine as advised by your physician.

Syrup/Oral Suspension:

Shake well before use.
Use the dosing syringe, cup, or spoon supplied with the pack to measure the dose accurately.
A dosing syringe is recommended to dose a child below the age of 3 months accurately.

Dry syrup/dry suspension:

Open the sachet, reconstitute the dry powder thoroughly in a glass of water, and swallow the mixture immediately.

Your doctor will determine the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

name: Polyclav Drops 10ml
introduction:
Introduction About POLYCLAV DROPS

POLYCLAV DROPS is used in infants for the management of various bacterial infections such as respiratory tract infections, urinary tract infections, bone and joint infections, middle ear infections (otitis media), tonsillitis, sinusitis, skin, and soft tissue infections such as cellulitis, animal bites, etc.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belong to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It works by preventing the growth of the bacteria, thus clearing up the infection.

POLYCLAV DROPS is not recommended for children with a history of severe kidney impairment, history of liver problems, or jaundice after taking penicillin antibiotics. It should be used with caution in children suffering from glandular fever (viral infection causing sore throat, high fever, swelling of salivary glands), liver disease, or kidney disease who are not passing urine daily.

POLYCLAV DROPS is for pediatric use only. It should be used with caution in neonates and infants less than 12 weeks of age. The most common side effects after giving POLYCLAV DROPS are vomiting, diarrhea, nausea, and thrush (fungal infections). Consult your doctor immediately if your child experiences any of the above side effects.
uses: Used to manage bacterial infections in children
usesDetails:
Uses Of POLYCLAV DROPS
Used to manage bacterial infections in children
mechanismOfAction:
How POLYCLAV DROPS Works

POLYCLAV DROPS work against bacterial infections. Amoxicillin in Clavam stops bacteria from making their cell walls, causing them to break apart and die. Clavulanic acid in Clavam stops bacteria from destroying amoxicillin, making it more effective at killing bacteria. So together, they help kill bacteria and manage infections.

Shake the medicine well before use.
Measure the required amount of the medicine in the measuring dropper provided with the pack.
Make sure to rinse the measuring dropper in warm water before and after use. Your doctor will decide the correct dose for your child based on their age and body weight.

POLYCLAV DROPS is suitable for use only in infants aged less than 1 year. However, it should be used only when recommended by your pediatrician. If your child is aged more than 1 year, consult your doctor for a suitable alternative.

introduction:
Introduction About CURAM 625MG TABLET

CURAM 625MG TABLET is used to manage bacterial infections, including middle ear and sinus infections, respiratory tract infections, genital tract infections, urinary tract infections, skin and soft tissue infections such as dental infections, bone and joint infections, septic abortion, and abdominal infections. The symptoms of bacterial infection include fever, difficulty breathing, pus formation, and pain.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belong to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It works by preventing the growth of bacteria and helps clear up the infection.

CURAM 625MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have liver problems or jaundice upon taking an antibiotic or amoxicillin-clavulanate. Before taking this medicine, inform your doctor if you are suffering from a hepatic impairment, liver disease, renal impairment, kidney disease, glandular fever, or are unable to pass water properly.

CURAM 625MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary. It should be used with caution in children (aged below 12 years) and elderly patients (above 50 years).

The common side effects associated with the use of CURAM 625MG TABLET are diarrhea, thrush (fungal infection in the vagina, skin folds, or mouth), nausea, and vomiting. Contact your doctor immediately if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of CURAM 625MG TABLET
Manage bacterial infection
mechanismOfAction:
How CURAM 625MG TABLET Works

CURAM 625MG TABLET helps in managing bacterial infection where amoxicillin is a penicillin that works by inhibiting the enzymes that help in the synthesis of the integral structural component of the bacterial cell wall whereas clavulanic acid is a beta-lactam (structurally related to penicillin) that works by inactivating an enzyme, namely beta-lactamase, thereby managing the inactivation of amoxicillin.
usageInstructions: Take this medicine as advised by your physician.
For Tablet, Capsule: Swallow the tablet with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse CURAM 625MG TABLET in the specified quantity of water as mentioned in the label.
Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

Common Side Effects of CURAM 625MG TABLET:
Diarrhoea

Nausea

Stop taking CURAM 625MG TABLET and contact your doctor if you experience any of the following side effects:

Inflammation of the liver (hepatitis), jaundice

warnings.details: CURAM 625MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women only if it is considered clearly necessary.
CURAM 625MG TABLET should be used with caution in breastfeeding women.
Do not drive or operate machines while taking if you feel unwell.
CURAM 625MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with renal impairment or kidney problems.

CURAM 625MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have ever had liver problems or jaundice upon taking an antibiotic or amoxicillin-clavulanate. It should be used with caution in patients with hepatic impairment or liver problems.
Do not take CURAM 625MG TABLET if you are allergic to amoxicillin, clavulanic acid, penicillin, any antibiotic, or any other ingredients of this medicine.
CURAM 625MG TABLET should be used with caution in children (below 12 years).
CURAM 625MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (above 50 years).

Others

Before taking CURAM 625MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you: 

Have glandular fever
Are unable to pass water properly

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug Interactions

Before taking CURAM 625MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Allopurinol, probenecid (medicine used to manage gout)
Warfarin (medicine used to inhibit blood clotting)
Methotrexate (medicine used to manage rheumatic diseases or certain cancers)
Mycophenolate mofetil (a medicine used to manage the organ rejection after organ transplant)
Contraceptives (medicines used to manage conception)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of CURAM 625MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose are gastrointestinal symptoms (including heartburn, indigestion, bloating, and constipation).

introduction:
Introduction About MOKCAN CV 200/28.5MG DRY SYRUP

MOKCAN CV 200/28.5MG DRY SYRUP is used to manage bacterial infections such as middle ear and sinus infections, respiratory tract infections, genital tract infections, urinary tract infections, skin and soft tissue infections such as dental infections, bone and joint infections, septic abortion (any abortion complicated by uterine infection), and abdominal infections. The symptoms of a bacterial infection may include fever, difficulty breathing, pus formation, and pain.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It works by preventing the growth of bacteria and helps clear up the infection.

Do not take MOKCAN CV 200/28.5MG DRY SYRUP if you have a history of hypersensitivity to beta-lactams, including penicillin and cephalosporins, or any other ingredients of this medicine. It is not recommended for use if you have a history of amoxicillin-clavulanate-associated jaundice or hepatic dysfunction.

Before taking MOKCAN CV 200/28.5MG DRY SYRUP, inform your doctor if you are suffering from hepatic or renal impairment. This medicine should be used with caution in pregnant women and only when necessary.

In breastfeeding women, it should be used with caution. MOKCAN CV 200/28.5MG DRY SYRUP should be used with caution in children (aged below 12 years) and elderly patients (above 50 years).

The common side effects associated with the use of MOKCAN CV 200/28.5MG DRY SYRUP are diarrhea, thrush (a fungal infection in the vagina, skin folds, or mouth), nausea, and vomiting. Contact your doctor immediately if any of the symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About MEGA CV 600MG INJECTION

MEGA CV 600MG INJECTION is used in the management of various bacterial infections such as respiratory tract infections (pneumonia, acute exacerbation of chronic bronchitis), urinary tract infections (cystitis, urethritis, pyelonephritis), bone and joint infections (osteomyelitis), middle ear infections (otitis media), tonsillitis, sinusitis, skin and soft tissue infections such as cellulitis, boils, wound infections, intra-abdominal sepsis, dental infections, and infections of genital organs in females.

MEGA CV 600MG INJECTION is also used as prophylaxis against various bacterial infections associated with major surgeries of the heart, joints, kidney, head and neck, stomach, biliary tract, intestine, and pelvic region. Along with management with this medicine, your doctor might order bacterial culture tests to enhance the outcomes of the management.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belong to the group of medicines called Penicillins and Beta-Lactamase Inhibitors. It works by preventing the growth of the bacteria and thus clearing up the infection.

MEGA CV 600MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney impairment who had a history of liver problems or jaundice after taking penicillin antibiotics. It should be used with caution in patients suffering from glandular fever (a viral infection causing sore throat, high fever, swelling of salivary glands, etc.), liver disease, kidney disease, who are not passing urine daily, convulsions (fits), or large intestine inflammation.

MEGA CV 600MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless necessary. It should be used with caution in breastfeeding women, as it may pass through breast milk. MEGA CV 600MG INJECTION should be used with caution in children as it may require dose modification.

The most common side effects after receiving MEGA CV 600MG INJECTION are diarrhea, thrush (fungal infection), etc. Consult your doctor immediately if any of your symptoms get worse or persist.
usesDetails:
Uses Of MEGA CV 600MG INJECTION
Management of various bacterial infections
mechanismOfAction:
How MEGA CV 600MG INJECTION Works

MEGA CV 600MG INJECTION helps in managing bacterial infection, where Amoxicillin works by inhibiting penicillin-binding proteins (which are involved in the synthesis of the bacterial cell wall), leading to the activation of autolytic enzymes in the bacterial cell wall. Therefore, leading to lysis of the cell wall and death of the bacterial cell, clavulanic acid inhibits the activity of bacterial enzymes known as beta-lactamases and hence enhances the antibacterial activity of amoxicillin.

name: Acuclav 375mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About ACUCLAV 375MG TABLET

ACUCLAV 375MG TABLET is used to manage bacterial infections, including middle ear and sinus infections, respiratory tract infections, genital tract infections, urinary tract infections, skin and soft tissue infections such as dental infections, bone and joint infections, septic abortion, and abdominal infections. The symptoms of bacterial infection include fever, difficulty breathing, pus formation, and pain.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belong to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It works by preventing the growth of bacteria and helps clear up the infection.

ACUCLAV 375MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have liver problems or jaundice upon taking an antibiotic or amoxicillin-clavulanate. Before taking this medicine, inform your doctor if you are suffering from a hepatic impairment, liver disease, renal impairment, kidney disease, glandular fever, or are unable to pass water properly.

ACUCLAV 375MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary. It should be used with caution in children (aged below 12 years) and elderly patients (above 50 years).

The common side effects associated with the use of ACUCLAV 375MG TABLET are diarrhea, thrush (fungal infection in the vagina, skin folds, or mouth), nausea, and vomiting. Contact your doctor immediately if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ACUCLAV 375MG TABLET
Manage bacterial infection
mechanismOfAction:
How ACUCLAV 375MG TABLET Works

ACUCLAV 375MG TABLET helps in managing bacterial infection where amoxicillin is a penicillin that works by inhibiting the enzymes that help in the synthesis of the integral structural component of the bacterial cell wall whereas clavulanic acid is a beta-lactam (structurally related to penicillin) that works by inactivating an enzyme, namely beta-lactamase, thereby managing the inactivation of amoxicillin.

introduction:
Introduction About MOXILIUM 250 DT TABLET

MOXILIUM 250 DT TABLET contains Amoxicillin which belongs to the group of medicines called Penicillins. It is used to manage wide range of infections caused by gram positive and gram-negative bacteria which includes respiratory infection (such as otitis media), sinus infection, gynaecological infection, urinary tract infection and other serious infections (such as septicaemia).

MOXILIUM 250 DT TABLET is not recommended for use in patients suffering from mononucleosis (glandular fever caused by Epstein Barr Virus) and/or certain infections (especially urinary tract infection, a severe infection of ear/nose/throat) caused by the non-susceptible pathogen.

Before taking MOXILIUM 250 DT TABLET, inform your doctor if you have a history of seizures/fits, meningeal disorders, diarrhoea, kidney problems (such as renal impairment) and/or liver problems (such as hepatic impairment).

MOXILIUM 250 DT TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if it is clearly necessary. MOXILIUM 250 DT TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents (from 6 months to 18 years of age) and elderly patients (aged above 65 years). Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.

The most common side effects of taking MOXILIUM 250 DT TABLET are skin rash, nausea and diarrhoea. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About PRESSCLAV FORTE 457MG DRY SYRUP

PRESSCLAV FORTE 457MG DRY SYRUP is used to manage bacterial infections such as middle ear and sinus infections, respiratory tract infections, genital tract infections, urinary tract infections, skin and soft tissue infections such as dental infections, bone and joint infections, septic abortion (any abortion complicated by uterine infection), and abdominal infections. The symptoms of a bacterial infection may include fever, difficulty breathing, pus formation, and pain.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It works by preventing the growth of bacteria and helps clear up the infection.

Do not take PRESSCLAV FORTE 457MG DRY SYRUP if you have a history of hypersensitivity to beta-lactams, including penicillin and cephalosporins, or any other ingredients of this medicine. It is not recommended for use if you have a history of amoxicillin-clavulanate-associated jaundice or hepatic dysfunction.

Before taking PRESSCLAV FORTE 457MG DRY SYRUP, inform your doctor if you are suffering from hepatic or renal impairment. This medicine should be used with caution in pregnant women and only when necessary.

In breastfeeding women, it should be used with caution. PRESSCLAV FORTE 457MG DRY SYRUP should be used with caution in children (aged below 12 years) and elderly patients (above 50 years).

The common side effects associated with the use of PRESSCLAV FORTE 457MG DRY SYRUP are diarrhea, thrush (a fungal infection in the vagina, skin folds, or mouth), nausea, and vomiting. Contact your doctor immediately if any of the symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About AXYLOX PD 500 CAPSULE

AXYLOX PD 500 CAPSULE contains a combination of Amoxicillin and Cloxacillin, which belongs to the group of medicines called semi-synthetic penicillin antibiotics. AXYLOX PD 500 CAPSULE is used to manage infectious conditions caused by various types of bacteria such as lung infection (Bronchopneumonia, bronchitis etc.), infection in the blood (septicaemia), urinary tract infection, bone infection, wound infection and following a surgery etc. The symptoms of bacterial infection include fever, tiredness, headache, stomach pain, feeling sick or vomiting sensation etc.

Amoxicillin and Cloxacillin work by killing and managing the growth of bacteria by blocking the production of the bacterial cell wall. Before recommending AXYLOX PD 500 CAPSULE, your doctor may want you to take relevant blood tests to understand your existing condition.

Before taking AXYLOX PD 500 CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have or ever had kidney disease (such as difficulty in passing urine, kidney failure, kidney injury etc.), liver disease, viral or fungal infection, malnutrition, suppressed immune system, bone marrow disorder, fits or seizure disorder, frequent diarrhoea etc. AXYLOX PD 500 CAPSULE should be used with caution among women who are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking AXYLOX PD 500 CAPSULE are sickness, vomiting, skin rashes, itching, loose stools (diarrhoea), stomach upset or discomfort etc. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

name: SUCOPEN 625mg Tablet 6's
introduction:
Introduction About SUCOPEN 625MG TABLET

SUCOPEN 625MG TABLET is used to manage bacterial infections, including middle ear and sinus infections, respiratory tract infections, genital tract infections, urinary tract infections, skin and soft tissue infections such as dental infections, bone and joint infections, septic abortion, and abdominal infections. The symptoms of bacterial infection include fever, difficulty breathing, pus formation, and pain.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belong to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It works by preventing the growth of bacteria and helps clear up the infection.

SUCOPEN 625MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have liver problems or jaundice upon taking an antibiotic or amoxicillin-clavulanate. Before taking this medicine, inform your doctor if you are suffering from a hepatic impairment, liver disease, renal impairment, kidney disease, glandular fever, or are unable to pass water properly.

SUCOPEN 625MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary. It should be used with caution in children (aged below 12 years) and elderly patients (above 50 years).

The common side effects associated with the use of SUCOPEN 625MG TABLET are diarrhea, thrush (fungal infection in the vagina, skin folds, or mouth), nausea, and vomiting. Contact your doctor immediately if any of the symptoms worsen.

Manage bacterial infection
mechanismOfAction:
How SUCOPEN 625MG TABLET Works

SUCOPEN 625MG TABLET helps in managing bacterial infection where amoxicillin is a penicillin that works by inhibiting the enzymes that help in the synthesis of the integral structural component of the bacterial cell wall whereas clavulanic acid is a beta-lactam (structurally related to penicillin) that works by inactivating an enzyme, namely beta-lactamase, thereby managing the inactivation of amoxicillin.

introduction:
Introduction About AMPIVAC 500 INJECTION

AMPIVAC 500 INJECTION contains Ampicillin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage bacterial infections of the ear, nose, throat, respiratory tract (bronchus, lungs), urinary tract, genital tract, stomach, blood, brain and skin or soft tissues.

It can also be used to manage typhoid fever, meningitis (inflammation of the lining of the brain), peritonitis (inflammation of the lining of the stomach) and endocarditis (inflammation of the lining of the heart and its valves).

AMPIVAC 500 INJECTION should be used under medical supervision. Do not stop receiving AMPIVAC 500 INJECTION even if you feel better during the midway of the therapy. Failing to complete the full course of the therapy or skipping doses in between the therapy may not result in adequate infection control.

During therapy with AMPIVAC 500 INJECTION, your doctor will periodically monitor your health condition through several blood tests/urine tests to access the improvement in your condition and to reduce the risk of unwanted side effects. AMPIVAC 500 INJECTION is suitable for use in adults and in children (aged 10 years or older; weighing 20 kg or more).

Before receiving AMPIVAC 500 INJECTION inform your doctor if you have any kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have blood cancer or any viral infections (such as cytomegalovirus infection) as a precaution.

AMPIVAC 500 INJECTION should be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women only if considered necessary by the physician. The most common side effects of receiving AMPIVAC 500 INJECTION are nausea, vomiting and diarrhea. Inform your doctor if they trouble you.

AMPIVAC 500 INJECTION is a bactericidal agent. It kills the susceptible bacteria by blocking the bacterial cell wall synthesis that is essential for the bacterial cell to survive. This action destroys the susceptible bacteria, manage their further growth and multiplication and reduce the severity of the infection.

AMPIVAC 500 INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into the vein (intravenously) or into the muscles (intramuscularly).

Do not miss a dose or stop receiving AMPIVAC 500 INJECTION without consulting your doctor as it may worsen your condition.

introduction:
Introduction About PENOM DT DISPERSIBLE TABLET

PENOM DT DISPERSIBLE TABLET contains Amoxicillin which belongs to the group of medicines called Penicillins. It is used to manage wide range of infections caused by gram positive and gram-negative bacteria which includes respiratory infection (such as otitis media), sinus infection, gynaecological infection, urinary tract infection and other serious infections (such as septicaemia).

PENOM DT DISPERSIBLE TABLET is not recommended for use in patients suffering from mononucleosis (glandular fever caused by Epstein Barr Virus) and/or certain infections (especially urinary tract infection, a severe infection of ear/nose/throat) caused by the non-susceptible pathogen.

Before taking PENOM DT DISPERSIBLE TABLET, inform your doctor if you have a history of seizures/fits, meningeal disorders, diarrhoea, kidney problems (such as renal impairment) and/or liver problems (such as hepatic impairment).

PENOM DT DISPERSIBLE TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if it is clearly necessary. PENOM DT DISPERSIBLE TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents (from 6 months to 18 years of age) and elderly patients (aged above 65 years). Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.

The most common side effects of taking PENOM DT DISPERSIBLE TABLET are skin rash, nausea and diarrhoea. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About MEGA CV 300MG INJECTION

MEGA CV 300MG INJECTION is used in the management of various bacterial infections such as respiratory tract infections (pneumonia, acute exacerbation of chronic bronchitis), urinary tract infections (cystitis, urethritis, pyelonephritis), bone and joint infections (osteomyelitis), middle ear infections (otitis media), tonsillitis, sinusitis, skin and soft tissue infections such as cellulitis, boils, wound infections, intra-abdominal sepsis, dental infections, and infections of genital organs in females.

MEGA CV 300MG INJECTION is also used as prophylaxis against various bacterial infections associated with major surgeries of the heart, joints, kidney, head and neck, stomach, biliary tract, intestine, and pelvic region. Along with management with this medicine, your doctor might order bacterial culture tests to enhance the outcomes of the management.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belong to the group of medicines called Penicillins and Beta-Lactamase Inhibitors. It works by preventing the growth of the bacteria and thus clearing up the infection.

MEGA CV 300MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney impairment who had a history of liver problems or jaundice after taking penicillin antibiotics. It should be used with caution in patients suffering from glandular fever (a viral infection causing sore throat, high fever, swelling of salivary glands, etc.), liver disease, kidney disease, who are not passing urine daily, convulsions (fits), or large intestine inflammation.

MEGA CV 300MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless necessary. It should be used with caution in breastfeeding women, as it may pass through breast milk. MEGA CV 300MG INJECTION should be used with caution in children as it may require dose modification.

The most common side effects after receiving MEGA CV 300MG INJECTION are diarrhea, thrush (fungal infection), etc. Consult your doctor immediately if any of your symptoms get worse or persist.
usesDetails:
Uses Of MEGA CV 300MG INJECTION
Management of various bacterial infections
mechanismOfAction:
How MEGA CV 300MG INJECTION Works

MEGA CV 300MG INJECTION helps in managing bacterial infection, where Amoxicillin works by inhibiting penicillin-binding proteins (which are involved in the synthesis of the bacterial cell wall), leading to the activation of autolytic enzymes in the bacterial cell wall. Therefore, leading to lysis of the cell wall and death of the bacterial cell, clavulanic acid inhibits the activity of bacterial enzymes known as beta-lactamases and hence enhances the antibacterial activity of amoxicillin.

introduction:
Introduction About LABMOX KID 125 DISPERSIBLE TABLET

LABMOX KID 125 DISPERSIBLE TABLET is an antibiotic medicine used in the management of various bacterial infections such as respiratory tract infections, ear, nose, throat infections, stomach infections (H. Pylori infection), skin infections and urinary tract infections, especially in children. It contains a medicine called amoxycillin which is a powerful antibacterial agent that eradicates the susceptible microorganism that causes the infection.

Do not take LABMOX KID 125 DISPERSIBLE TABLET if you are allergic to Amoxycillin. Before taking LABMOX KID 125 DISPERSIBLE TABLET inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, glandular fever, urinary problems, etc. Consult your doctor before taking LABMOX KID 125 DISPERSIBLE TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking LABMOX KID 125 DISPERSIBLE TABLET are nausea, diarrhea and skin rashes. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LABMOX KID 125 DISPERSIBLE TABLET

Management of bacterial infections such as:

Respiratory tract infections
Ear, nose, throat infections
Stomach infections (H. Pylori infection)
Skin infections
Urinary tract infections
mechanismOfAction:
How LABMOX KID 125 DISPERSIBLE TABLET Works

LABMOX KID 125 DISPERSIBLE TABLET contains a medicine called Amoxicillin which is a type of antibiotic that belongs to the penicillin group. It works by inhibiting the synthesis of bacterial cell walls. Bacteria have a protective outer layer called the cell wall, which is essential for their survival. Amoxicillin interferes with the enzymes that are responsible for forming the cell wall, specifically targeting the cross-linking process. This weakens the cell wall, causing it to rupture and ultimately leading to the death of the bacteria. This action makes amoxicillin effective against a wide range of bacterial infections.

Take LABMOX KID 125 DISPERSIBLE TABLET as advised by the physician. Disperse the medicine in a glass of water before consumption. Do not crush, swallow or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of the therapy based on your age, body weight and severity of infection.

introduction:
Introduction About PIPRAVAC TZ 2.25 INJECTION

PIPRAVAC TZ 2.25 INJECTION is a combination of Piperacillin and Tazobactam which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage several bacterial infections such as lower respiratory tract infections such as pneumonia, acute bacterial exacerbation causing breathing difficulties, urinary tract infections, pyelonephritis, skin infections, abdominal, biliary tract infections and female pelvic infections such as postpartum endometritis or pelvic inflammatory disease, bacteraemia, and bacterial meningitis in infants and children. It is also used along with other antibacterial agents in the management of neutropenic caused by bacterial infection.

Inform your doctor or your health-care professional before any laboratory tests as PIPRAVAC TZ 2.25 INJECTION will interact with medical investigations. Inform your doctor if you are allergic to any antibiotics or other medicines. PIPRAVAC TZ 2.25 INJECTION should not be used in patients allergic to penicillin antibiotics, cephalosporin, and other beta-lactam antibiotics. PIPRAVAC TZ 2.25 INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with pre-existing diarrhoea, low potassium levels, kidney, and liver diseases.

Avoid concomitant use of other aminoglycoside antibiotics and vancomycin along with this medicine. PIPRAVAC TZ 2.25 INJECTION should be used with caution in pregnant and breast-feeding women. PIPRAVAC TZ 2.25 INJECTION should be used with caution in children above 2 months and in elderly people. Your doctor will administer the right dose depends on your child’s age, body weight and severity of the infection. The common side effects of PIPRAVAC TZ 2.25 INJECTION are diarrhoea, yeast infection, headache, sleeplessness, stomach pain, vomiting, nausea, constipation, skin rash, itching, fever, and injection site reaction.

mechanismOfAction:
How PIPRAVAC TZ 2.25 INJECTION Works

PIPRAVAC TZ 2.25 INJECTION works by destroying the bacterial growth responsible for causing infections. Piperacillin works by interrupting the cell wall formation by binding with the enzymes responsible for cell wall synthesis. This binding causes defects in the cell wall leading to cell death causing death of the organism. Tazobactam is responsible for the irreversible termination of enzymes (beta- lactamases) that protect the organism from antibiotics and produces less anti-bacterial actions when given alone so it’s always used in combination with other antibiotics. Thus, both the substances works by managing cell growth and function inhibiting bacterial growth.

PIPRAVAC TZ 2.25 INJECTION will be administered into the vein (intravenously) by your doctor or nurse. Your doctor will administer the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: LAVMOX LB 625 Tablet 6's
introduction:
Introduction About LAVMOX LB 625 TABLET

LAVMOX LB 625 Tablet is used in the management of various bacterial infections. It is prescribed predominantly to manage ear infections, sinus infections, respiratory tract infections, urinary tract infections, skin and soft tissue infections, certain dental infections, bone and joint infections and certain other infections caused by bacteria. 

LAVMOX LB 625 Tablet is a combination antibiotic combining Amoxicillin, Clavulanic acid and Lactic acid Bacillus as active ingredients. Amoxicillin weakens bacterial cell walls, leading to their destruction, and Clavulanic acid protects amoxicillin from degradation by enzymes produced by bacteria, allowing it to effectively combat a broader range of bacterial infections. This combination enhances the efficacy of amoxicillin, making it effective against a wider spectrum of bacteria. Lactic acid bacillus helps to replenish and maintain the beneficial bacteria in the gut, reducing the risk of antibiotic induced diarrhea or other gut problems.

Prior to the therapy, your doctor may suggest blood tests and urine tests to analyse the type of bacteria that has caused the infection and the number of bacteria that is present in the body for better therapy optimisation.  

Take LAVMOX LB 625 Tablet with meals or as advised by your physician. Take LAVMOX LB 625 Tablet exactly for the duration recommended by your doctor. Stopping the therapy during the midway may cause the bacteria to become more resistant and makes it difficult to control the infection. Do not take LAVMOX LB 625 Tablet for more than 2 weeks without consulting your doctor. 

LAVMOX LB 625 Tablet is suitable for use in adults and in children (weighing 40 kgs or more). Before taking LAVMOX LB 625 Tablet inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must inform your doctor before LAVMOX LB 625 Tablet is prescribed to you, if you are pregnant, breastfeeding, scheduled for any blood tests, liver function test or urine tests. 

Do not take LAVMOX LB 625 Tablet if you are allergic to any of its ingredients. The most common side effects of taking LAVMOX LB 625 Tablet are diarrhoea, thrush, nausea, vomiting, skin rash, indigestion, dizziness and headache. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How LAVMOX LB 625 TABLET Works

LAVMOX LB 625 Tablet is a combination three medicines, namely Amoxicillin, Clavulanic acid and Lactic acid Bacillus. Amoxicillin is a penicillin type antibiotic. It works by blocking the release of certain essential proteins (peptidoglycans) within the bacteria that is responsible for bacterial cell wall synthesis. This weakens the bacterial cell wall, leading to its rupture, followed by destruction of bacteria.  

Clavulanic acid is a beta-lactamase inhibitor. Many bacteria produce enzymes called β-lactamases that can destroy penicillin-type antibiotics like amoxicillin, rendering them ineffective. Clavulanic acid inhibits these β-lactamase enzymes, protecting amoxicillin from degradation. This allows amoxicillin to exert its antibacterial effects effectively against a broader spectrum of bacteria, including those that produce β-lactamases. 

By combining amoxicillin with clavulanic acid, the efficacy of amoxicillin is enhanced, making the combination antibiotic effective against a wider range of bacterial infections.  

Lactic acid Bacillus present in the medicine helps in replenishing and maintaining beneficial bacteria in the gut, reducing the risk of antibiotic associated diarrhea and other gut problems.
usageDetails:
How to use LAVMOX LB 625 TABLET

Take LAVMOX LB 625 Tablet with meals or as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. 

LAVMOX LB 625 Tablet is usually prescribed as one dose thrice daily for 2 weeks. However, your doctor will decide the correct dosage and number of doses to be taken in a day based on your age, body weight and severity of infection. 

Take LAVMOX LB 625 Tablet exactly for the duration recommended by your doctor. Stopping the therapy during the midway may cause the bacteria to become more resistant and makes it difficult to control the infection.  

Inform your doctor if there is no improvement in your condition even after using LAVMOX LB 625 Tablet for more than 2 weeks.

Introduction About DUET DDS 457MG SUSPENSION

DUET DDS 457MG SUSPENSION is used to manage bacterial infections such as middle ear and sinus infections, respiratory tract infections, genital tract infections, urinary tract infections, skin and soft tissue infections such as dental infections, bone and joint infections, septic abortion (any abortion complicated by uterine infection), and abdominal infections. The symptoms of a bacterial infection may include fever, difficulty breathing, pus formation, and pain.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It works by preventing the growth of bacteria and helps clear up the infection.

Do not take DUET DDS 457MG SUSPENSION if you have a history of hypersensitivity to beta-lactams, including penicillin and cephalosporins, or any other ingredients of this medicine. It is not recommended for use if you have a history of amoxicillin-clavulanate-associated jaundice or hepatic dysfunction.

Before taking DUET DDS 457MG SUSPENSION, inform your doctor if you are suffering from hepatic or renal impairment. This medicine should be used with caution in pregnant women and only when necessary.

In breastfeeding women, it should be used with caution. DUET DDS 457MG SUSPENSION should be used with caution in children (aged below 12 years) and elderly patients (above 50 years).

The common side effects associated with the use of DUET DDS 457MG SUSPENSION are diarrhea, thrush (a fungal infection in the vagina, skin folds, or mouth), nausea, and vomiting. Contact your doctor immediately if any of the symptoms worsen.

name: Sensiclav 300mg Injection 1's
introduction:
Introduction About SENSICLAV 300MG INJECTION

SENSICLAV 300MG INJECTION is used in the management of various bacterial infections such as respiratory tract infections (pneumonia, acute exacerbation of chronic bronchitis), urinary tract infections (cystitis, urethritis, pyelonephritis), bone and joint infections (osteomyelitis), middle ear infections (otitis media), tonsillitis, sinusitis, skin and soft tissue infections such as cellulitis, boils, wound infections, intra-abdominal sepsis, dental infections, and infections of genital organs in females.

SENSICLAV 300MG INJECTION is also used as prophylaxis against various bacterial infections associated with major surgeries of the heart, joints, kidney, head and neck, stomach, biliary tract, intestine, and pelvic region. Along with management with this medicine, your doctor might order bacterial culture tests to enhance the outcomes of the management.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belong to the group of medicines called Penicillins and Beta-Lactamase Inhibitors. It works by preventing the growth of the bacteria and thus clearing up the infection.

SENSICLAV 300MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney impairment who had a history of liver problems or jaundice after taking penicillin antibiotics. It should be used with caution in patients suffering from glandular fever (a viral infection causing sore throat, high fever, swelling of salivary glands, etc.), liver disease, kidney disease, who are not passing urine daily, convulsions (fits), or large intestine inflammation.

SENSICLAV 300MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless necessary. It should be used with caution in breastfeeding women, as it may pass through breast milk. SENSICLAV 300MG INJECTION should be used with caution in children as it may require dose modification.

The most common side effects after receiving SENSICLAV 300MG INJECTION are diarrhea, thrush (fungal infection), etc. Consult your doctor immediately if any of your symptoms get worse or persist.
usesDetails:
Uses Of SENSICLAV 300MG INJECTION
Management of various bacterial infections
mechanismOfAction:
How SENSICLAV 300MG INJECTION Works

SENSICLAV 300MG INJECTION helps in managing bacterial infection, where Amoxicillin works by inhibiting penicillin-binding proteins (which are involved in the synthesis of the bacterial cell wall), leading to the activation of autolytic enzymes in the bacterial cell wall. Therefore, leading to lysis of the cell wall and death of the bacterial cell, clavulanic acid inhibits the activity of bacterial enzymes known as beta-lactamases and hence enhances the antibacterial activity of amoxicillin.

introduction:
Introduction About AMOXYVAC CV STRAWBERRY FLAVOR ORAL SUSPENSION

AMOXYVAC CV STRAWBERRY FLAVOR ORAL SUSPENSION is used to manage bacterial infections such as middle ear and sinus infections, respiratory tract infections, genital tract infections, urinary tract infections, skin and soft tissue infections such as dental infections, bone and joint infections, septic abortion (any abortion complicated by uterine infection), and abdominal infections. The symptoms of a bacterial infection may include fever, difficulty breathing, pus formation, and pain.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It works by preventing the growth of bacteria and helps clear up the infection.

Do not take AMOXYVAC CV STRAWBERRY FLAVOR ORAL SUSPENSION if you have a history of hypersensitivity to beta-lactams, including penicillin and cephalosporins, or any other ingredients of this medicine. It is not recommended for use if you have a history of amoxicillin-clavulanate-associated jaundice or hepatic dysfunction.

Before taking AMOXYVAC CV STRAWBERRY FLAVOR ORAL SUSPENSION, inform your doctor if you are suffering from hepatic or renal impairment. This medicine should be used with caution in pregnant women and only when necessary.

In breastfeeding women, it should be used with caution. AMOXYVAC CV STRAWBERRY FLAVOR ORAL SUSPENSION should be used with caution in children (aged below 12 years) and elderly patients (above 50 years).

The common side effects associated with the use of AMOXYVAC CV STRAWBERRY FLAVOR ORAL SUSPENSION are diarrhea, thrush (a fungal infection in the vagina, skin folds, or mouth), nausea, and vomiting. Contact your doctor immediately if any of the symptoms worsen.

Introduction About MOXITRUE 625 TABLET

MOXITRUE 625 TABLET is used to manage bacterial infections, including middle ear and sinus infections, respiratory tract infections, genital tract infections, urinary tract infections, skin and soft tissue infections such as dental infections, bone and joint infections, septic abortion, and abdominal infections. The symptoms of bacterial infection include fever, difficulty breathing, pus formation, and pain.

It contains a combination of medicines called Amoxicillin and Clavulanic acid, which belong to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It works by preventing the growth of bacteria and helps clear up the infection.

MOXITRUE 625 TABLET is not recommended for use if you have liver problems or jaundice upon taking an antibiotic or amoxicillin-clavulanate. Before taking this medicine, inform your doctor if you are suffering from a hepatic impairment, liver disease, renal impairment, kidney disease, glandular fever, or are unable to pass water properly.

MOXITRUE 625 TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary. It should be used with caution in children (aged below 12 years) and elderly patients (above 50 years).

The common side effects associated with the use of MOXITRUE 625 TABLET are diarrhea, thrush (fungal infection in the vagina, skin folds, or mouth), nausea, and vomiting. Contact your doctor immediately if any of the symptoms worsen.
